article.articleHeadline: Braziliyadakı sarı qızdırma epidemiyasının səbəbi tapılıb
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The cause of the yellow fever epidemic in Brazil has been found.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever outbreak in Brazil (2017–2018) tied to unprecedented drought, per Science Advances study led by Jamie Coldwell of Princeton University. The team found the dry spell inverted the usual rainfall-driven spread, with 1,376 infections and 483 deaths across the country over two years. The disease reached large cities in Minas Gerais as drought forced monkeys to migrate to urban areas for water, carrying the virus to Haemagogus forest mosquitoes that then moved into cities and transmitted it to Aedes aegypti. Yellow fever is a mosquito-borne virus, with about 90% of cases occurring in Africa; severe illness features high fever, organ damage, and bleeding, and roughly half of those progressing to severe disease die within 7–10 days. The study warns recurring droughts could heighten the risk of new urban outbreaks in major cities.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける黄熱病流行の原因が判明
triage.triage_reason: 2017-2018年の過去の流行に関する研究成果の報告であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は2017-2018年に発生した過去の黄熱病流行について、干ばつとの関連を分析した学術研究（Science Advances誌）を報じたものであり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: 夏天这种"发烧+乏力"别当感冒扛！可能是"蜱虫病"！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Summer, Don't Mistake This 'Fever and Fatigue' for a Cold! It Could Be a 'Tick-Borne Disease'!
article.articleSummary: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), a tick-borne viral infection caused by Dabie bandavirus, is entering China's high-risk season. Since April 1, 2026, SFTS is a Category B disease under the national Infectious Diseases Law. Shandong is among seven high-risk provinces (Anhui, Henan, Hubei, Liaoning, Jiangsu, Zhejiang) with peak transmission April–October, mainly affecting older rural farmers and outdoor workers. Early symptoms mimic a cold but include fever (38–40°C), fatigue, myalgia, loss of appetite, nausea, diarrhea, and progressive thrombocytopenia and leukopenia. Severe illness can involve bleeding, confusion, dyspnea, and oliguria. Transmission is primarily through tick bites; secondary spread can occur via contact with infected blood, secretions, or animals (cattle, sheep, cats, dogs). Prevention emphasizes protective clothing, DEET, permethrin-treated gear, body checks, and environmental cleanup. After a bite, avoid burning or oiling the tick; remove with tweezers, disinfect, and monitor for two weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の「発熱+倦怠感」を風邪と勘違いしないで！「マダニ媒介感染症」の可能性
triage.triage_reason: 中国で毎年発生する既知の季節性疾患（SFTS）に関する一般向け予防啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な増加を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: SFTSは中国7省で毎年4〜10月に流行する既知の風土病であり、本記事は季節到来に伴う一般向け予防啓発情報。具体的な症例数増加や新規アウトブレイクの記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱、30分に1人が犠牲に
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: one person dies every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating, with UN OCHA reporting a death every 30 minutes. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been over 4,500 confirmed infections and at least 2,128 deaths. The UN warns this could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak on record as transmission remains focused in Congo’s six provinces, while cases have also emerged in Uganda and near the South Sudan border. In response, international funding for the outbreak has reached about $300 million. The UN Emergency Fund has allocated an additional $30.5 million, supplementing the $24 million already earmarked for Congo and four other countries, to bolster containment, treatment capacity, and cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱、30分に1人が犠牲に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（4,500例超・死者2,128人）で史上最悪級と警告され、ウガンダ・南スーダン国境地域にも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンでの症例発生も報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。国際支援として約3億ドルの資金が投入されており、致死率の高さと拡大リスクから史上最悪のエボラ流行になり得ると警告されている。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: وفاة مصاب بفيروس إيبولا كل 30 دقيقة فى الكونغو الديمقراطية |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: An Ebola patient dies every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: UN warns Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading at an unprecedented pace, with more than 4,500 confirmed and probable infections and at least 2,128 deaths since it was first reported on May 15. Tom Fletcher, Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator, says the current outbreak is the fastest-spreading on record and stresses the need to rapidly broaden the international response to prevent wider transmission. The outbreak is killing about one person every 30 minutes, and six provinces in the DRC have reported cases. Additional infections have been detected in Uganda, with cases near the South Sudan border, raising concerns about cross-border spread and the potential for the epidemic to become one of Ebola’s deadliest in history.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国で30分ごとにエボラ患者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数(深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際的拡大の兆候)に該当し、WPRO基準も広範に満たすため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダやスーダン国境付近での感染例にも言及しているが、主たる発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola lan sang tỉnh thứ 6 của Cộng hòa Dân chủ Congo, số ca tử vong tăng lên trên 2.180 người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has spread to the sixth province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the death toll rising to over 2,180.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak has spread to Bas-Uele, the sixth province affected in the Democratic Republic of Congo. A death was confirmed in Buta, Bas-Uele, in a patient who traveled from Isiro, Haut-Uele, by motorbike taxi. As of August 14, total confirmed Ebola cases reached 4,665 with 2,184 deaths (case fatality ~46.8%). Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of cases and 80% of deaths. The outbreak is progressing faster than previous waves; delayed case detection, ongoing armed conflict, and an overburdened health system hinder response and enable transmission. Bas-Uele borders South Sudan and the Central African Republic, and the Haut-Uele–Basu-Uele case shows spread along population routes. Africa CDC urges international support to deploy Ervebo; Kinshasa has requested 100,000 doses for trials, frontline workers, and high-risk groups. Ervebo targets Ebola Zaire; experts say it may offer protection and reduce mortality even with Bundibugyo in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行が第6州に拡大、死者数は2,180人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約46.8%の大規模なエボラ流行が第6州へ拡大しており、武力紛争と保健システムの逼弱により対応が困難で、国際支援(ワクチン10万回分要請)が必要とされているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 南スーダンおよび中央アフリカ共和国との国境地域(Bas-Uele)への拡大が報告されているが、これら周辺国での症例発生は記事中に明記されていないため、対象国リストに該当するDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。Africa CDCによるErvebo（エボラ・ザイール株ワクチン）の国際展開要請があり、越境拡大リスクが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: 7月广东新冠感染超7.1万例，流感43万例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong records over 71,000 COVID-19 infections in July and 430,000 influenza cases.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong, July 2026: 71,467 new COVID-19 infections (0 deaths) from July 1–31, up from 26,117 in June. Influenza cases reached 430,516 with 2 deaths; June had 274,328. Total July statutory infectious diseases: 618,365 cases, 113 deaths. Category A: no cases or deaths. Category B: 112,543 cases, 111 deaths; top diseases are COVID-19, hepatitis B, syphilis, tuberculosis, and gonorrhea, accounting for 96.64% of Category B. No cases or deaths for infectious atypical pneumonia, poliomyelitis, rabies, fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, anthrax, meningococcal meningitis (流脑), diphtheria, or schistosomiasis. Category C: 505,822 cases, 2 deaths; top three are influenza, hand-foot-mouth disease, and other infectious diarrhoeal diseases, making up 99.85% of Category C. Prevention notes emphasize high susceptibility to COVID-19, heightened risk for the elderly and those with chronic conditions, and the need for protection in elderly care and welfare facilities, hygiene, masking in clinical settings, and early diagnosis/reporting of clusters.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省、7月の新型コロナ感染者数が7.1万人超、インフルエンザは43万例
triage.triage_reason: 広東省疾病予防管理センターの月次法定感染症統計報告であり、COVID-19・インフルエンザとも季節的な増加はあるが死亡率は低く、異常な流行や国際的拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 定例の月次感染症統計発表であり、突発的な感染症イベントではないため対象国リストへの該当としては計上しない（中国国内の通常統計報告）。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: وفاة شخص بـ"إيبولا" كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One person dies of Ebola every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is driving a rapidly escalating outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with deaths now reported at about one every 30 minutes. Since the outbreak began on May 15, DR Congo has recorded over 4,500 infections and at least 2,128 deaths. The United Nations warns the virus is spreading quickly and urges a strengthened international response, alongside essential services such as water, sanitation, and healthcare. The outbreak has been detected in six Congolese provinces and has also reached neighboring Uganda, with cases near the South Sudan border. In response, the UN has allocated an additional $30.5 million, in addition to $24 million previously provided for DR Congo and four other countries. Frontline teams have been boosted with 20 more staff; emphasis is on safe and dignified burials, expanding treatment capacity, improving contact tracing, and deploying more experienced managers.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより30分ごとに1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラの大規模アウトブレイクで感染者4,500人超、死者2,128人以上、複数州及び隣国ウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大も報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。国連が3,050万ドルの追加支援を割り当てるなど、国際的な対応が既に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 6 người bị đàn chó nghi mắc dại cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six people bitten by a pack of dogs suspected of having rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies suspected in Thanh Hoa, Vietnam: Six residents of Thanh Quan commune's Thanh Huong hamlet were bitten or exposed to saliva from a pack of dogs during euthanization from late July to 14 August 2026. An initial dog showed abnormal behavior, bit several people, then died; another dog in the same group bit three people, including a child. Some victims delayed vaccination; one applied traditional medicine to wounds. Thanh Hoa CDC and local authorities are reviewing exposures and urging vaccination; authorities are tightening dog/cat management, vaccination checks, and public messaging against roaming pets. Rabies is spread mainly via dog saliva and is nearly 100% fatal once symptoms appear, but preventable with timely post-exposure prophylaxis. Immediate actions: wash wounds with soap under running water for at least 15 minutes, disinfect, and seek medical evaluation for vaccine or immunoglobulin; avoid home remedies.

triage.headline_ja: 犬の群れに噛まれた6人、狂犬病の疑い
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの一地域における個別の犬咬傷事例であり、狂犬病は同国で地方病的に発生しているため異常性は低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで地方病的に発生しており、地元当局（Thanh Hoa CDC）が対応中。人-人感染はなく、局所的な動物咬傷事例として管理可能な範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: 确诊4665例，死亡2184例！疫情蔓延6省，非洲疾控：大量死亡病例出现在医疗设施之外！世卫组织：传播速度前所未有！中使馆紧急提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4,665 confirmed cases, 2,184 deaths! Outbreak spreads to six provinces! Africa CDC: a large number of deaths occur outside healthcare facilities! WHO: the speed of transmission is unprecedented! The Chinese embassy issues urgent reminder.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has spread to six provinces as of Aug 12, 2026: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo. Cumulative confirmed cases reach 4,665 with 2,184 deaths. Africa CDC reports ongoing community transmission and a rising number of deaths outside healthcare facilities. WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the speed of transmission is unprecedented, and the outbreak could become the largest on record, potentially lasting over a year and possibly surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Cross-border risk is high given proximity to South Sudan, about 35 km from the border. Ongoing conflict in North and South Kivu hampers response and fuels distrust. China issued warnings for its nationals and, on Aug 1, dispatched a third batch of Ebola experts to Kinshasa to bolster surveillance and laboratories. Case fatality rate around 50%, some strains up to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: 確診4,665例、死亡2,184例！感染は6州に拡大、アフリカCDC：多数の死亡が医療施設外で発生！WHO：前例のない速さで拡大！中国大使館が緊急注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が6州に拡大し、致死率約50%、WHOが前例のない拡大速度と史上最大規模の可能性を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 南スーダン国境から約35kmと近接し越境リスクが高い。北・南キブ州の紛争が対応を阻害。中国は自国民への警告と専門家派遣を実施。中国自体での発生ではないため China は verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Liên Hiệp Quốc báo động về dịch Ebola, kêu gọi quốc tế hành động
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations warns of the Ebola outbreak, calls on the international community to take action.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) — the 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus — has reached at least 4,500 confirmed cases and 2,128 deaths since it was declared on May 15, and is spreading across six provinces in the DRC and into Uganda, with infections near the border with South Sudan. UN Deputy Secretary-General for humanitarian affairs Tom Fletcher called it the fastest-spreading and potentially deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, warning that a life is lost roughly every 30 minutes. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo. Donors have contributed nearly $300 million to the Ebola response fund; after a UN meeting, an additional $30.5 million from the UN emergency fund was allocated, to be added to $24 million previously allocated for Congo and four other countries.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ流行を警告し国際社会に行動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生した第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョウイルス）が4,500例以上・死亡2,128人に達し、ウガンダへも拡大、国連が史上最速拡大の恐れがあると警告しており、国際的拡大・重篤性・渡航貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大も報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・承認された治療法がないブンディブギョウイルスによる流行であり、致死率・拡大速度が過去最悪級とされている点は特に注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश में बढ़ जाता है लम्पी का खतरा, पशुओं को बचाने के लिए अपनाएं ये आसान देसी उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of lumpy skin disease increases during the rainy season; adopt these easy home remedies to protect livestock.
article.articleSummary: Rainy-season onset raises infectious-disease risk for livestock, with Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) becoming a major concern due to potential heavy economic losses for farmers. The article urges preventive action rather than waiting for an outbreak. Key measures include ensuring cleanliness, timely vaccination, deworming, and the adoption of simple home remedies to keep animals safer. Livestock expert and gold-medalist Dr. Sushma Suman stresses that extra vigilance during the monsoon can substantially reduce LSD and other diseases. No laboratory-confirmation details or case counts are provided. The guidance aims to protect animal health and farmer livelihoods by proactive care during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季にランピースキン病のリスクが増加、家畜を守るための簡単な家庭療法を採用しよう
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は季節性の予防啓発情報であり、具体的な発生報告や症例数の記載がなく、動物疾患であり人への公衆衛生影響も示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発を目的とした一般情報であり、具体的な発生地域や症例報告がないため、対象国としての確定は困難。家畜の疾患であり、ヒトへの感染性は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: التفشي الأسرع انتشارا إيبولا يقضي على مصاب كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak is killing a patient every 30 minutes in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is killing about one person every 30 minutes, according to Tom Fletcher, United Nations Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator. He described the outbreak as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record and urged a faster, broader international response and greater solidarity to stop the virus's advance. The UN official emphasized the need for speed and an expanded, coordinated response to curb the crisis. The statement highlights the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the urgency of international coordination. This marks the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record and has drawn calls for rapid action from international communities.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行、コンゴで30分に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 国連高官が史上最速の拡大と評するエボラ流行であり、重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが高くIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 国連人道問題調整官(OCHA)トップによる公式声明で、致死率・拡大速度ともに過去最悪水準と報告されている。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: FN: Ebolaudbrud i DR Congo koster et menneske livet hver halve time
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo costs a life every half hour.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is costing roughly one life every 30 minutes. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher described the situation in a Friday statement cited by AFP, noting a rapidly growing outbreak that has prompted the UN to step up its response. The article does not provide current case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or information on infection sources or imported/exported cases. The account stresses the escalating toll and the urgent need for intensified public health measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行、30分に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大と高い死亡率が国連高官により言及されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数や検査確定情報は記事に記載されておらず、続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Đàn chó nghi mắc dại cắn liên tiếp 6 người dân
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A pack of dogs suspected of rabies bites six locals in quick succession.
article.articleSummary: Rabies suspected in Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam, after six residents were exposed to a litter of unvaccinated dogs from two families in Thanh Huong village, Thanh Quan commune. Since late July 2026, the five-dog group sharing a mother two months old showed abnormal behavior. On August 12, a white dog bit several people and later died after drooling and reduced appetite; another dog in the litter became aggressive and, after relocation, continued to bite a owner, children, and a neighbor. Health authorities suspect rabies in the dogs; six people are at risk due to bites or handling saliva from the animals. Immediate response included wound care guidance, rabies prophylaxis, and vaccination; exposed individuals are stable and under home observation. One dog escaped confinement, keeping ongoing exposure risk. Authorities are disinfecting the area, controlling animals, and expanding vaccination for dogs and cats; residents urged to vaccinate pets and seek PEP promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病感染疑いの野犬群が住民6人を相次いで咬む
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの一地域で発生した犬の狂犬病疑い事例で、曝露者は暴露後発症予防（PEP）を受け安定しているが、逃走した犬による継続的な曝露リスクがあり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで流行地域であり、地方レベルの通常対応（PEP、ワクチン接種拡大、動物隔離）が行われている。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。逃走した犬の状況次第で継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: FN: Ebolaudbrud i DR Congo koster et menneske livet hver halve time
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo costs a human life every half hour.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing on record, with at least 2,128 deaths and more than 4,500 confirmed infections since May 15. The transmission is active across six provinces in DR Congo and in neighboring Uganda. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher warns the virus is 'winning' unless a faster, larger-scale, more coordinated response is mounted, noting a death every 30 minutes. WHO and Africa CDC have warned the outbreak could become the deadliest to date. Donors have contributed nearly $300 million, with an additional $30.5 million allocated by a UN fund. About 20 more staff were dispatched; authorities emphasize the need to double safe-burial teams, triple treatment capacity, expand contact tracing, and deploy more experienced leaders. A major obstacle is the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、30分ごとに1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数(深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大)に該当し、隣国ウガンダへの越境伝播とワクチン未承認の変異株による深刻な公衆衛生危機であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに存在しないためverified_locationsから除外。史上最速拡大かつ最多死亡者数となる可能性がWHO/Africa CDCにより指摘されており、Bundibugyo変異株にはワクチン・治療法が未承認である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: التفشي الأسرع انتشارا.. إيبولا يقضي على مصاب كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fastest-spreading outbreak... Ebola kills a patient every 30 minutes in the Congo - Al-Ahli Stadium
article.articleSummary: Since the Ebola outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15, the disease has killed at least 2,128 people among more than 4,500 cases, with UN officials warning it could become the deadliest in history. The 17th Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak is spreading across six DRC provinces and into Uganda, with cases near the South Sudan border. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever and is transmitted via contact with infected body fluids; there is no known cure or vaccine for this strain. Frontline responses emphasize safe burials, tripling treatment capacity, expanding contact tracing, and deploying more experienced managers. Donor support totals about $300 million, plus $30.5 million from the UN emergency fund added to $24 million previously allocated for DRC and four other countries. By contrast, the 2018–2020 outbreak killed about 2,300 people from 3,500 infections.

triage.headline_ja: 最速で拡大する流行…エボラ出血熱がコンゴで30分ごとに患者の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ型)のアウトブレイクが発生し、死者2,128人・症例4,500人超と深刻で、ウガンダや南スーダン国境地域への拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは記事で言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。国際的な資金支援(UN緊急基金、ドナー拠出約3億ドル)が既に投入されており、致死率も高い深刻な流行。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC urges urgent vaccine deployment as Ebola outbreak spreads across DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, Africa CDC urges immediate Ervebo deployment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to counter a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak that has expanded to six provinces. DR Congo reports 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths (CFR 46.8%), with 965 recoveries. Ituri remains the main epicenter; Bas-Uele’s Buta has been added, totaling 54 affected health zones across Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo. The outbreak began May 15 after Bundibugyo ebolavirus was identified. Ervebo—WHO-prequalified, single-dose vaccine for Zaire ebolavirus—is considered for emergency use despite no strain-specific license, given possible cross-protection. The DRC requests 100,000 doses from the ICG to support trials and protect high-risk groups, including contacts, healthcare workers and burial teams. The plan followed a Kinshasa crisis meeting with President Tshisekedi, Africa CDC head Kaseya, and WHO Director-General Tedros.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、DRコンゴ全土に拡大するエボラ流行に対しワクチンの緊急展開を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行(4,665症例、致死率46.8%)が6州に拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心・支援要請も明確なため。
triage.notes: 大統領・Africa CDC長官・WHO事務局長が参加する危機会議が開催されるなど、国際的・政治的関与が非常に高い事例。ICGへの10万回分のワクチン要請も含め、フルリスク評価が必要。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Can H1N1 Trigger Heart Problems? Cardiologist Explains Risks As Delhi Cases Surge
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,449 H1N1 influenza cases this year up to Aug 12, a six-fold rise from 229 cases in the same period in 2025 (NCDC). H1N1, swine flu, primarily respiratory but can strain the cardiovascular system, especially in older adults and those with heart disease. Fever, dehydration, tachycardia, and hypoxemia during infection increase myocardial workload. Myocarditis is a potential but uncommon complication, presenting with chest pain, breathlessness, fatigue, palpitations, or rapid/irregular heartbeat; severe cases can cause heart failure or dangerous arrhythmias. Influenza can transiently raise heart attack risk in the weeks after infection due to systemic inflammation and clotting. High-risk individuals—coronary artery disease, heart failure, hypertension, diabetes—should monitor for cardiac symptoms and seek prompt care for chest pain, dyspnea, or syncope. Vaccination remains a key preventive measure, especially for those with cardiovascular disease, as Delhi’s H1N1 surge continues.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1は心臓疾患を引き起こすか？デリーの症例急増を受け、循環器専門医がリスクを解説
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1症例が前年同期比6倍に急増していると国立疾病管理センター(NCDC)のデータで報告されており、季節性インフルエンザとしては異常な増加率であるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は主に心臓疾患患者向けの健康アドバイス記事だが、NCDCによる症例数急増（229件→1,449件、6倍）という具体的データが含まれており、デリー地域での流行状況として注視が必要。重症度や死亡数についての具体的記載はなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Minsa prórroga por 90 días la Emergencia Sanitaria por brote de sarampión para reforzar acciones de prevención y control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health extends Public Health Emergency for 90 days due to measles outbreak to reinforce prevention and control measures.
article.articleSummary: Peru extends the 90-day Public Health Emergency for measles with local transmission confirmed in Puno and elevated spread risk in the Lima Metropolitan Region and the Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, Apurímac, and Callao areas. Supreme Decree 013-2026-SA extends the emergency from August 15, 2026. By epidemiological week 30-2026, measles cases were identified in 40 provinces and 118 districts; Puno accounts for 32.5% of active transmission. About 83.9% of affected districts are in four jurisdictions: Puno (52), Arequipa (21), Cusco (14), and Lima Region (12). Forty-five districts have transmission lasting more than four weeks; ten districts, mainly in Puno, have persistence over 12 weeks. Over the 90 days, the Ministry will continue the action plan, surveillance, prevention and control, case care, and procurement for the emergency. Vaccination remains the primary prevention tool; parents should verify two-dose completion and seek care for fever and rash.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、麻疹アウトブレイクによる公衆衛生緊急事態を90日間延長し予防・対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ペルーで麻疹が40県118地区に拡大し、複数地域で12週間以上の持続的伝播が続くなど深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事態であり、政府が緊急事態を延長するなど公的対応が強化されている。
triage.notes: 本イベントはペルー（対象国リスト外）で発生しており、ブラジルは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文中で言及がないため verified_locations には含めない。麻疹の広域・長期的な地域内伝播という性質上、モニタリング対象国への波及可能性を含め継続的な注視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 河南一传染病医院被淹 周口卫健委：院内405人安全转移
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An infectious disease hospital in Henan flooded; Zhoukou Health Commission says 405 people inside the hospital were safely evacuated.
article.articleSummary: Heavy rains and upstream floodwaters breached the Jialu River's east-bank dike in Zhoukou, Henan, on Aug 13, flooding the city's sole infectious disease hospital, Zhoukou Fifth People's Hospital. The facility, which houses the TB prevention institute and serves as the city's clinical center for tuberculosis, liver disease, and AIDS, had 405 people inside evacuated safely by Aug 14, 11:00. Of these, 18 critically ill patients were transferred to Zhoukou Central Hospital; others relocated to Zhoukou Central Hospital, Chu Hui District North Community Health Service Center, and Zhoukou Eye Hospital. The breach extended about 30 meters near New North Ring Bridge, with water depths up to 1.5 meters inside the campus. The Ministry of Emergency Management dispatched 200 personnel and 110 large engineering machines; they arrived by 10:00 on Aug 14 to assist evacuation and relief.

triage.headline_ja: 河南省の伝染病専門病院が浸水、周口市衛生健康委員会は院内405人が無事避難したと発表
triage.triage_reason: 洪水による病院施設の被災・避難事案であり、結核など感染症自体のアウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大は報告されていない。人的被害もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されない。
triage.notes: 本事案は自然災害（洪水）による医療施設の被災・患者避難に関する報道であり、結核の感染拡大や公衆衛生危機を示す内容ではない。避難は迅速に完了し、政府による対応も適切に行われている。感染症サーベイランスの観点からは低優先度。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: "إيبولا" يقضي على مصاب كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: Ebola is killing a patient every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to escalate, with UN Humanitarian Affairs Chief Tom Fletcher warning the outbreak is killing about one person every 30 minutes as of August 15, 2026. The statement comes as the epidemic—started May 15—has surpassed 4,500 reported cases and at least 2,128 deaths, making it the fastest-spreading and one of the deadliest on record. Ebola is transmitted through contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever and high fever. UN officials urge accelerated, expanded response and greater international solidarity to prevent further spread. Donations amounting to roughly $300 million have been pledged to a fund dedicated to combating the outbreak. The focus remains on rapid containment, risk communication, and protecting health workers and communities in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で30分ごとに1人の命を奪っている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、致死率も高く4500例超・死者2128人に達しており、国際的懸念と支援が既に動いている重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 国連高官による公式声明と3億ドル規模の国際的資金拠出が既に行われており、史上最速・最悪クラスの流行とされる。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情升溫 聯合國：每30分鐘奪1命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies; UN says one person dies every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) intensifies as UN warns the virus now claims a life every 30 minutes. Since its May 15 declaration, confirmed cases have surpassed 4,500 with at least 2,128 deaths, marking the deadliest Ebola outbreak on record. The Bundibugyo virus is the cause, transmitted through contact with bodily fluids and causing hemorrhagic fever; there is no approved treatment or vaccine. This is DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, spreading across six provinces near Uganda and South Sudan borders. In response, about 20 frontline staff have been dispatched, but more personnel are needed. Burial teams must double, treatment capacity triple, and contact tracing strengthen, alongside expanded management staff. Donor nations have contributed nearly $300 million; the UN Emergency Fund has allocated an additional $30.5 million, plus $24 million previously disbursed, to DRC and four other countries. Basic water, sanitation, medical care needs are urgent.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ出血熱の感染拡大 国連「30分に1人死亡」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行(確定症例4,500超、死者2,128人)が拡大中で、複数州・国境地帯に及び国際支援が要請されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは国境地域として言及されているが、記事主題はDRC国内の流行であるため、対象国リストにあるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた（ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれない）。史上最悪規模のエボラ流行として国際的関心が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sete regiões mantêm alto risco para dengue em Cuiabá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven Regions Remain at High Risk for Dengue in Cuiabá
article.articleSummary: Seven of 27 regions remain high risk for dengue, Zika and chikungunya transmitted by Aedes aegypti in Cuiabá, Brazil, per the 2nd LIRAa 2026 (May 26–29). Of 27 strata, seven high, 18 medium, two low; average IIP 3.4%—down from the year's first survey but not low-risk. North is the most affected at 7% infestation, followed by South at 6.4% and East at 5.9%. High risk defined as >3.9%, low risk <1%. Health Secretary Deisi Bocalon notes the overall improvement but ongoing concerns, urging residents to inspect interiors and surroundings, keep water tanks closed, clean gutters, and discard waste to prevent breeding. Since 2026 began, 673,856 property inspections, 72,284 treated sites, 81,080 larvicide applications, and 19,398 potential breeding sites eliminated. Despite actions, 25 of 27 strata remain medium or high.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバ市内7地域でデング熱の高リスクが継続
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・クイアバ市における例年実施されている蚊媒介感染症（デング・ジカ・チクングニア）のLIRAa定期サーベイランス報告であり、異常事態や重症例の急増等の記載はなく、通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 地域保健当局による蚊指数（LIRAa）調査結果の定期報告。症例数・死亡者数の具体的記載はなく、季節的・恒常的なベクター対策活動の一環と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में चांदीपुरा वायरस का बढ़ा खतरा, अब तक 27 की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising threat of Chandipura virus in Gujarat; 27 dead so far.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat continues with 41 laboratory-confirmed cases and 27 deaths since surveillance began on June 30. As of August 14, 5 PM, 257 suspected cases have been recorded; 246 samples tested, 11 awaiting results. Earlier data (July 21) showed 63 suspected, 12 confirmed, and 8 pending. Chandipura virus causes Acute Encephalitis Syndrome and predominantly affects children, transmitted by sandflies; there is no specific antiviral treatment or vaccine. Symptoms can escalate rapidly to high fever, vomiting, seizures, and neurological signs. Public health responses include intensified door-to-door surveillance, vector control around homes and animal shelters, insecticide spraying, sanitation drives, and awareness campaigns. Emphasis remains on reducing sandfly contact through full-body coverage, bed nets, repellents, and environmental cleanup. No information on imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスの脅威拡大、これまでに27人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 確定41例中27例死亡と致死率が非常に高く、小児を中心に急速進行する脳炎症候群であり、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介性で特異的治療薬・ワクチンがなく、致死率が高い。継続的な監視とベクター対策が実施されているが、国際的拡大の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يلتهم الكونغو الديموقراطية: حالة وفاة كل 30 دقيقة والأمم المتحدة تحذر من التفشي الأسرع في التاريخ - جنوبية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a death every 30 minutes, and the United Nations warns of the fastest-spreading outbreak in history - Southern.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is raging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with UN officials warning of the fastest-spreading, deadliest outbreak yet, killing someone every 30 minutes (roughly 48 deaths per day). The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved treatment or vaccine, and it causes hemorrhagic fever. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids. International response includes about $300 million in donor funding for the outbreak response, plus $30.5 million newly allocated from the UN emergency fund, joining $24 million already spent. An additional 20 field staff will be deployed to frontline efforts. The article underscores urgent, expanded international action to contain the humanitarian crisis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国を席巻:30分ごとに1人が死亡、国連は史上最速の感染拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: 国連が史上最速拡大と警告するエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクであり、致死性・国際的懸念・大規模な国際支援が確認されるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による第17次DRCアウトブレイク。国連緊急基金及び多額の国際支援投入中で、フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: FN: Ebolaudbrud i DR Congo koster et menneske livet hver hal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo costs a life every half hour.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo costs a life every 30 minutes, according to UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher in a statement cited by AFP. "The outbreak is the fastest-growing we have ever recorded," Fletcher said. He added: "We need ..." though the sentence is incomplete in the source. The report emphasizes the accelerating toll and ongoing international concern as responders race to contain transmission. The article identifies Ebola as the disease and DR Congo as the affected location, without providing further counts or laboratory details. The report highlights an ongoing public health emergency in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、30分ごとに1人の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: 国連高官が「史上最速の拡大」と表明したエボラ流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生への影響と国際的関心が明確に確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数のデータは記事に記載なし。国連高官の発言のみで詳細情報は続報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: ‫ الأمم المتحدة تؤكد وفاة شخص بالإيبولا كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations confirms a death from Ebola every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading rapidly, with the UN warning that a death occurs about every 30 minutes. Since the outbreak began on May 15, more than 4,500 infections and at least 2,128 deaths have been reported, as cases spread across six Congolese provinces and into neighboring Uganda, near the South Sudan border. UN officials say the outbreak is the fastest-spreading and could become the deadliest in the disease's history. Global assistance includes $30.5 million in new Emergency Relief Fund allocations, joining $24 million already earmarked for DRC and four other countries. The UN has sent 20 more frontline staff and calls for expanded safe and dignified burials, triple treatment capacity, stronger contact tracing, and more experienced managers. Emphasis is placed on water, sanitation, health care, and essential services in the impacted region.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより30分に1人が死亡していると確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで急速に拡大するエボラ流行が6州とウガンダにまで広がり、死者2,128人・感染4,500人超と深刻。国際緊急援助も動員されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大も報じられているが、両国はGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主題国として明確に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Dompu Terima 3.000 Dosis Vaksin Rabies dari Pemerintah Pusat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dompu Receives 3,000 Doses of Rabies Vaccine from the Central Government.
article.articleSummary: Dompu Regency, West Nusa Tenggara, received 3,000 rabies vaccine doses from the central government in 2026 to counter dog-mediated rabies. The dog population (HPR) is about 10,000, so 3,000 doses yield roughly 30% coverage, well below the 70% target for community protection. Execution is hampered by lack of on-ground funding despite vaccine supply; cross-sector collaboration and local budget support are needed to maximise vaccination. Behavioral challenges hinder control, as many owners let roaming dogs persist after harvest and must confine and provide medical care. In addition to vaccination, authorities monitor and control stray or symptomatic HPR per animal health protocols. Upstream urgency is underscored by 488 dog-bite cases recorded through July 2026; all victims received clinical care at puskesmas, including wound cleaning and human rabies vaccine, highlighting the need for population management and multi-agency community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: ドンプ県、中央政府から狂犬病ワクチン3,000回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は既知の風土病的課題であり突発的異常事態ではないが、ワクチン接種率が目標を大きく下回り咬傷例が多数報告されているため、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は地域内で継続的な風土病であり、ワクチン接種率不足（目標70%に対し約30%）と咬傷例488件（7月時点）が報告されているが、死亡例や異常な流行パターンの報告はない。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: ദില്ലിയിൽ കുട്ടികളിൽ എച്ച്1എൻ1 കേസുകൾ വർദ്ധിക്കുന്നു ; രക്ഷിതാക്കൾ ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ട കാര്യങ്ങൾ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Delhi, H1N1 cases among children are increasing; what parents should watch out for.
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports rising H1N1 influenza cases among children; as of August 15, 2026, 1,449 cases have been recorded, a sixfold increase from 229 cases in the same period last year (NCDC). Among those tested for influenza, about one in three are confirmed positive for H1N1 (Influenza A). Dr. Vandan Garg, Director of Internal Medicine at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Vaishali, Ghaziabad, notes that H1N1 is the swine flu variant of Influenza A, spread through respiratory secretions, and typically causes sudden high fever, cough, body aches, and fatigue. While most recover completely, very young children, pregnant women, and the elderly are at higher risk. Preventive measures include child vaccination, good hand hygiene, and staying home if symptomatic. The article emphasizes vigilance among parents in Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで子どものH1N1（インフルエンザA）感染例が増加；保護者が注意すべき点
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1症例が前年比6倍に増加しているが、H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザであり重症度や国際的拡大の明確な兆候はないため、フルRRAには至らないが動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザの一種であり、インドでは毎年一定数の症例が報告される。今回は前年同期比で顕著な増加が見られるため、続報や重症度・死亡例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DRC spreads to 6th province as cases surpass 4 500
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to six provinces in the northeast, with 4,500 cases and more than 2,100 deaths since mid-May. A new Bas-Uele case involved a man who travelled from an affected province to the provincial capital, Buta, where he died, confirming Bas-Uele as the sixth affected province. The outbreak’s epicentre remains Ituri, where insecurity and displacement hinder response activities. Community mistrust and refusal to follow health guidelines are limiting case reporting and timely isolation. The World Health Organization urges intensified community engagement to improve detection and response. The virus circulating is the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Nevertheless, UK and Canadian researchers are running clinical vaccine trials that have shown preliminary signs of reducing deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、第6州に拡大し症例数4500例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目(深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク)に該当し、WPRO基準も全項目該当する重大な公衆衛生上のシグナルであるため、フルRRAへ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: Bas-UeleおよびIturiはDRC国内のADM1地域であり、発生国としてはDRCのみを計上。承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行であり、治安不安・住民の不信感が対応を阻害している点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تؤكد وفاة شخص بالإيبولا كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations confirms a death from Ebola every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola drives the fastest-spreading outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the UN announcing a death every 30 minutes as of August 15, 2026. Since the May 15 declaration, over 4,500 infections and at least 2,128 deaths have occurred. The outbreak is active in six Congolese provinces and has spilled into Uganda, with cases near the South Sudan border. The UN warns it could become the deadliest Ebola epidemic and urges a substantially expanded international response, including more safe-burial teams, triple treatment capacity, and intensified contact tracing and leadership. Donations of about $300 million have been pledged to a dedicated fund, and the UN Emergency Fund has allocated $54.5 million ($30.5m added to $24m) to support the DRC and four other countries. Authorities emphasize urgent needs for water, sanitation, and health services. Twenty additional frontline staff were dispatched, with calls for further scaling.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国で30分ごとにエボラによる死亡が発生していると発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行(感染4,500人超、死亡2,128人以上)がウガンダにも越境し、国連が過去最悪の流行になる可能性を警告し国際支援拡大を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主要な発生国として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: فيروس إيبولا يقضي على مصاب كل ثلاثين دقيقة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: The Ebola virus kills an infected person every thirty minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is killing about one person every 30 minutes. As of August 15, 2026, there have been 2,128 deaths among more than 4,500 cases since the outbreak was declared on May 15, making it the fastest-spreading, potentially deadliest outbreak to date. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no proven treatment or vaccine. Infections have been reported in six DR Congo provinces, with cases in Uganda and near the South Sudan border. UN humanitarian chief Tom G. Fletcher called for urgent, expanded action, including safer burials, boosted treatment capacity, and improved contact tracing. Donors have given roughly $300 million to an Ebola response fund; the UN Emergency Fund added $30.5 million, alongside $24 million previously allocated for DR Congo and four other countries. Twenty extra frontline staff were deployed. Past Ebola outbreaks in Africa killed over 15,000; the 2018–2020 outbreak killed about 2,300 of 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスが30分に1人の割合で感染者の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2128人の死者・4500人超の症例を伴う急速拡大中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行があり、ウガンダや南スーダン国境付近にも感染が及び、有効な治療法・ワクチンがないため国際的関心と支援が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダン国境付近での感染も報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による過去最速・最悪級の流行とされ、国際的な資金・人員支援が既に行われている。

article.articleHeadline: ΟΗΕ: Ένας άνθρωπος πεθαίνει κάθε 30 λεπτά από έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: One person dies every 30 minutes from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to worsen: 4,556 confirmed cases and 2,128 deaths in about three months, with a death every 30 minutes cited by UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Frieden. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is responsible. On May 15, the DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak; two days later WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The current outbreak is the deadliest in DR Congo's history since 2018–2020, which killed nearly 2,300 of about 3,500 cases. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, though clinical trials are ongoing. Response funding remains inadequate: CERF allocated $30.5 million in addition to $24 million already earmarked for DRC and four neighbors; Africa CDC has secured $264 million of the $518 million needed. Twenty more frontline staff were deployed as part of a broader mobilization.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により30分に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで致死率・死者数が極めて高く、ワクチン・治療法未確立かつ国際支援が必要な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言しており、2018-2020年の流行を上回る史上最悪の規模とされる。資金不足が続いており、国際的な支援拡大が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Covid returns to capital as 50-yr-old man tests positive
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 returns to Odisha’s capital Bhubaneswar as a 50-year-old man from Baramunda tests positive, the first case in the city this year, with treatment in an isolation ward. This marks the second Covid-19 case detected in Odisha within a month, following a 54-year-old woman from Purushottampur in Ganjam district who tested positive on 22 July and was admitted to MKCG Medical College and Hospital in Berhampur. Health officials urged calm and precautionary measures. The department had asked hospitals to promptly share Covid-19 information and, in July, called for ready isolation facilities, heightened surveillance, and rapid response teams in districts bordering Andhra Pradesh after detections there.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19が州都に再来、50歳男性が陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 単発の散発例で重症化や集団感染の情報がなく、既存の対応体制内で管理されているため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: オディシャ州で1ヶ月以内に2例目のCOVID-19散発例。地元当局はサーベイランス強化と隔離施設準備を実施済みで、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Exhausted health workers in Congo struggle to keep up as Ebola...
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Ituri province, eastern Congo, centered in Nizi, has surpassed 4,700 cases with over 2,200 deaths as of mid-August 2026, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. Surveillance struggles, with 60–70% of new infections detected among people not previously monitored as contacts, hinder containment. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo; trials are underway. Strains on the response include unpaid workers leading to a strike that temporarily closed the Nizi Treatment Center, and frontline staff reporting a lack of protective gear, often buying disinfectant with personal funds. The UN has released $30.5 million in emergency funding. Insecurity, rebel activity, mining-driven population movement, and poor roads impede reach; some areas are inaccessible, and attacks on health facilities have occurred. Ituri accounts for roughly 90% of Congo’s cases and 80% of deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで疲弊する医療従事者、エボラの拡大に接触者追跡が追いつかず
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡大とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行で、4700例超・死者2200人超、承認済みワクチン/治療薬なし、国際支援も投入されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株による過去最速拡大の流行であり、治安悪化・接触者追跡の破綻・医療従事者のストライキなど対応能力の限界が示唆される。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 每30分鐘死1人！　聯合國：民主剛果伊波拉疫情「正在失控」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One person dies every 30 minutes! United Nations: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is expanding at an unprecedented pace. As of 2026-08-15, cumulative deaths exceed 2,128 and confirmed cases surpass 4,500 across six provinces; cross-border cases have emerged in Uganda and South Sudan. The outbreak began when the DRC declared it on May 15. There is no effective therapy or vaccine for Bundibugyo virus. UN OCHA warns the situation is out of control, with an average death every 30 minutes. International pledges total about $300 million; the UN Emergency Fund has allocated $30.5 million, plus $24 million previously disbursed, to aid the DRC and four other affected countries (roughly $355 million in all). Frontline capacity remains strained: 20 additional personnel; burial teams must double, treatment capacity triple, and contact tracing strengthened, alongside improvements in water, sanitation, and basic medical services. Past outbreaks (2018–2020) caused nearly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 30分に1人死亡！　国連：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は「制御不能」状態
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）が制御不能な速度で拡大し、死者2,128人・感染者4,500人超、ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。有効な治療法・ワクチンが存在しないブンディブギョウイルスによる流行であり、国連が『制御不能』と警告する重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Ένας άνθρωπος πεθαίνει κάθε 30 λεπτά
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: One person dies every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with a death every 30 minutes. As of 2026-08-15, it has 2,128 deaths among 4,556 laboratory-confirmed cases, three months after the May 15 declaration as the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later. Health systems and resources remain stretched. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain yet, though clinical trials are underway. Frontline staff were boosted by 20 new deployments today. Funding includes an additional 30.5 million USD from CERF, atop 24 million USD already allocated to DRC and four neighboring countries. Africa CDC estimates 518 million USD is needed for the regional response but only 264 million is funded so far. Authorities urge rapid, large-scale action and solidarity to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱:30分ごとに1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（4,556症例、2,128死亡）であり、IHR基準の複数該当・国際支援の必要性が明確なため。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。致死率は約47%と非常に高く、資金不足（518百万USD必要に対し264百万USDのみ確保）が続いている。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株による流行。

article.articleHeadline: Bandung Jadi Tuan Rumah ACPID 2026, Lebih dari 1.000 Pakar Asia Berkolaborasi Hadapi Ancaman Infeksi Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bandung to Host ACPID 2026, More Than 1,000 Asian Experts Collaborate to Tackle Threats Posed by Pediatric Infections.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia hosted the 12th Asian Congress of Pediatric Infectious Diseases (ACPID) in Bandung, West Java, August 14–16, 2026, alongside the Annual Scientific Meeting on Pediatric Infectious Diseases (ASMPID) at Trans Hotel & Convention Center. More than 1,000 participants from across Asia attended. Organized by the Indonesian Pediatric Society (IDAI) with the Asian Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases (ASPID), ACPID 2026 aims to build regional resilience against pediatric infections by formulating strategic responses to vaccine‑preventable diseases (VPD), neglected tropical diseases (NTD), emerging/re-emerging infections, and antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Four interactive workshops addressed severe dengue fever, HIV in children, infection management in cancer patients, and congenital syphilis. Beyond medicine, the program stresses integrated national immunization programs and One Health, with IDAI West Java collaborating with local health authorities to boost complete immunization coverage.

triage.headline_ja: バンドン、ACPID 2026のホスト都市に、1,000人以上のアジア専門家が小児感染症の脅威に対処するため協力
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学会・会議開催の告知であり、具体的な感染症のアウトブレイクや症例急増を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術会議（ACPID 2026）の開催報告であり、デング熱・HIV・先天性梅毒などは会議のワークショップテーマとして言及されているのみで、実際の発生・流行事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: खांसी-बुखार को न करें नजरअंदाज, दिल्ली में बढ़ रहे स्वाइन फ्लू के मरीज, डॉक्टर से जानिए कैसे करें बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore cough and fever; swine flu cases are rising in Delhi—learn from doctors how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu cases are rising in Delhi amid monsoon and cooler weather, according to doctors. Environmental conditions such as temperature changes, crowding, and exposure to an infected person facilitate transmission; testing increases reported cases. Key symptoms include high fever (sometimes up to 102–104°F), chills, sore throat, body and head pain, weakness, and shortness of breath. Early home rest may be advised for mild cases, but medical guidance is essential as the disease can resemble common cold/flu initially. High-risk groups include children, seniors over 60, diabetics, asthma or tuberculosis patients, current or former smokers with lung disease, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities or immunosuppression. In Delhi, hospitals have dedicated respiratory medicine OPDs/wards and ventilator facilities. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, mask-wearing, and covering coughs; continue COVID-era precautions. Seek urgent care if shortness of breath or deterioration occurs.

triage.headline_ja: 咳や発熱を軽視しないで、デリーで豚インフルエンザの患者が増加中—医師が予防法を解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）症例増加に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報は乏しいが、季節的な増加傾向は継続監視の対象となる。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1亜型）のデリーにおける増加を伝える一般向け医療啓発記事。既存の医療体制内で対応可能とされ、緊急のリスク評価対象とは考えにくいが、季節的傾向として経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: ΟΗΕ: Ο Έμπολα σκοτώνει έναν άνθρωπο κάθε 30 λεπτά στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Ebola is killing one person every 30 minutes in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is killing about one person every 30 minutes, per UN humanitarian affairs chief. In roughly three months since the May 15 declaration, the DRC reports 2,128 deaths among 4,556 laboratory-confirmed cases as the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country spreads, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days after the outbreak’s proclamation. The health response is strained by resource constraints in a very poor country. Frontline capacity was boosted with 20 more staff, and an additional $30.5 million from CERF was allocated, on top of $24 million already provided to DRC and four neighboring nations. The Africa CDC plan requires about $518 million, with only about $264 million funded. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain yet; clinical trials are underway. Ebola has killed at least 15,000 people in Africa over the last 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴでエボラが30分に1人の割合で死者を出している
triage.triage_reason: DRCでPHEIC宣言済みのエボラ第17次流行が拡大中で、致死率も高く、国際支援が必要な深刻な公衆衛生上の危機であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOはこの流行発生2日後にPHEICを宣言済み。ワクチン・治療法が未確立のBundibugyo株であり、資金不足も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Destina EEUU 242 mdd para combatir ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US allocates $242 million to combat Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: United States allocates more than $242 million to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), bringing total direct U.S. funding for the response to over $500 million as Washington remains the leading international contributor. The move coincides with a visit by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who warned of the outbreak’s progression and urged a strengthened response. The DRC declared its seventeenth Ebola outbreak on May 15, in a nation with over 100 million people. Authorities report 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths since the start of the outbreak. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted through close contact and bodily fluids; there is no vaccine or approved treatment for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak. The U.S. has travel restrictions for travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and bars U.S. citizens from returning directly from the DRC; Uganda’s measures to curb spread are noted. Washington urged others to increase contributions, while criticisms targeted travel bans and a Kenyan quarantine center.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴのエボラ対策に2億4200万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が進行中で、確定症例3,874例・死亡1,751例と規模が大きく、国際的な資金拠出・渡航制限・WHO事務局長の現地訪問など国際的関心も高いため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域には米国・スーダン・ケニア・ウガンダも含まれるが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行であり、米国は資金拠出国、ケニア・ウガンダは渡航制限や検疫対応の文脈で言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : l'épidémie s'étend à une sixième province sur fond de risque de transmission prolongée (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: The outbreak is spreading to a sixth province amid a backdrop of prolonged transmission risk (GENERAL ARTICLE).
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has spread to a sixth province, with 4,727 confirmed cases and 2,214 deaths, now spanning 55 health zones across Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo. The Buta zone in Bas-Uele joined after a traveler from Isiro (Haut-Uele) moved there and died. Ituri remains the epicenter; 976 recoveries have been reported. Community transmission is the main challenge, with over 63% of deaths occurring in communities rather than treatment centers, complicating tracing and safe burials. Official contact-tracing coverage is 82.6%, but CDC Africa cautions this does not by itself measure effectiveness if many contacts are not identified early. The outbreak could last up to a year; WHO and CDC Africa warn it may become the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever, potentially surpassing 2014–2016 West Africa. Retrospective village investigations aim to map earlier transmission from January.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ:感染拡大が6番目の州に及ぶ、長期化する感染リスクを背景に(総合記事)
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が6州55保健地区に拡大し、確定症例4,727例・死亡2,214例に達しており、WHO/CDC Africaが史上2番目の規模となる可能性を警告するなど、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの全てでIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: WHO・CDC Africaが2014-2016西アフリカ流行を超える規模になる可能性を警告しており、既にフルリスク評価対象として継続監視・介入が必要な段階にある。コミュニティ内死亡が63%超を占め接触者追跡の実効性に懸念があり、今後1年続く可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Ένας άνθρωπος πεθαίνει κάθε 30 λεπτά σύμφωνα με τον ΟΗΕ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: One person dies every 30 minutes according to the UN.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is escalating, with the UN citing a death every 30 minutes. The DRC declared the 17th Ebola outbreak on 15 May, and the WHO followed with a public health emergency of international concern two days later. Three months after the declaration, at least 2,128 deaths have occurred among 4,556 laboratory-confirmed cases, as the outbreak spreads faster than any previously recorded. The most lethal Congo Ebola outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths in 3,500 cases. Financially, an additional 30.5 million USD was allocated from CERF atop 24 million already committed, while Africa CDC’s plan for 518 million remains only partially funded at 264 million. There is no vaccine or therapy for the Bundibugyo strain yet; clinical trials are underway. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher urged rapid, broad-scale action to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱：国連によれば30分ごとに1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、致死率・拡大速度ともに過去最悪水準で、IHR基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言済み。ワクチン・治療薬未確立のBundibugyo株による過去最速の感染拡大が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Η επιδημία του Έμπολα στοιχίζει τη ζωή σε έναν άνθρωπο κάθε 30 λεπτά, λέει ο ΟΗΕ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The Ebola epidemic claims a life every 30 minutes, says the UN.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused 2,184 deaths from over 4,660 cases (case fatality ~47%), with the outbreak declared on May 15 by national authorities. It is affecting six of 26 provinces, led by Ituri, which accounts for over 3,400 cases; Uganda reports 20 cases. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher warns the virus is killing about one person every 30 minutes and urges speed, scale, and solidarity. CERF has allocated an additional $30.5 million, on top of $24 million previously provided; OCHA has added 20 staff. Calls to double safe and dignified burials, triple treatment capacity, strengthen contact tracing, and deploy more experienced leadership. WFP will extend hot meals to treatment and isolation centers in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, as 2.6 million people in eastern DRC face severe hunger (over half in Ituri), with food funding only 25% funded.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ：エボラ流行で30分ごとに1人が死亡、国連が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が発生し、致死率約47%、6州に拡大しウガンダにも波及。国連が国際支援を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも20例報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。国連CERFによる追加資金拠出や食料支援不足など、人道危機の複合的側面も見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Ebola en RD Congo : un décès toutes les 30 minutes, l'épidémie s'étend à une 6e province
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus in DR Congo: one death every 30 minutes, the outbreak is spreading to a sixth province.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating, with a death roughly every 30 minutes as the outbreak spreads to a sixth province. UN OCHA humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher warned that the epidemic, declared May 15 as the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak, is the fastest ever and requires urgent mobilization. The current surge has killed more than 2,128 people and sickened about 4,566 confirmed cases, reported three months after the declaration. Health systems in the DRC, one of the world’s poorest, remain strained, prompting deployment of 20 additional frontline staff. CERF provides $30.5 million in extra support, atop $24 million previously allocated. For the Africa CDC–WHO joint plan, $518 million is needed, with only $264 million mobilized. No vaccine or specific treatment is available for the Bundibugyo variant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス:30分に1人が死亡、流行は第6州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大し、多数の死者・感染者を出しており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 史上最速とされる流行で、致死率が高く、ワクチン・特異的治療法がないBundibugyo株が原因。国際的な資金・人員支援が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Ο ιός έμπολα σκοτώνει έναν άνθρωπο ανά τριάντα λεπτά
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The Ebola virus kills one person every thirty minutes.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues at a deadly pace: about one death every 30 minutes, with 4,556 lab-confirmed cases and 2,128 deaths three months after the outbreak was declared. DRC declared the 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15; WHO later declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher called for rapid, large-scale action as health facilities in one of Africa’s poorest nations face resource shortages. About $54.5 million has been allocated for response: $30.5 million extra from CERF in addition to $24 million previously allocated to DRC and four neighboring countries. The Africa CDC plan needs $518 million but only $264 million is secured. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet; clinical trials are underway. Ebola has claimed at least 15,000 lives in Africa over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラウイルスが30分に1人の割合で人命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、致死率・拡大速度ともに深刻で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン・治療法未確立のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクで、資金不足が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolan har nått sjätte provins: "Viruset ligger före
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has reached the sixth province: "The virus is ahead."
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached a sixth province. Overall, 2,100 deaths have been confirmed and 4,500 infections identified, though actual figures may be higher. Healthcare workers say they are increasingly unable to keep pace with transmission and that contact tracing is deteriorating. WHO Africa head Yakub Janabi warned the virus is ahead of responders. Semafor reports the development, with AP corroborating mounting strain on health systems in the affected areas. The reports underscore the need for intensified international support. This expansion signals broader regional spread and greater strain on resources.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが第6の州に到達:「ウイルスが先行している」
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が第6州に拡大し、死者2,100人・感染4,500人と規模が大きく、封じ込め能力を超えているとの警告があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOアフリカ地域責任者による警告や複数メディア(Semafor, AP)による報道があり、国際支援の必要性が明示されている。続報でRRAへの移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: All 4Thrives players safe after food poisoning outbreak at PUBG Mobile World Cup
article.articleSummary: A food poisoning outbreak struck the PUBG Mobile World Cup 2026 Grand Finals in Paris, affecting around 20 players on Day 1. Four of six scheduled matches were completed before play was suspended; organizers said they are investigating the source with EWC and providing support to affected players. Pakistan's 4Thrives, owned by Walee Technologies and recently rebuilt, reported all players safe after taking lunch from home. Other teams affected included S2G Esports (Turkey), Tianba (China), and GodLike Esports (India); incidents involved vomiting and ambulances on site, with reports of possible hospitalisations. The illness appears limited to PUBG Mobile participants, with no similar symptoms among staff or participants in other Esports World Cup tournaments. Day 1 matches have been rescheduled; tickets for Aug 14 remained valid for Aug 15.

triage.headline_ja: PUBGモバイルワールドカップで発生した食中毒、4Thrivesの選手は全員無事
triage.triage_reason: パリで開催されたeスポーツ大会における食中毒（食品由来）事案であり、感染症のヒト-ヒト伝播リスクや国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 発生場所はフランス・パリのイベント会場であり、対象国リストにフランスは含まれない。影響を受けた選手の国籍（パキスタン、トルコ、中国、インド）は発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。食中毒事案であり感染症シグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Is Now the Second Largest on Record
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak now stands at 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths as of 14 August 2026, making it the second-largest on record and, per WHO, the fastest-moving. Case fatality runs about 46%, with several hundred in care. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no vaccine for this strain exists. Genomic sequencing shows circulation since February, implying two to three months of unobserved spread. It has reached Bas-Uele, the sixth province, on 13 August; previously Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo were affected. Ituri accounts for about 86% of cases and 80% of deaths, with active transmission around Bunia. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in first-in-human trials; none available yet. WHO advisers consider Ervebo for a trial in DRC, while cross-border spread toward Uganda and mobility along cobalt corridors complicate containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、記録上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: 確定4,665例・死亡2,184例（致死率約46%）で史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大とWHOが評価。ワクチン未存在のブンディブギョ株が6州に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境リスクも指摘されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大懸念が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン未承認株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による流行で、2種の候補ワクチンが初回ヒト試験中、Ervebo試験も検討中。

article.articleHeadline: Ανησυχία στον ΟΗΕ για την εξάπλωση του Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: "Ένας άνθρωπος πεθαίνει κάθε 30 λεπτά"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN expresses concern over the spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: "One person dies every 30 minutes".
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, with WHO and UN officials warning of rapid spread. The DRC declared the 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15; WHO followed with a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later. Three months on, 4,556 lab-confirmed cases and 2,128 deaths have been reported; authorities note the virus is propagating more quickly than any prior outbreak, with a death toll averaging about one person every 30 minutes. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine or treatment; clinical trials are underway. The 2018–2020 outbreak remains the deadliest on record (≈2,300 deaths, ~3,500 cases). UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher called for urgent international action, announcing 30.5 million USD in CERF funds (in addition to 24 million already allocated) to support the response. Africa CDC's plan requires 518 million USD; funding so far stands at 264 million.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴでのエボラ拡大に懸念表明:「30分ごとに1人が死亡」
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行で、致死率・拡大速度ともに過去最悪級であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言しており、過去最悪の流行を超える規模で拡大中。国際的な資金・支援要請が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Trabajadores de salud exhaustos en Congo no dan abasto mientras el ébola supera rastreo de contactos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health workers exhausted in Congo can't keep up as Ebola outpaces contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo virus in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is overwhelming health workers in Nizi, Ituri province. The cumulative tally exceeds 4,700 cases and 2,200 deaths, with fatalities accelerating about three times faster than the 2014–16 West Africa epidemic. Surveillance lags as 60–70% of new infections are identified among people not previously monitored as contacts, allowing transmission before case finding. Community health workers, including Gédéon Banga Ngbape and Ana Ndroy Kasime, conduct door-to-door investigations but face daily brutality: long hours, limited personal protective equipment, and underfunded salaries; Nizi’s treatment center staff have struck over unpaid wages for months. There are no licensed vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola, though trials are underway. The outbreak is worsened by conflict, misinformation, and mobile populations; Ituri hosts about 90% of Congo’s cases and 80% of deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで疲弊する医療従事者、エボラ熱の拡大に接触者追跡が追いつかず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(4700症例超、2200人超死亡)が接触者追跡能力を超えて拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文では言及がないため除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、紛争・誤情報・人口移動が流行悪化要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak spreads to 6th province amid warnings of prolonged transmission
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has spread to a sixth province, with confirmed cases reaching 4,727 and deaths 2,214 as of Aug 15, 2026. The epidemic spans 55 health zones across Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo, with Ituri the epicenter and Buta in Bas-Uele newly affected after a traveler from Isiro (Haut-Uele) died in Buta. So far 976 people have recovered. Persistent community transmission and gaps in contact tracing threaten to prolong what is already world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. About 63% of deaths occur in communities rather than facilities; contact follow-up sits at 82.6%, though authorities caution that identified contacts do not capture undetected chains. WHO notes many cases are among people not on existing lists. Investigations suggest transmission may have begun before formal detection (Feb–May). Projections range from six months to over a year, with village-based response urged and intensified surveillance to shorten the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、6番目の州に拡大し長期化の懸念
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が6州・55保健地域に拡大し、死者2,214人・症例4,727人に達している。持続的な地域内感染と接触者追跡の限界により長期化が懸念され、WHOも関与する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 感染は旅行者の移動を介して新たな州（Bas-Uele州Buta）にも拡大しており、未検出の感染連鎖の存在が示唆されている。史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nguy cơ từ các ổ bệnh dại ở Đồng Nai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning about the risk of rabies outbreaks in Dong Nai Province
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk in Dong Nai Province, Vietnam, has produced 3 deaths and over 40 dog rabies outbreaks in 2026, up from last year by 12. Aug 14 report: Đ.G.P., 2016, Dak Mai Hamlet, Bu Gia Map Commune, exposed to an unvaccinated dog that died; he developed white lesions on the tonsils on Aug 7, with vomiting, and died after transfer to Ho Chi Minh City Hospital. Aug 1: Lâm Tuấn Kiệt, 2020, Long Khanh Ward, bitten by a dog; vaccinated and given immunoglobulin, stabilized. Late June: a white 7 kg dog in Lo Duc Street, Ho Nai Ward, bit 12 people; rabies confirmed. May: N.T.G., 1958, Xuân Que Commune, died after a rabid dog attacked her hand; no post-exposure prophylaxis. Authorities are boosting stray-dog control and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省における狂犬病発生の危険性に関する警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ドンナイ省で2026年に狂犬病による死者3名と40件超の犬の発生が報告され、住民の継続的な曝露リスクと当局・住民の高い関心が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで地域流行的だが、ドンナイ省では今年の発生件数が前年より増加し複数の死亡例が報告されている。地域住民への曝露が継続しており、当局が野犬対策と啓発を強化中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Ένας άνθρωπος πεθαίνει κάθε 30 λεπτά σύμφωνα με τον ΟΗΕ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: One person dies every 30 minutes according to the UN.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is taking a heavy toll, with the UN's humanitarian affairs chief stating that one person dies every 30 minutes. As of August 15, 2026, the outbreak continues to spread despite response efforts. The piece notes that health services and infrastructure in the country, among the poorest in the world, face chronic shortages of resources. The UN appeal calls on the international community to wake up and mobilize to intensify support. The article emphasizes the ongoing strain on local health systems and the difficulty of containing transmission, without providing specific case counts or laboratory-confirmed data. It highlights the critical background of under-resourced medical facilities and the urgent need for additional funding and logistics to curb the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ:国連によると30分ごとに1人が死亡している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行拡大と高い死亡率が国連により報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数や検査確定データは記事に記載されておらず、続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 每30分钟死1人 民主刚果伊波拉疫情失控 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One person dies every 30 minutes: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control | China Press
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-15, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is described as 'out of control' by the UN OCHA Deputy Under-Secretary-General, with the outbreak accelerating at an unprecedented pace. The situation is marked by an average of one death every 30 minutes. DR Congo authorities report more than 4,500 confirmed Ebola cases and over 2,128 deaths. The statement warns this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record and urges the international community to rapidly scale up response efforts, coordination, and resources. If the trend continues, it risks becoming the deadliest Ebola outbreak in human history. The report emphasizes urgent, larger-scale actions and international solidarity; it does not provide laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 每30分钟死1人 民主刚果伊波拉疫情失控（30分ごとに1人死亡、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が制御不能に）
