triage.notes: 国連OCHAが史上最速のエボラ流行と警告しており、致死率・拡大速度の観点から史上最悪となるリスクが指摘されている。詳細な検査確認情報や感染経路は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Có nên cho trẻ nghỉ học khi lớp có ca tay chân miệng?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Should children stay home from school when there is a case of hand, foot, and mouth disease in the class?
article.articleSummary: EV71-associated Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) is circulating in Vietnam, with cases in Phú Thọ. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets, feces, and blister fluid, spreading in daycare and schools. EV71 can cause severe complications such as encephalitis, myocarditis, pulmonary edema, and respiratory failure; progression can be rapid, and fatalities have occurred. Children under 10, especially under 5, are most affected; some infections present with subtle signs like blisters on the buttocks or perianal area rather than on hands, feet, or mouth. The Ministry of Health advises monitoring fever, keeping sick children home, and returning only after recovery; illness often lasts at least 10 days. Classmates should be monitored for 7 days for fever, mouth ulcers, drooling, or rash on hands, feet, knees, or buttocks. EV71 vaccine is licensed for ages 2 months to under 6 years; VNVC plans rollout with cross-protection across EV71 subgroups. Dr Le Tran Thang, VNVC Phan Thiet Vaccination Center.

triage.headline_ja: クラスに手足口病の患者が出た場合、子どもを学校に通わせないべきか？
triage.triage_reason: EV71関連の手足口病はベトナムで流行しているエンデミックな疾患で、重症化リスクはあるが本記事は一般的な保健指導・啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数や急増を示す情報がなく判断材料が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は保健省のアドバイスに基づく一般向け啓発記事であり、特定の集団発生や症例数急増の報告ではない。EV71は重症化（脳炎、心筋炎、肺水腫）や死亡例が既知だが、本記事内では現在の流行規模やクラスター情報は示されていない。続報や公式統計の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Alle 30 Minuten stirbt in Republik Kongo Mensch durch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Every 30 minutes, a person in the Republic of the Congo dies from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is grappling with a severe Ebola outbreak that began May 15 in the eastern provinces, with Ituri the hardest hit. UN-OCHA warns the epidemic is spreading faster than any prior outbreak, with a death every 30 minutes. Three months into the outbreak, authorities report 4,566 laboratory-confirmed cases and at least 2,128 deaths, while total fatalities exceed 2,000. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment currently available. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever. The enduring burden of Ebola in Africa is underscored by more than 15,000 deaths over the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で30分ごとに1人がエボラ出血熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ(Bundibugyo variant)アウトブレイクが発生し、確定症例4,566例・死亡2,128例以上と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的拡大リスクとワクチン未承認という管理困難性が認められるため。
triage.notes: UN-OCHAが史上最速の拡大速度と警告。ワクチン・特異的治療法未承認のBundibugyo株による第17回目のアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: كل 30 دقيقة.. إيبولا يقتل مصاباً في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Every 30 minutes... Ebola kills an infected person in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is killing one person every 30 minutes, with 2,128 deaths among over 4,500 cases since the outbreak began on May 15. The UN warns it's the fastest-spreading outbreak and could become the deadliest in the disease's history. It has been registered in six provinces in the DRC, plus Uganda, with cases near the South Sudan border. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no known cure or vaccine. International response includes about $300 million donated to a dedicated fund; UN emergency fund contributing an additional $30.5 million on top of $24 million already allocated to DRC and four other countries. The UN plans to send 20 more staff to front lines. Calls to double safe and dignified burials, triple treatment capacity, enhance contact tracing, and deploy more experienced managers, while addressing water, sanitation, health, and other basic needs.

triage.headline_ja: 30分ごとに1人死亡…エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で感染者を殺している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目が該当し、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速拡大し複数国に波及していることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンも発生地域として挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株であり、国連が過去最悪のアウトブレイクになる可能性を警告している点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo: Alle 30 Minuten ein Todesfall
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo: one death every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, with UN OCHA reporting a death every 30 minutes as of 15 August 2026. More than 2,000 people have died and many more are at risk. The current outbreak is described as the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic the country has seen, with 4,566 confirmed cases and at least 2,128 deaths reported by Congolese authorities three months after the outbreak began. By comparison, the 2018–2020 outbreak—the most deadly previously recorded—killed nearly 2,300 people among about 3,500 cases. UN OCHA official Tom Fletcher urged urgent global action to ensure countermeasures keep pace with transmission. The article highlights the severity and the need for international response, without detailing infection sources or cross-border cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行:30分に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、死者2,000人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的対応の緊急性が明示されているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 国境を越えた感染事例や感染源についての詳細は記事に記載されていないため、国際的拡大リスクは不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Many Indians Are Discovering Hepatitis Only During Routine Blood Tests
article.articleSummary: India harbors about 29 million hepatitis B and 5.5 million hepatitis C infections, per the WHO Global Hepatitis Report 2024, one of the highest national burdens. Chronic hepatitis often produces few early symptoms, so many carriers remain unaware until routine blood tests, pre-surgical panels, or blood donations reveal abnormal liver function. Transmission occurs via infected blood, unsafe injections, inadequately sterilised instruments, sexual contact, or mother-to-child transmission (HBV). Despite improvements in healthcare safety, lapses persist. Hepatitis C is now curable in most patients with direct-acting antivirals, with cure rates exceeding 90% in Indian studies; hepatitis B cannot be cured but antiviral therapy can suppress the virus to undetectable levels, reducing cirrhosis and cancer risk with ongoing treatment. Vaccination remains essential against hepatitis B. Routine screening is advised for those with blood transfusion history, dialysis, family history, healthcare exposure, multiple procedures, or unexplained liver enzyme elevations; fatty liver disease can co‑exist.

triage.headline_ja: 多くのインド人が定期血液検査で初めて肝炎と診断されている
triage.triage_reason: 慢性肝炎の疫学的背景と検査啓発に関する一般的な健康記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 既知の慢性感染症（B型・C型肝炎）の有病率と診断啓発に関する記事であり、突発的なアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Face à une épidémie d'Ebola particulièrement meurtrière en RDC, la course contre la montre pour déployer de nouveaux vaccins
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing a particularly deadly Ebola outbreak in the DRC, the race against the clock to deploy new vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has escalated into the second-deadliest in history, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (about 28,000 infections and 11,000 deaths). Declared May 15 with weeks of delay, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and is advancing rapidly. Official tallies report more than 4,566 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 2,128 deaths. Three months earlier, the WHO Director-General had declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for this outbreak. The race is on to deploy new vaccines to curb transmission and save lives amid ongoing spread within the DRC. The status underscores the urgent need for vaccination strategies and rapid international response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で特に致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の流行に直面し、新型ワクチン展開への時間との闘い
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行は史上2番目に致死的規模に達し、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文はDRCの流行のみを主題としているため除外した。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みであり、致死率・拡大速度ともに極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak situation still deeply worrying, says top UN health official
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province's Bunia, has claimed close to 2,000 lives with about 4,000 infections, per the World Health Organization. Two-thirds of deaths occur at home, distant from treatment centres. There is currently no vaccine for Ebola Bundibugyo disease, but patients can recover if diagnosed in time. WHO Africa Regional Director Dr Mohamed Janabi called for greater support for the response and to maintain other essential health services. Plans include increasing bed capacity by 400 for Ebola and 100 for other services. In Aru, a border town, no new infections have been reported for two weeks after establishing treatment centres and raising awareness to seek care early, reducing spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行状況は依然として深刻に懸念される、とWHO高官が発言
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行で約2,000人の死亡、4,000人の感染が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染継続のリスクがあるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ型にはワクチンが存在しないと記載されており、通常のザイール型エボラとは異なる点に留意。国境の町アルでは対策が奏功し2週間新規感染なしとの報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: UNO schlägt Alarm: Alle 30 Minuten stirbt ein Mensch durch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Sounds the Alarm: Every 30 Minutes a Person Dies from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola deaths are occurring at about one every 30 minutes, according to UN figures. The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) says the outbreak is spreading faster than any Ebola epidemic before, with more than 2,000 people reported dead and many more at risk. Tom Fletcher, head of OCHA, stated on Friday that 'the world must wake up and act.' The UN's warning emphasizes the scale and urgency of the crisis and the ongoing transmission, calling for immediate international attention to the Ebola outbreak in the region. The figures indicate a severe mortality burden and underscore the need for sustained international response. As of August 15, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 国連が警鐘:コンゴ民主共和国で30分ごとに1人がエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで過去最速のペースで拡大し、死者2000人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響が報告されており、国際的な関心・支援要請も明確でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 国連(OCHA)が『史上最速の拡大』と警告し、国際的な緊急対応を呼びかけている重大なシグナル。フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 联合国：刚果（金）每半小时就有一人死于埃博拉
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, one person dies from Ebola every half hour.
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in its 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Since May 15, there have been over 4,500 confirmed cases and at least 2,128 deaths; Uganda has reported cases, with transmission reaching areas near the South Sudan border. Ebola spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever; there is no vaccine or treatment for this strain. UN humanitarian chief Martin Griffiths warns the outbreak is the fastest-spreading yet and calls for rapid, large-scale, united action. Donors have contributed nearly $300 million to a dedicated Ebola response fund; the UN Emergency Fund has reallocated $30.5 million on top of $24 million previously, to support Congo and four other countries. Only 20 frontline staff are deployed so far; more are needed, including doubling safe-burial teams, doubling treatment capacity, improving contact tracing, and expanding essential services (water, sanitation, health).

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国では30分に1人がエボラ出血熱で死亡している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク(4,500例超、死者2,128人以上)が発生し、ウガンダへも拡大、国際的な緊急対応が呼びかけられており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による過去最速の拡大と国連が警告している点は特筆すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 北京新生入学肺结核筛查今启动，为何必须进行筛查？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing freshmen pulmonary TB screening begins today; why must screening be conducted?
article.articleSummary: Beijing launched tuberculosis (TB) screening for new students in nurseries, primary schools, junior high, and senior high/vocational schools on Aug 15. TB, caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, is a Class B infectious disease in China; due to nonspecific early symptoms and latent infection, proactive screening aims to prevent campus spread. TB most often affects the lungs but can involve other organs; early signs include low fever, night sweats, fatigue, weight loss, poor appetite, and a mild cough. China’s TB burden has declined since 2012 (incidence and mortality down ~30%, cure rate >90%), though about 10% of counties remain high-prevalence. Transmission is via respiratory droplets in crowded settings; waning BCG protection and developing adolescent immunity heighten school risk. Screening rules: day students (preschool–junior high) are screened for symptoms and close contacts; positives get TB infection testing. Boarding middle/high/vocational students undergo full infection testing; high-risk entrants have symptom screening, infection testing, and annual chest imaging. After Aug 15, parents/students can register via the WeChat mini-program “Beijing Freshmen TB Screening” to complete basic info and proceed with testing and imaging. Seek care for cough >2 weeks, coughing blood, night sweats, or weight loss.

triage.headline_ja: 北京、新入学児童・生徒への肺結核スクリーニングを本日開始、なぜ検査が必要か
triage.triage_reason: 定例の新学期結核スクリーニングプログラムの案内であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の疾患で中国では発生率・死亡率とも減少傾向にあり、本記事は毎年恒例の学校での予防的スクリーニング施策の広報記事。感染拡大の兆候や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: ΟΗΕ: Η επιδημία του Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό στοιχίζει τη ζωή σε έναν άνθρωπο κάθε 30 λεπτά
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC claims the life of one person every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 2,128 deaths among 4,556 laboratory-confirmed cases as of 15 August 2026, three months after the May outbreak declaration. UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher warns the Bundibugyo-strain epidemic is spreading faster than any previous DRC outbreak, killing about one person every 30 minutes. The DRC, among the world’s poorest nations, continues to face resource constraints despite prior funding commitments; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days after the May declaration. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola yet, though clinical trials are underway. Financing includes an additional $30.5 million from CERF atop $24 million already allocated to DRC and four neighboring countries; Africa CDC projects total needs of $518 million with $264 million funded.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、30分に1人の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで、致死率が高く感染拡大速度も過去最速、ワクチン・治療薬未承認というIHR基準・WPRO基準に複数該当する重大な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: WHOは既にPHEICを宣言済みであり、本来はフルRRAが継続実施されている段階と考えられる。Bundibugyo株による感染拡大とワクチン未承認の状況が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: "Σκοτώνει έναν άνθρωπο κάθε 30 λεπτά" - Εξαπλώθηκε σε έκτη επαρχία του Κονγκό | Ειδήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: "It kills one person every 30 minutes" - Has spread to the sixth province of Congo | News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached Bas-Uele Province, the sixth province to confirm the virus, after a death in Buta tested positive. As of 15 August 2026, official counts are 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths, with Associated Press reporting over 4,700 cases and more than 2,200 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccine or specific therapy for this strain, though candidate vaccines and therapies are in trials. Ituri Province remains the epicenter with about 90% of cases and 80% of deaths, and this is the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the DRC. The UN warns of the fastest-spreading transmission, with 60–70% of new cases not previously identified as contacts, hindering tracing. A UN appeal mobilized $30.5 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund, with about $300 million pledged by donors. Conflict, displacement, limited road access, staffing shortages, and strikes hinder containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:「30分に1人が死亡」―コンゴ第6州にまで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行が第6州に拡大し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がない中で急速に感染拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo species）、6州に拡大、致死率約47%、UNが資金拠出と国際支援を要請。紛争・避難民・道路アクセス制限が封じ込めを阻害。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola, l'ONU injecte 30,5 millions USD supplémentaires dans la riposte | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: the UN injects an additional USD 30.5 million into the Ebola response | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher announced a fresh 30.5 million USD injection into the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) from the Central Emergency Response Fund (CERF). The new funds complement 24 million USD already released for the DRC and four neighboring countries, with 20 additional field staff to bolster on-the-ground teams. Fletcher warned that Ebola is spreading faster than the international response can contain, describing the outbreak as the fastest-ever and noting about a death every 30 minutes, with fatalities exceeding 2,000 to date. Nearly 300 million USD has already been mobilized by international donors, but needs remain substantial. Priorities include doubling secure burial capacity, tripling treatment capacity, and improving contact tracing and epidemiological surveillance, aiming to accelerate response and build community trust to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：国連が対応策にさらに3050万米ドルを追加投入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における「史上最速」とされるエボラ出血熱の流行で死者2000人超、近隣国への拡大も示唆されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事では近隣4カ国への資金拠出にも言及しているが、具体的な国名は明示されていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。既に大規模な国際対応が進行中の継続事案であるが、死亡率の急増や封じ込めの遅れが強調されており、状況の悪化を示すシグナルとしてPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak through the eyes of Canadian aid workers
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ituri province faces the fastest-growing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with more than 2,100 deaths among over 4,500 infections since the spring declaration. The WHO warns it could surpass the deadliest outbreak (over 11,000 deaths). No specific vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola, though clinical studies are underway. The outbreak officially began in May, with evidence it started in February and early cases misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid. Canadian aid workers report rising community awareness and willingness to seek treatment and participate in safe burials, despite attacks on health workers and misinformation. In Ituri countryside, contact tracing reaches 200–300 people daily; in Bunia, contacts are 'out of control'. MSF coordinates safe, dignified burials and PPE logistics; Canada has allocated CAD 1.8 million to local Red Cross as part of an $8 million fund; body bags with a window address rumours and preserve family trust.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ人援助従事者の目から見た、史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、死者2,100人超・感染者4,500人超と極めて深刻。WHOも史上最悪の流行を上回る可能性を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: カナダは援助資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外。ブンディブギョ株エボラで特異的なワクチン・治療法が存在しない点、初期症例がマラリア・腸チフスと誤診されていた点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉史上最快擴散！已破2千死　疾管署：8/21研議延長入台禁令
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads faster than ever in history! Death toll surpasses 2,000. Taiwan CDC: On Aug. 21, considering extending the entry ban to Taiwan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda is accelerating, with WHO declaring the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). As of Aug 10, DRC has 4,449 confirmed cases and a 46.3% fatality rate; Uganda’s last reported case was on June 21. Taiwan’s CDC states border measures—entry bans for residents from DRC and Uganda and voluntary, free testing for travelers with travel history—will be discussed at the Aug 21 inter-ministerial meeting to decide whether to extend. In Taiwan, four international airports are issuing self-health management forms to asymptomatic travelers with travel history, and voluntary testing is offered. By Aug 14, 10 travelers from affected regions who returned to Taiwan sought testing; 9 were negative, 1 awaiting results. The measures, originally enacted on June 2 for 90 days, may be extended beyond Aug 21 to curb cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ史上最速拡散！死者2000人突破　台湾疾管署：8月21日に入境禁止令延長を協議
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、致死率46.3%と深刻。IHR基準を複数満たし国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの重大イベント。台湾は流行国ではなく水際対策実施国として記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉史上最快擴散！已破2千死　疾管署：8/21研議延長入台禁令 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola's fastest spread in history! Death toll tops 2,000; Taiwan CDC: On Aug. 21, considering extending Taiwan's entry ban | LIFE.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to spread rapidly. As of Aug 14, DRC has 4,449 confirmed cases with a 46.3% case-fatality rate; Uganda’s last case was June 21. The World Health Organization designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Taiwan’s Centers for Disease Control has barred entry for residents from DRC and Uganda and suspended visas since June 2 (90 days), with four exemptions for diplomats, spouses and minor children of Taiwanese nationals, foreign-degree students, and humanitarian programs. Taiwan is also offering voluntary free testing at four international airports for travelers with travel history; 10 returnees have been tested (9 negative, 1 pending) as of Aug 14. A cross-ministerial meeting on Aug 21 will decide whether to extend border controls. No clear signs of containment yet.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ史上最速の拡散！死者2000人突破 台湾疾病管制署：8月21日に入台禁止令延長を検討
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラ出血熱がDRC・ウガンダで急速に拡大し致死率46.3%と深刻で、国際的な渡航制限措置も取られておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。台湾は水際対策の実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みでフルRRAへ進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola në Kongo, mbi 2 mijë viktima. OKB-ja paralajmëron për përhapje të shpejtë
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, over 2,000 victims. The UN warns of rapid spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with over 2,000 deaths and more than 4,500 lab-confirmed cases since the current outbreak. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher calls for an immediate scale-up of international assistance amid resource and health-capacity shortfalls. Latest figures: 2,128 deaths from 4,556 lab-confirmed cases, about three months into the outbreak. The UN has added $30.5 million from CERF, on top of $24 million pledged earlier for the DRC and four neighboring countries. WHO says $518 million is needed for the joint preparedness and response plan, with only $264 million secured. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola variant; there is no vaccine or variant-specific approved treatment yet, while clinical trials continue. DR Congo has faced prior outbreaks, including 2018–2020 (≈2,300 deaths from 3,500 cases), and Ebola has caused thousands of deaths in Africa over five decades.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ、死者2,000人超。国連が急速な拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行（死者2,128人、症例4,556人）し、国連が国際支援拡大を要請しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・変異株特異的治療薬が未承認であり、周辺国への波及リスクも指摘されている。資金不足（必要518百万ドルに対し264百万ドルのみ確保）も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒正在失控！聯合國示警：每30分鐘奪一命、全球必須醒來
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is spiraling out of control! UN warns: a life is lost every 30 minutes, the world must wake up.
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has intensified, with UN OCHA warning and WHO's Tedros describing it as the deadliest on record. The death toll has surpassed 2,000, with about one death every 30 minutes as the epidemic expands. International response includes CERF funding of $30.5 million added on August 14, atop $24 million previously allocated to Congo and four neighboring countries, plus 20 specialists dispatched to frontline areas. UN outlines an expanded strategy: double safe and dignified burial capacity; triple treatment capacity; strengthen contact tracing and management; and address urgent basic needs such as water, sanitation, and healthcare. Ebola virus, identified in 1976 in the DRC, spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and damaged skin, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and about 50% fatality.

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒正失控！聯合國：每30分鐘奪一命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is spiraling out of control! UN: a life is lost every 30 minutes.

WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls it the most deadly Ebola outbreak to date. The spread is at record speed, averaging one death every 30 minutes and pushing deaths above 2,000 with many at risk. article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: وفاة كل 30 دقيقة لمصابي إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: One death every 30 minutes among Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher says about one person dies every 30 minutes among Ebola patients in the DRC. triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者、30分に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模かつ過去最速の拡大速度とされるエボラ流行で、多数の死者と国際的な資金支援要請があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 国連職員の発言として、致死率の高さと感染拡大速度が強調されており、既に国際的な資金支援（約3億ドル）が動いている。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak through the eyes of Canadian aid workers
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Congo's northeast, centered on Bunia in Ituri. Since the spring declaration, more than 4,500 infections and over 2,100 deaths have been recorded. The World Health Organization calls it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, on track to surpass the deadliest one (over 11,000 deaths). Bundibugyo Ebola has no specific vaccine or treatment yet; clinical studies are underway. Canadian aid workers report improving community awareness and engagement in safe burials, though cases keep rising. In Ituri countryside, contact tracing targets about 200–300 people daily; in Bunia, the number of contacts is out of control. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; traditional burials pose risk. Safe and dignified burial teams, PPE logistics from Canada, and clear-window body bags are used to counter misinformation and fear. Canada has allocated $1.8 million to local Red Cross as part of an $8 million international fund.

triage.headline_ja: カナダの援助従事者が見た、史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡大とWHOが評価する大規模エボラ流行（4,500人超感染、2,100人超死亡）であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確に認められる。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、ワクチン・治療法未確立。Bunia（Ituri州）における接触者追跡が制御困難な状況にあり、国際支援（カナダ等）が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : l'évêque de Beni-Butembo suspend les messes de funérailles et les grandes assemblées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: the Bishop of Beni-Butembo suspends funeral Masses and large gatherings.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu prompts preventive measures in the Butembo-Beni area. On August 13, 2026, Bishop Sikuli Paluku Melchisédech of Butembo-Beni issued a pastoral communiqué calling Catholics and others to intensify prevention to curb transmission amid a surge of Ebola cases in Butembo, Beni and surrounding areas. The diocese suspended funeral Masses held with the body, and large gatherings at major sanctuaries in Butembo (notably MCA and Mont Carmel) and other venues such as Thabor and Saba. Choirs and church groups (MAC and GRAS) and their inter-parish movements were halted. Water points should be set up at entrances, with handwashing using soap or sanitizer before entering. To limit contact, offertory collections are advised after Communion. The bishop commends health workers and urges community support and adherence to preventive measures to slow Ebola spread in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ出血熱：ベニ・ブテンボ司教が葬儀ミサと大規模集会を停止
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州（ブテンボ・ベニ地域）でエボラ症例の急増が報告され、教会が葬儀ミサや集会を停止するなど地域社会レベルでの対応が取られており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は主に宗教的措置（葬儀ミサ停止、集会制限、手洗い設備設置等）を報じており、症例数や死亡者数など疫学的詳細は記載なし。北キブ州（ベニ・ブテンボ）は過去にも大規模エボラ流行が発生した地域であり、続報での症例数・対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Thêm giải pháp điều trị Covid-19 từ Hoa Kỳ, trong bối cảnh ca mắc tăng nhẹ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Additional COVID-19 treatment options from the United States, in the context of a slight uptick in cases.
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 cases are rising in Vietnam, with Hanoi reporting 268 new infections from July 24–31 and 855 cases in 2026 (no fatalities). Health authorities warn summer travel and crowded indoor settings may boost transmission, but no evidence of unusual virulence or increased severe outcomes. Long Châu Pharmacy and Vaccination System, in collaboration with a leading U.S. pharmaceutical company, are bringing an FDA-approved Covid-19 treatment to Vietnam. The regimen uses nirmatrelvir with ritonavir, authorized under FDA Emergency Use Authorization for mild-to-moderate SARS-CoV-2 infection (Covid-19) in adults and in children 12 years and older (minimum 40 kg) at high risk of progression. Long Châu aims to improve access, especially for high-risk patients, and ease the healthcare burden. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health continues surveillance of cases, hospitalizations, and variants; no unusual changes detected.

triage.headline_ja: 米国からのCOVID-19治療法追加、感染者数が微増する中で
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19感染者数の軽微な増加と新規治療薬の導入に関する内容で、異常な重症化や変異株の懸念は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も認められない。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし、異常な重症化や変異株の証拠なしと明記されており、通常の季節的変動および新治療薬導入のニュースと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: DF tem primeiro caso de raiva em cães desde 2000; vacinação de pets começa neste sábado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District reports its first rabies case in dogs since 2000; pet vaccinations begin this Saturday.
article.articleSummary: Federal District, Brazil, reports its first dog rabies case in 26 years: a 4-year-old female dog from Lago Norte developed symptoms July 23 and died July 29; diagnosis confirmed by the Health Secretariat this week. Two additional suspected cases in Lago Oeste were ruled out. Although canine rabies has not been recorded in the DF since 2000 and there are no confirmed feline cases since 2001, the virus still circulates sporadically among wildlife and livestock, especially bats and herbivores. Environmental Health teams conducted a vaccination block in the area. A citywide dog vaccination campaign begins Saturday, August 15, at 151 vaccination posts across the DF, with locations and hours published by the Health Secretariat; posts operate Monday through Saturday until month’s end. Pet vaccination is annually recommended to prevent transmission to humans, given rabies’ high fatality rate.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦区（ブラジル）で2000年以来初めて犬の狂犬病症例が報告、今週土曜日からペットワクチン接種開始
triage.triage_reason: 26年ぶりに連邦区で犬の狂犬病症例が確認され、地域として異常な事象であり、野生動物・家畜での病原体循環継続の可能性がある。また地元メディア・保健当局の高い関心を伴いワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始されているため、WPRO基準該当かつ社会的関心もありPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 人への感染例は報告されていないが、狂犬病は致死率が高いため公衆衛生上の警戒対象。地元保健当局が既にワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施しており、外部支援の必要性は低いと考えられる。今後の人的感染例の有無や野生動物での拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Carlos Madeiro: Menina caso zero da zika diz 'papai' pela 1ª vez aos 10 anos: 'Emocionante'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carlos Madeiro: Zika patient-zero girl says 'dad' for the first time at age 10: 'Moving'.
article.articleSummary: Zika virus patient-zero Catarina, from Brazil's Northeast, became pivotal in confirming that Zika infection can cause fetal microcephaly, with the discovery in the placenta in November 2015 amid a spike of microcephaly births in the region. Initially, prognoses warned she might not survive birth or could be left with severe impairment; however, Catarina has progressed and now studies in the 5th grade and leads a nearly normal life, enjoying play and interaction. Her father Mário recalls the moment he heard her say 'papa' at the gate, a moving milestone that affirmed the family's years of therapy and care. Since four months old, Catarina has received ongoing multidisciplinary support, including physiotherapy and speech therapy, highlighting the long-term implications and care required for Zika-associated developmental challenges.

triage.headline_ja: カルロス・マデイロ：ジカ熱患者第1号の少女、10歳で初めて『パパ』と発話『感動的』
triage.triage_reason: 2015年のジカ熱流行に関連した個人の回顧的な人間ドラマ記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2015-2016年のジカ熱流行時に胎児小頭症の因果関係確認に寄与した患者の10年後の近況を伝える人間味のある記事であり、現在の感染症シグナルとしての価値はない。

article.articleHeadline: Turis Digigit Anak Singa di Kafe, Berakhir Vaksin Rabies Sendiri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tourist bitten by a lion cub at a cafe ends up getting the rabies vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Chinese tourist bitten by a lion cub at a Phuket, Thailand lion cafe prompted rabies vaccination after staff claimed the animals were vaccinated. The bite caused a minor arm abrasion; the tourist subsequently received a rabies vaccine in Thailand and reported fever and arm soreness but remained stable. Thai health guidelines treat any bite or scratch from an animal with skin breaks as potential rabies exposure, a disease nearly always fatal once symptoms appear. Lion-interaction cafes have surged in Phuket, Chiang Mai, and Bangkok under the Wild Animal Conservation and Protection Act, though enforcement remains lax; notable incidents include a 2024 seizure of an unregistered cub and a 2025 Phuket raid. In Chalong, Phuket, police and the Tourist Assistance Centre confirmed vaccination records for two lions—rabies and tetanus vaccines with certificates from Happy Paws Animal Hospital. CCTV footage was not retained. Authorities call for tighter monitoring and adherence to procedures.

triage.headline_ja: カフェでライオンの子供に噛まれた観光客、自らも狂犬病ワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: 個別の観光客が動物カフェでライオンの子に噛まれ狂犬病ワクチンを接種した単発事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 動物カフェでの咬傷事例は個別対応済みであり、ヒト-ヒト感染や集団発生の兆候はない。ただしタイ国内での動物カフェ規制の実効性については継続的な監視対象となり得る。

article.articleHeadline: 每30分鐘奪1命！民主剛果伊波拉增至2184死　聯合國：資源遠遠不夠
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One life lost every 30 minutes! Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 2,184 deaths; United Nations: resources are far from enough.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus drives the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths reported as of August 14, 2026. The crisis has spread to six provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, Tshopo, and Bas-Uele—marking the fastest expansion on record. There is no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo virus; vaccines and treatments remain in trials. The northeastern DRC context—armed conflict, displacement, weak health systems, and logistical barriers—hampers surveillance and containment. International support approaches nearly $300 million, including a UN CERF allocation of $30.5 million plus $24 million previously invested, for a total of about $54.5 million. The WHO has declared PHEIC; if momentum continues, deaths could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Calls persist to double safe burials, triple treatment capacity, and bolster contact tracing and health worker deployment.

triage.headline_ja: 毎30分ごとに1人死亡！民主コンゴのエボラ死者数2,184人に増加　国連「資源が全く足りていない」
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行が6州に拡大し、死者数が急増しており、ワクチン・治療法未確立で国際支援が必要な深刻な公衆衛生危機である。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEICを宣言済み。ワクチン・治療法が未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、武力紛争地域における対応の困難さが指摘されている。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ituri - Une campagne antipaludique lancée pour soutenir la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ituri - A malaria control campaign launched to support the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, launched a four-day mass campaign to administer antimalarial drugs in Bunia, Nyakunde, Mungwalu and Rwampara health zones, targeting more than one million people. The intervention runs amid an Ebola outbreak in the region and aims to reduce malaria-related fever, thereby easing fever-driven demand on health facilities and improving the identification of suspected Ebola cases. In the first half of 2026, malaria deaths in Ituri totaled around one hundred, underscoring malaria as a leading driver of clinical consultations in the province. Authorities note that malaria and Ebola share fever and other symptoms, complicating early case detection. The campaign is presented as a component of the Ebola response; community and religious leaders have urged compliance to ensure success and to relieve health centers from fever-related cases that may mask Ebola testing needs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:イトゥリ州 - エボラ対応を支援するためのマラリア対策キャンペーンが開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ流行に関連し、マラリア対策キャンペーンが実施されている。エボラ自体が重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、発熱症状の重複による症例特定の複雑化も懸念材料である。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア対策キャンペーンが主題だが、背景にDRCイトゥリ州での進行中のエボラ流行がある点が重要。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリーでは言及されておらず除外した。エボラ流行そのものの詳細（症例数・死亡数等）は本記事に記載なく、既存の流行状況について別途確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉病毒失控！聯合國示警「30分鐘死1人」　6省全淪陷重災區曝光
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola virus out of control! UN warns of 'one death every 30 minutes' as six provinces fall, heavily hit areas exposed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo virus has spread to six provinces, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths reported as of August 14. Ituri Province accounts for roughly 90% of cases and about 80% of fatalities, amid ongoing armed conflict, population displacement, and limited health resources. The United Nations warns of a death about every 30 minutes, underscoring rapid transmission. Bas-Uele Province has reported its first Ebola death, signaling geographic expansion to a sixth province. About 60–70% of new infections are not linked to traced contacts, suggesting undetected transmission chains. Health facilities face violence, staff strikes over unpaid wages, and supply disruptions, complicating surveillance, isolation, and care. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo at present; WHO and partners are supporting centers, surveillance, and clinical research.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルスが制御不能！国連が『30分に1人死亡』と警告、6州が壊滅的被害地域に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoウイルスによるエボラが6州に拡大し、4,665例・2,184死亡と極めて深刻。武力紛争下で追跡不能な感染連鎖が60-70%に及び、ワクチンもなく国際支援が急務であるため、フルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（約47%）、武力紛争・医療従事者のストライキ・物資不足により対応が著しく困難な状況。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株であることも重大な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: The terrifying virus outbreak no one wants to talk about
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. The outbreak began in February and was declared on 15 May. It has killed more than 2,000 people, with fatalities rising faster than the 2014–16 peak and the World Health Organization chief warning it could become the deadliest ever. Much of the toll is in areas out of reach of aid workers amid ongoing Congo conflict and militia violence tied to mineral wealth (coltan). The response is hampered by budget cuts; WHO cannot pay some first responders, and a vaccine for this strain may be long off. Imported/exported cases include a June case in France (doctor returning from Congo) and a British humanitarian worker evacuated to London; Europe risk remains low. Global aid reductions and US withdrawal from WHO compound the challenge.

triage.headline_ja: 誰も話したがらない恐ろしいウイルスの流行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で稀なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱が発生し、死者2000人超・過去最悪のペースで拡大、既にフランス・英国への症例輸出も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: フランス・英国での症例は輸入例であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法がない稀な株であること、資金不足によるWHO対応の困難さが特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Point Santé : le virus Ebola Bundibugyo circulait depuis plusieurs mois sans être signalé, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Update: The Bundibugyo ebolavirus had been circulating for several months without being reported, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,400 confirmed cases and 2,000 deaths, with Ituri province alone accounting for roughly 90% of cases and 80% of deaths across five provinces and 53 health zones. Transmission chains remain partly unknown; 60–70% of fatalities occur in communities outside treatment centers and contact lists, and contact tracing stands at about 80% but needs 95% to halt spread. WHO aims to triple health capacity to 3,000 beds within 12 weeks; no viral mutation detected, and spread is attributed to conflict, population displacement, and barriers to care. The outbreak likely began in February and was officially declared May 15; surveillance weakened by USAID funding cuts, prompting calls for Africa-led health sovereignty. Vaccination efforts center on Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) in a Phase 3 trial in DRC, with Gavi providing $40 million and stock doses; Phase 1 trials for Bundibugyo-specific candidates underway in Canada (Moderna) and the UK (Oxford).

triage.headline_ja: 保健情報:ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスは、WHOによると発表前に数か月間、報告されないまま流行していた
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,400人以上の確定症例、2,000人以上の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が進行中であり、致死率が高く、紛争・住民移動により伝播が続いている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: カナダ・英国はワクチン候補（Bundibugyo特異的）の第I相試験実施国であり、感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。USAID資金削減によるサーベイランス低下やコンタクトトレーシングが目標未達(80%/95%必要)など、封じ込めに外部支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola salgınının görüldüğü eyalet sayısı 6'ya yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo where the Ebola outbreak has been observed has risen to six.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to six provinces, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths (case fatality rate 46.8%). Bas-Uele’s Buta Health Zone was added to the list of affected areas, bringing the national count of affected regions to 54. The six affected provinces are Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, with Ituri in the northeast remaining the outbreak’s epicenter. Since the outbreak began on 15 May, 965 people have recovered. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. These figures indicate ongoing transmission and a widening geographic footprint within the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が確認された州の数が6州に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国内で6州に拡大し、致死率46.8%と高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日発生、Bundibugyo株による大規模流行。4,665例確定、2,184死亡、致死率46.8%。北キブ・南キブ・イトゥリ・バスウエレ・オートウエレ・ツォポの6州に拡大。継続的な人道支援・国際的な対応が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: മലപ്പുറത്ത് എലിപ്പനി കേസുകള്‍ ആശങ്കാജനകമായി ഉയരുന്നു. എലിപ്പനി ആശങ്ക; 116 കേസുകൾ. ഈമാസം രണ്ടുമരണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox cases are rising alarmingly in Malappuram. Monkeypox concern; 116 cases. Two deaths this month.
article.articleSummary: Malappuram district in Kerala reports 116 confirmed monkeypox cases to date, with two deaths this month: August 6 (a 57-year-old Edavathiruthi resident) and August 9 (a 45-year-old Manjeri resident). Cases are reported across multiple localities including Edavathiruthi, Manjeri, Vettakkode, Kavannur, Thrippanachi, Anakkayam, Thrikkalangode, Kondotti, Chungathara, Nilambur, Thirunavaya, Marakkar, and Mangalassery. Health authorities warn higher risk among sanitation and cleaning workers; doxycycline prophylaxis is being given to at-risk individuals. Symptoms prompting hospital care include fever with severe body pains and eye redness. The district also faces a broader fever surge: 16,634 fever cases treated in government facilities over the past week; daily averages exceed 2,000, with 2,961 fever patients yesterday. No infection source or imported/exported case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: マラプラム県でネズミ熱(レプトスピラ症)患者が増加、懸念高まる。116例、今月2名死亡
triage.triage_reason: 疾患タグはMpoxとなっているが、記事本文はケララ州マラプラム県における레プトスピラ症(rat fever)の急増を報じており、116例・死亡2名に加え週間発熱患者16,634例という規模の大きさから、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性の2点が該当するためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患分類はMpoxとなっているが、原文見出し・本文はマラヤーラム語で『エリッパニ(エリッパニ=rat fever/レプトスピラ症)』を指しており、実際のイベントはレプトスピラ症の地域的流行である。疾患タグの誤りに注意し、実際の内容（レプトスピラ症アウトブレイク）に基づき評価した。地域は発生地域リスト通りケララ州（インド）に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून में दुधारू पशुओं पर मंडरा रहा चमोकन बीमारी का खतरा, जानें कैसे करें बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During the monsoon, dairy animals face the threat of Chamokan disease; learn how to protect.
article.articleSummary: Chamokan disease threatens dairy cattle in Palamu during the monsoon, caused by external parasites such as lice. Humidity, filth, and standing dirty water around sheds facilitate spread. Parasitic blood-feeding weakens animals, causing anemia, fatigue, and decreased milk yield; severe cases can lead to pneumonia and death. Transmission can occur from infected to other animals in close quarters. Early signs include increased parasite load, persistent itching, hair loss, weight loss, weakness, and reduced milk production. Upon symptom onset, isolate affected animals and sanitize the shed; ensure dry bedding and remove stagnant water. Regular cleaning, possible bathing, and veterinary-guided use of appropriate medicines, dips, or sprays are recommended; do not self-dose. If outbreaks persist, seek veterinary care promptly; maintaining a dry, clean housing during monsoon is the key preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン時期、乳牛にチャモカン病の脅威が迫る―予防方法を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: 動物のみに影響する外部寄生虫による疾患であり、人獣共通感染症の兆候やヒトへの健康影響の記載がなく、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 本疾患は乳牛の外部寄生虫（シラミ等）による家畜疾患であり、ヒトへの感染性やヒト-ヒト感染の記述はない。地域限定的な家畜衛生情報であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 সোয়াইন ফ্লু বাড়িয়ে দিতে পারে হার্ট অ্যাটাকের ঝুঁকি, সতর্ক করছেন চিকিৎসকরা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Swine Flu May Increase the Risk of Heart Attack, Doctors Warn.
article.articleSummary: Delhi, India is experiencing a sharp surge in H1N1 influenza (swine flu). National data from the NCDC show 1,449 H1N1 cases in Delhi as of August 12, 2026, more than six times the 229 cases recorded by the same date in 2025. While H1N1 is a respiratory virus, the disease is not limited to the lungs or throat. Cardiovascular specialists warn that the infection can trigger a severe inflammatory response in the body's immune system, potentially putting the heart at risk and increasing the likelihood of a heart attack. The report underscores an ongoing outbreak in the capital, highlighting the need for awareness among residents and clinicians. No details on fatalities or laboratory confirmation are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1豚インフルエンザが心臓発作のリスクを高める可能性、医師が警告(デリー)

triage.notes: 記事はデリーにおけるH1N1症例の急増（前年同日比6倍以上）と心血管系合併症リスクについて医師の警告を伝えるもの。死亡例やラボ確認情報は記載なし。国レベルのNCDCデータに基づく報告であり、季節性インフルエンザの流行として国内医療体制内で対応可能な範囲と考えられるが、急増の推移は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: فيروس "إيبولا" يقتل شخصًا كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو | الصحافة اليوم - يومية اخبارية جامعة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: The Ebola virus kills one person every 30 minutes in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola is killing about one person every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 15 August 2026, according to UN Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher. The outbreak, described as the fastest-spreading in history, has logged more than 4,500 cases and at least 2,128 deaths since it emerged on 15 May, across six Congolese provinces, with cases also in Uganda and near the South Sudan border. The UN cautioned the epidemic could become the deadliest on record unless the international response expands rapidly, addressing water, sanitation, health services, and other basic needs. Funding of 30.5 million dollars is added to 24 million already allocated for the DRC and four other countries. Fletcher announced 20 additional frontline staff and called for doubling safe-burial teams, tripling treatment capacity, improving contact tracing, and deploying more experienced managers to accelerate the response.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:エボラウイルスがコンゴで30分ごとに1人を死亡させている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が4500例超・死者2128人以上に達し、ウガンダや南スーダン国境付近にも波及するなど、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する重大な国際的公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンも記事で言及されているが両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。史上最速拡大とされる大規模流行であり、国際的資金・人員支援が拡大投入されている。

article.articleHeadline: Paludisme en RDC : plus de 26 millions de cas dont près 30.000 morts enregistrés en 2025 (PNLP)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria in the DRC: more than 26 million cases, including nearly 30,000 deaths recorded in 2025 (PNLP).
article.articleSummary: DRC malaria burden: approximately 26,064,143 malaria cases and 29,938 deaths in 2025, per Dr. Guy Esebe Dembo, deputy director of the National Malaria Control Program (PNLP). Figures released August 14, 2026 at the Ituri provincial governorate esplanade during a mass drug administration campaign launch. Malaria remains the principal public health challenge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with calls to sustain and intensify high-impact interventions and adapt strategies to health zone realities. The Ituri event aims to strengthen prevention and response and mobilize authorities, health professionals, partners, and communities to further reduce malaria cases and deaths. The report underscores ongoing national efforts to combat malaria through reinforced interventions and new, region-specific approaches.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のマラリア:2025年に2600万件超の症例、約3万人の死亡を記録(PNLP)
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCにおいて既知の風土病であり、本記事は国家マラリア対策プログラム(PNLP)による年次統計の発表であって、新規または異常な発生事象ではないため。
triage.notes: マラリアはDRCの風土病であり、本記事は2025年の年次統計と大量投薬キャンペーン開始の報告。突発的な異常発生ではなく、既存の国家プログラムによる継続的対応が行われているため、フルRRAの対象にはならないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão da dengue atende parte do Jardim Damasco em Varginha | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue task force serves part of Jardim Damasco in Varginha | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Varginha, Brazil: The City Hall's Environmental Surveillance launches the Dengue Task Force Mutirão da Dengue in part of Jardim Damasco from August 19–21, 2026. The campaign aims to remove water-collecting materials to curb Aedes aegypti, the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector. Residents on affected streets must clear items from indoors and place them on the curb by 7:00 am on collection day; vehicles will operate once per street. Acceptable items include old furniture, cans, plastics, tires, and other water-holding objects; branches and construction debris will not be collected. In this first phase, several streets are listed, with the Jardim Damasco area divided into two parts due to its size. The effort involves the municipal Departments of Public Works and Urban Services, Environment, Education, and Government.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策合同活動、ヴァルジーニャのジャルジン・ダマスコ地区の一部で実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介対策（清掃活動）に関する行政広報であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体による定期的な蚊媒介対策（ゴミ回収・清掃キャンペーン）の告知であり、感染者数の急増や異常な流行状況についての記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉史上最致命疫情爆發？每半小時就奪走一命！民主剛果伊波拉失控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Ebola the deadliest outbreak in history? One life is lost every half hour! Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, ongoing since mid-May 2026, is driven by Bundibugyo virus. As of August 15, 2026, confirmed cases exceed 4,500 with at least 2,128 deaths. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, and there are no approved treatments or vaccines. Transmission occurs mainly through contact with infected bodily fluids, causing severe hemorrhagic fever, with spread extended to border areas with Uganda and South Sudan. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher warns this is the fastest-spreading outbreak in history, with a death every 30 minutes. International funding totals near $300 million, and UN emergency funds have allocated an additional $30.5 million, plus $24 million previously disbursed, to assist the DRC and four other countries. Frontline efforts include deploying 20 UN staff, but burial teams must triple in capacity, medical treatment capacity must triple, and contact tracing, WASH, and logistical management require rapid scale-up.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱は史上最も致死的な流行か？30分ごとに1人の命が奪われる！コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例4,500人超・死者2,128人以上と規模が大きく、ウガンダ・南スーダン国境地域への拡大、承認された治療薬・ワクチンの不在、国際的な緊急資金投入など、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Former rebel fighters join campaign against Ebola in the DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo variant and lacking an approved vaccine, is on track to be the deadliest in the country's history, with about 2,000 deaths nationwide as it spreads to a sixth province and threatens South Sudan. Amid conflict and poor health access, MONUSCO-supported demobilisation of 27 former rebels is deploying them as community mobilisers in Tchomia, Ituri Province, to promote handwashing, symptom recognition, and prompt reporting of suspected cases in central markets, town centers, and the animal feed production site. The initiative engages former fighters in prevention and detection, aiding the public health response and stabilization by strengthening community cohesion.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が承認済みワクチンなしで拡大し、約2000人が死亡、同国史上最悪の流行となりつつあり、第6州に拡大し南スーダンへの越境リスクも指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الإبلاغ عن 4665 حالة مؤكدة لإيبولا و2184 وفاة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 4,665 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,184 deaths reported - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in an intensive transmission phase, the largest outbreak recorded in the country. As of 12 August 2026, 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths have been reported (case fatality 46.8%). The outbreak expanded from Mongbwalu health zone in Ituri to 54 health zones across six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and Bas-Uele, with Bas-Uele recently affected by a travel-related case in Buta health zone (symptoms on 4 August). Week 32 (3–9 August) totals were 579 cases and 304 deaths, signaling rapid, cross-regional spread and high lethality. France reported an imported case on 24 June 2026 with no secondary transmission by 14 August (41 days post-discharge). Uganda’s last imported case was discharged on 16 July, with enhanced monitoring through 27 August due to cross-border risk from DRC. Regional preparedness guides the response.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱の確定症例4,665件、死亡者2,184人と報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが進行中で、致死率46.8%、6州54保健地区に拡大し、フランス・ウガンダへの国際的波及も確認されているため。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية الإبلاغ عن 4665 حالة مؤكدة لإيبولا و2184 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization reports 4,665 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,184 deaths
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 4,665 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 2,184 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, linked to the Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) strain. This outbreak is the largest Ebola epidemic recorded in the DRC to date, with transmission intensifying and spreading faster than any prior event. The outbreak is characterized by ongoing transmission within interconnected geographic clusters, indicating sustained spread across multiple communities. The figures reflect confirmed cases and deaths, underscoring a protracted public health emergency in the region. No further details on infection sources or cross-border movement are provided in the report. Continuous monitoring and regional coordination remain essential to address this rapidly evolving situation in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、エボラ確定症例4,665件、死亡2,184人を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が拡大中であり、致死率も高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため即時のフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に症例・死亡者数を報告しており、DRC史上最大のエボラ流行と明記されている。BDBV株による流行で、複数クラスター間での持続的な感染拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola nella Repubblica Democratica del Congo: una persona muore ogni 30 minuti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: one person dies every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding rapidly, now killing about one person every 30 minutes. As of 2026-08-15, authorities report more than 2,000 deaths among 4,556 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,128 fatalities, three months after the May 15 declaration, marking the 17th Ebola epidemic in DRC. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days after the outbreak was declared. The current outbreak is driven by the Budibugio strain; there is no approved vaccine or cure, though clinical trials are ongoing. Health services in one of the world’s poorest countries face resource shortages, hindering response. UN humanitarian official Tom Fletcher calls for international awakening and mobilization. Historical context cites the 2018–2020 outbreak in DRC, which caused nearly 2,300 deaths among about 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱:30分に1人が死亡

triage.notes: WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言済みであり、既知の重大アウトブレイクとしてフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Флечер: Ебола побеђује, Уједињене нације убрзавају хуманитарни одговор
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fletcher: Ebola Wins, the United Nations Accelerate the Humanitarian Response
article.articleSummary: On 15 August 2026, Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo, described by UN OCHA as the fastest-growing outbreak with more than 2,000 fatalities. UN Deputy Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Tom Fletcher announced a reinforced response: an additional $30.5 million from the CERF, deployment of 20 frontline professionals, and strengthened regional leadership. Donor support has approached $300 million. The UN activated a collective humanitarian surge in early June to accelerate coordination and response. Tedros Adhan Ghebreyesus of WHO warned the outbreak could become the deadliest, with a death roughly every 30 minutes. The response prioritizes rapid scale-up, water, hygiene, health protection, and essential services in the region, aiming to save lives while awaiting further containment. The article does not specify infection sources or detailed case figures.

triage.headline_ja: フレッチャー:エボラが猛威を振るう中、国連は人道支援を加速
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が2,000人以上の死者を出し「史上最速の拡大」とされ、国際的な人道支援強化が発表されるなど、深刻性・異常性・国際的関与のいずれも該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事は感染源や詳細な症例数を明記していないが、国連・WHOによる大規模人道支援の発表という高い社会的・政治的関心を示す内容であり、既存のRRA継続案件として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: UN upozoravaju: Ebolu više ne stižemo! Virus u Kongu odnosi život za životom, svet mora hitno da reaguje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN warns: We can't keep up with Ebola anymore! The virus in Congo is taking life after life; the world must act urgently.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding at an alarming rate, and the United Nations warns the world cannot keep up. UN Deputy Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Tom Flečer said the outbreak is a race against time as the virus is currently ‘winning,’ and he cited Tedros Adanom Gebrejesus’s warning that it could become one of the deadliest if action is not taken. In response, the UN held an emergency Inter-Agency Standing Committee meeting and agreed to significantly accelerate the joint humanitarian response. Donors have mobilized nearly $300 million, with an additional $30.5 million from the UN Central Emergency Response Fund (CERF). Twenty more field experts and a senior regional coordinator have been deployed. The plan covers patient care, infection control, water, sanitation, healthcare, and other basic needs. More than 2,000 lives have been lost; many people remain at risk.

triage.headline_ja: 国連が警告：もはやエボラに追いつけない！コンゴでウイルスが命を次々と奪う、世界は緊急対応が必要
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大し2000人以上が死亡、国連が緊急対応を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 国連が緊急人道対応を要請し、3億ドル近い資金が動員されるなど、国際的関与レベルの高い重大なエボラ流行事案。続報でWHOの公式リスク評価・IHR通知状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتّسع في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 54 منطقة صحية - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola expands in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 54 health zones.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is expanding rapidly, becoming the largest and fastest-spreading yet. The outbreak has spread to 54 health zones across six provinces, after being confined to the Mongbapo area in Ituri Province. Confirmed cases total 4,665 with 2,184 deaths, a case-fatality rate of 46.8%. The humanitarian crisis, insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement hinder response and heighten the risk of wider spread. Surveillance is being strengthened, treatment centers expanded, and health workers trained. In France, no secondary infections have been reported after a traveler case on 24 June, while Uganda maintains enhanced surveillance amid ongoing risk of transmission from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で54の保健地区に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大・最速拡大のエボラ流行が54保健地区に及び致死率46.8%と深刻。国際的拡大（フランスへの渡航関連症例）も確認されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: وفاة مصاب كل نصف ساعة... الأمم المتحدة تحذر من سلالة إيبولا فتاكة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient dies every half hour... United Nations warns of a deadly Ebola strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is described as the fastest-spreading. The UN humanitarian chief says the outbreak has killed at least 2,128 and sickened over 4,500 since it began on May 15. Cases have been reported in six DRC provinces and in Uganda, near the South Sudan border. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain causes hemorrhagic fever and currently has no approved treatment or vaccine. This is the 17th Bundibugyo outbreak in the DRC. Donor funding totals about $300 million, plus $30.5 million from the UN emergency fund, on top of $24 million already allocated to DRC and four other countries (roughly $54.5 million). Twenty more staff deployed; calls to expand safe burials, triple treatment capacity, enhance contact tracing, and strengthen water, sanitation, and health services as the world is urged to act.

triage.headline_ja: 30分ごとに患者が死亡…国連、コンゴ民主共和国での致死的エボラ株流行に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）が発生し、死者2,128人・感染者4,500人超、複数州とウガンダへの拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCが主題の流行を報告し、ウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大に言及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。治療薬・ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラ株の17回目の流行であり、致死率が非常に高い点にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dosen ISTA Gelar Skrining TBC dan Latih Warga Parung Panjang Bogor Buat 'Trilogi Antiseptik'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ISTA Lecturer Conducts TB Screening and Trains Parung Panjang, Bogor Residents to Create the 'Antiseptic Trilogy'.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) education and screening were conducted in Parung Panjang, Bogor Regency, West Java, Indonesia, under a Community Service Program (PKM) by ISTA lecturers in collaboration with Paguyuban Warga Mataram Raya. In a session at Masjid An-Nur, 61 participants received TB risk education, clinical symptom overview, and guidance on interrupting transmission, alongside broader Clean and Healthy Living Behavior (PHBS) training. The outreach also included TB screening and equipment for home hygiene, culminating in the development of the 'Antiseptic Trilogy'—three household products: strawberry-scented hand soap, lime-scented dish soap, and lemongrass-scented floor cleaner—produced to promote hygiene. Post-session knowledge scores rose from 5.75 to 8.75, indicating effective information transfer and engagement. The initiative emphasizes community-driven health awareness and practical steps to prevent TB transmission, with interactive leaflets reinforcing messages.

triage.headline_ja: ISTA講師が結核スクリーニングを実施、ボゴール県パルンパンジャン住民に「消毒剤トリロジー」の作り方を指導
triage.triage_reason: 地域コミュニティによる結核啓発・スクリーニング活動の紹介記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の風土病である結核に対する地域コミュニティの教育・啓発活動を報じるものであり、新たな感染拡大や異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Siết chặt quản lý dịch bệnh trong chăn nuôi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tighten Disease Control in Livestock Farming
article.articleSummary: As of the first seven months of 2026 in Lao Cai province, livestock production continued to grow despite extreme weather raising disease risks. Cattle herd reached about 1,475,090 (98.34% of annual plan, +0.16% YoY); poultry stock 13.215 million; live meat production 99,373 tons, up 2.22%. The province maintains 1,178 farm facilities meeting farm standards, including 13 large farms and seven closed-linkage chains, with a shift toward centralized, biosecure farming. Although endemic diseases have not spread widely, hot, humid, and flood-prone conditions could foster pathogens. African swine fever remains a reference point; households like La Thi Duyen implement early preventive measures: isolated enclosures (>1,000 m2), strict access control, weekly sanitation, microbial products for sanitation and waste treatment, vaccination, and proper waste management. Authorities reinforce vaccination schedules, movement controls of animals and products, and routine veterinary supervision, aiming to bolster disease prevention and protect livelihoods amid market fluctuations.

triage.headline_ja: 畜産業における疾病管理の強化
triage.triage_reason: 実際のASF発生報告ではなく、ラオカイ省における家畜疾病予防・管理体制強化に関する一般的な行政記事であり、具体的なアウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はASFの実際の発生事例を報告するものではなく、家畜疾病一般に対する予防的措置（バイオセキュリティ強化、ワクチン接種、移動管理）を紹介する内容。ASFは過去の参照例として言及されているのみで、現在進行形のアウトブレイクの記述はないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية.. فشو إيبولا في (54) منطقة صحية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo... Ebola outbreak in 54 health zones.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is the largest and fastest-spreading in the country’s history. As of 15 August 2026, it has extended to 54 health zones across six provinces, after being initially confined to the Mongobobo area in Ituri. Confirmed cases total 4,665 with 2,184 deaths (case fatality 46.8%). The humanitarian crisis, insecurity, displacement, and cross-border population movement hinder response and raise the risk of further spread. Response measures include enhanced surveillance, expanded treatment centers, and health-worker training. In France, no secondary cases were reported following an imported infection detected on 24 June. Uganda maintains heightened cross-border surveillance due to ongoing risk of transmission from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国…エボラ出血熱が54の保健地区に拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRC史上最大・最速拡大のエボラ流行と警告し、致死率46.8%、6州54保健地区に拡大、フランスへの輸入例も発生しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: フランスでの輸入症例やウガンダの越境監視は言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行として国際的な注目度が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Bas-Uele becomes the 6th province affected, One person every 30 minutes is killed in this outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to surge; in the past 24 hours, 62 new confirmed Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases and 30 deaths were reported across Ituri (41), North Kivu (16), Haut-Uélé (4), and Tshopo (1). Of these, 14 community deaths and 16 deaths in Ebola Treatment Centers. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for about 85% of cumulative cases and 66.1% of last24h cases. Since the start through August 13, 2026, the DRC has logged 4,727 confirmed cases and 2,214 deaths, CFR 46.8%. Bas-Uélé becomes the sixth province affected; the first confirmed case is a person from Isiro (Haut-Uélé) who traveled to Bas-Uélé and died in Buta. Africa CDC notes the outbreak may have started as early as February, weeks before its May declaration; UN warns the outbreak is the fastest-growing and potentially deadliest, with a death every 30 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行:バス・ウエレ州が影響を受ける6番目の州に、この流行では30分ごとに1人が死亡している
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行は累計4,727症例・2,214死亡（CFR46.8%）に達し、新たな州への拡大や高い致死率、国連による「最も急速に拡大し致死的な流行」との警告があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Africa CDCは本流行が2026年2月頃から始まっていた可能性を指摘、5月の宣言より数週間前とされる。バス・ウエレ州は6番目の感染確認州で、Isiro（Haut-Uélé州）からButaへ移動した人物が最初の症例。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Welcomes Emergency Consultative Group Recommendations on Ebola Bundibugyo Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts Africa CDC to adopt Emergency Consultative Group (ECG) recommendations to guide scientific advice for DRC and other African states. The ECG, chaired by Prof. Salim Abdool Karim, endorses two Ervebo vaccination strategies under clinical protocols: (a) ring vaccination of contacts with immediate vaccination and a second dose 2–3 weeks later to generate efficacy data against Bundibugyo Ebolavirus; (b) compassionate vaccination of frontline workers under a study protocol to document incident cases, clinical course, and outcomes, aiming to assess whether vaccination reduces death risk post-infection. The ECG highlights rapidly accumulating evidence on Ervebo’s effects and states this evidence should guide and potentially modify vaccine use. Africa CDC emphasizes African scientific leadership and reliance on best available science to inform responses in DRC and across Africa.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ・ブンディブギョ対応に関する緊急諮問グループの勧告を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続しており、アフリカCDCが緊急諮問グループの勧告に基づきワクチン戦略を承認するなど、国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ・ブンディブギョ種のアウトブレイクへのアフリカCDCの科学的対応（ワクチン接種戦略）を扱っており、地域はDRCに限定される。'Africa'は大陸区分であり対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: UN relief chief warns Ebola is outpacing the response in DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-growing on record and could become the deadliest, with the epidemic killing someone every 30 minutes. More than 2,000 deaths have occurred. UN relief chief Tom Fletcher announced a rapid scale-up with nearly $300 million in donor backing and an additional $30.5 million from CERF (on top of $24 million previously allocated to the DRC and four neighboring countries). Twenty more staff have been deployed to the frontlines. The response plan doubles safe and dignified burial teams, triples treatment capacity, improves contact tracing, and deploys more experienced managers, while addressing water, hygiene, health care and other basic services needs. Heads of major humanitarian organizations pledged to turbocharge the response after an emergency Inter-Agency Standing Committee meeting. Current date: 15 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 国連人道問題調整官、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱が対応能力を上回っていると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで記録的な速さで拡大し2000人以上が死亡、国際的な大規模支援が動員されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 近隣4か国にもCERF資金が配分されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行であり、他国の具体的な発生は言及されていないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Risco alto para dengue continua em 7 regiões de Cuiabá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High dengue risk continues in seven regions of Cuiabá.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk remains high in seven regions of Cuiabá, Brazil, though the 2nd Rapid Indices for Aedes aegypti (LIRAa) 2026 shows an overall Infestation Index (IIP) of 3.4%—a medium-risk classification after previously being high. From May 26–29, 2026, 10,929 properties across 27 strata were inspected by the Municipal Health Secretariat. Seven strata (25.9%) exceed 3.9% IIP, indicating persistent high-risk pockets. The North region is the worst: Stratum 26 at 7% IIP includes Nova Canaã, Residencial Paraná, Três Barras, Colina Verde, Jardim Umuarama, Altos da Glória, and 1º de Março. The South (Stratum 2) has 6.4% IIP (Osmar Cabral, São Francisco, Jardim Passaredo, Lagoa Azul, Primor das Torres, Parque Mariana). East (Stratum 10) records 5.9% (Dom Aquino, Poção, Bandeirantes, Jardim Paulista, Lixeira). Only two strata in Guia and Sucuri are <1% (low risk). Most breeding sites are inside/around homes (36.9%), with urban litter (27.6%) and movable containers (21%) contributing.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバ市の7地域でデング熱リスク高水準が継続
triage.triage_reason: 定期的な蚊媒介指数（LIRAa）の監視報告であり、患者数急増や異常事態を示す内容ではないため、通常の公衆衛生モニタリング活動と判断される。
triage.notes: デング熱の患者数・重症度に関する情報はなく、蚊の生息密度指数（Aedes aegypti infestation index）に関する定期報告のみ。ブラジル国内の地方自治体レベルの通常業務と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: एनएल चर्चा 436: दिल्ली में स्वाइन फ्लू का प्रकोप, संसद में अमित शाह की वापसी और चमोली सुरंग हादसा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: NL Discussion 436: Swine Flu Outbreak in Delhi, Amit Shah's Return to Parliament, and Chamoli Tunnel Accident.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, NL Discussion 436 spotlights a rapidly rising Swine Flu (H1N1) outbreak in Delhi, India. The Hindi podcast episode features infectious diseases expert Dr. Trupti Gilada (17 years of experience) discussing the Delhi situation within a broader weekly news roundup. The article notes the outbreak but provides no specific case counts, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or identified infection sources. The discussion emphasizes public health context and expert interpretation of Delhi’s H1N1 activity, rather than detailed epidemiology. The program is produced by NewsLondry, with Atul Chaurasia anchoring. Other topics framed the week’s agenda, including political developments and additional national and international news, situating the health discussion within the broader current affairs slate.

triage.headline_ja: NL討論会436:デリーで豚インフルエンザ流行、アミット・シャー国会復帰、チャモリトンネル事故
triage.triage_reason: デリーでのH1N1(豚インフルエンザ)流行がポッドキャストで言及されているが、症例数・重症度・検査確定などの具体的情報が全くなく、季節性インフルエンザとしての通常発生か異常事態かも判断できないため。
triage.notes: インドでは毎年H1N1(豚インフルエンザ)の季節的流行が報告されており、本記事はニュースポッドキャストでの言及に過ぎず、具体的な疫学データ（症例数、重症度、検査確定等）が欠如している。続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mongbwalu: Resilience in a little gold-mining town engulfed by Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Mongbwalu, Ituri, DRC, driven by the Bundibugyo strain; no approved vaccine or treatment. As of Aug 12, more than 4,400 confirmed cases and over 2,000 deaths, making it the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the DRC. Mongbwalu, a 140,000-person gold-mining town, remains an epicenter amid a highly mobile mining labor force, displacement from armed violence, and weak health infrastructure. Aid funding cuts and delayed wages have hampered response; health centers and workers have faced hostility and attacks, undermining containment. Community engagement is deemed essential by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka. Medics at Mongbwalu General Hospital balance Ebola care with surveillance, while mistrust and misinformation hinder care-seeking. Recovery stories exist; Deogratias Kasereka was the first local patient to recover and now speaks publicly. Water insecurity from mining runoff worsens prevention, though NGOs have added water tanks. Despite challenges, residents continue mining to feed families, hoping for improvement.

triage.headline_ja: モングバルウ：エボラに包囲された小さな金鉱町のレジリエンス
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定4,400例超、死者2,000人超）が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と管理困難性が明確なためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行で、資金不足・治安悪化・不信感が対応を阻害。DRC史上最大のエボラ流行と報告されており、継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。
