article.articleHeadline: SPOROTHRIX BRASILIENSIS МОЖЕ ДА ЗАРАЗИ МАЧКЕ И ЉУДЕ И СВЕ СЕ ВИШЕ ШИРИ Ветеринари и микробиолози забринути због смртоносне гљивице
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporothrix brasiliensis can infect cats and humans and is spreading more and more. Veterinarians and microbiologists are concerned about a deadly fungus.
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis is a dimorphic fungus, originally causing widespread feline and human infections in Brazil, now spreading across South America to Paraguay, Chile, Argentina, and Uruguay; the United States has not reported human cases publicly. The Brazilian outbreak is ongoing, with more than 11,000 people and at least 200 dogs infected; cats are heavily affected and many die. Transmission occurs from cats to humans via scratches, bites, mutual licking, and grooming. In humans, infection causes painful skin ulcers and can progress to severe, potentially fatal disease in immunocompromised individuals, with symptoms that can appear after a delay. A 2022 case in the United Kingdom linked infections to a family that moved from Brazil three years earlier: one of two family cats was infected, and a veterinarian treating the cat was infected. The pathogen could reach crowded urban centers like Istanbul or Bangkok, with a single traveler potentially introducing it.

triage.headline_ja: Sporothrix brasiliensisは猫やヒトに感染し、感染が拡大中——獣医師や微生物学者はこの致死性真菌を懸念
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルを中心に南米複数国へ拡大している人獣共通感染症で、免疫不全者では重症化・死亡例もあり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルでの継続的な流行（ヒト11,000人以上、イヌ200頭以上感染）とパラグアイ・チリ・アルゼンチン・ウルグアイへの拡大を報じている。タイ（バンコク）やトルコ（イスタンブール）は『旅行者により将来持ち込まれる可能性がある』という推測的言及にとどまり、実際の症例発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: پشه‌ها در حال فتح جهان؛ تغییرات اقلیمی جبهه جدیدی برای بیماری‌ها ساخته است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquitoes are taking over the world; climate change has created a new front in the fight against disease.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading beyond tropical regions as climate change, urbanization, and mass human movement enable Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus to expand. Dengue cases rose from 505,430 in 2000 to 14.6 million in 2024, with over 12,000 deaths that year, and the disease is now endemic in more than 100 countries. Vector expansion is driven by trade, travel, city development, and shifting rainfall. Habitat suitability for Aedes aegypti increased about 1.5% per decade between 1950 and 2000 and could reach 3.2–4.4% per decade by 2050, with frontiers in North America and China moving from roughly 2 km/year to 6 km/year. A 2026 study projects that by 2050, under a mid-range climate scenario, about 3.29 billion people may be exposed to at least one month of dengue transmission risk from Ae. aegypti, and about 3.30 billion from Ae. albopictus. The message: mosquitoes are a growing global health threat.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊が世界を席巻中：気候変動が疾病との闘いに新たな前線を作った
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国・地域における具体的なデング熱アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、気候変動とベクター拡大に関する一般的な研究・傾向解説記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は世界規模の気候変動とデング熱媒介蚊の生息域拡大に関する将来予測・トレンド解説であり、中国を含む特定国での実際の発生事例を報告するものではない。中国は媒介蚊の拡大例として言及されているのみで、具体的アウトブレイクの主題ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Bas-Uele devient la sixième province touchée par l'épidémie en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Bas-Uele becomes the sixth province affected by the outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bas-Uele reporting its first confirmed case, bringing the outbreak to six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and Bas-Uele. The Bas-Uele case occurred in Buta; the deceased had travelled to Haut-Uele, prompting intensified contact tracing. As of 14 August 2026, the DRC recorded 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths (approximately 46.8% fatality), with about 965 recoveries and hundreds still in care. Ituri remains the epicenter, hosting around 90% of cases and 80% of deaths. The outbreak is caused by Ebola virus species Bundibugyo, for which no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists; clinical trials of candidate vaccines and two therapies are underway, with WHO exploring potential cross-protection from existing vaccines. Response relies on early detection, laboratory confirmation, isolation, contact tracing, infection control in health facilities, safe burials, vaccination when available, and community engagement, plus reinforced border surveillance and a multisectoral school plan as the new academic year approaches. A joint WHO/INSP/EOC mission to Buta supports local capacity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:バス・ウエレ州がコンゴ民主共和国で流行の影響を受ける6番目の州に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで6州に拡大し、致死率約46.8%、感染者4,665人・死者2,184人という深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ワクチンや特異的治療法がまだ存在しないBundibugyo種による流行で、致死率が非常に高く、州間・国境を越えた拡大リスクが継続している。WHO/INSP/EOCの合同ミッションが対応中。

article.articleHeadline: فليتشر: إيبولا يودي بحياة شخص كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fletcher: Ebola claims a life every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: UN humanitarian chief and OCHA Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is killing about one person every 30 minutes, the fastest-spreading on record. He urges accelerated international action to scale up the response and solidarity, warning that the virus is "winning" in the DRC if not quickly countered. The appeal stresses urgent needs for water, sanitation, health care, and other basic services in the region. Donors have contributed roughly $300 million to a dedicated Ebola fund. Congolese authorities reported 4,449 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,061 deaths as of Wednesday. The outbreak was declared the seventh in the DRC on 15 May, and two days later the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern—the highest level of global alert.

triage.headline_ja: フレッチャー氏：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が30分ごとに1人の命を奪っている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱でWHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、4,449症例・2,061死亡という高い致死率・急速拡大が報告されているため、IHR基準を複数満たすシグナルとして判断。
triage.notes: WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言しており、国際的な資金・人道支援の拡大要請がなされている。史上最速の感染拡大とされ、致死率も高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Dinas Kesehatan Palembang tangani 14.248 kasus diare hingga Juli 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palembang Health Office handles 14,248 diarrhea cases as of July 2026.
article.articleSummary: Palembang, Sumatera Selatan – The Palembang City Health Office reported 14,248 diarrhea cases from January through July 2026, across all age groups, including 5,570 children under five. There were no fatalities. Health officials linked the surge to poorer river water quality during the dry season, which elevates bacterial contamination capable of causing diarrhea. To curb transmission, the city is intensifying the Healthy Living Community Movement (GERMAS), with health workers from all Puskesmas educating residents on diet and lifestyle. Key recommendations emphasize consuming more vegetables and fruit and routine morning exercise, especially for children. The principal precaution remains avoiding river water; if water must be used, it should be thoroughly boiled before consumption.

triage.headline_ja: パレンバン保健局、2026年7月までに下痢症例14,248件に対応
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例なく、既知の季節的要因（乾季の河川水質悪化）による下痢症例増加であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地元保健局による通常の公衆衛生対応（GERMAS運動の強化）であり、死亡例なし。季節性の水質問題による地域的な公衆衛生課題であり、国際的な懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Trabajadores de salud exhaustos en Congo no dan abasto mientras el ébola supera rastreo de contactos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exhausted health workers in the Congo can't keep up as Ebola outpaces contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 2,200 people among over 4,700 cases, government figures show. It is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. Frontline workers are exhausted as community health worker Gédéon Banga Ngbape and his team scour eastern communities, identifying people who may have crossed paths with the outbreak. They investigate dozens of alerts and trace exposures to suspected or confirmed cases, aiming to ensure anyone with symptoms receives care promptly to prevent further transmission. The report underscores the strain on health workers and the persistent challenge of contact tracing amid rising case numbers while authorities push to isolate and treat patients in the east.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおいて疲弊した医療従事者、エボラ感染拡大に接触者追跡が追いつかず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ出血熱の流行があり、死者2,200人超・症例4,700人超と深刻な公衆衛生被害が生じている。IHR基準複数該当かつWPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行で、接触者追跡が追いつかず医療従事者が疲弊している状況。国境を越えた拡大リスクや渡航制限の可能性については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: 夏季警惕环孢子虫病 疾控专家详解预防关键→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant for cyclosporiasis in summer; disease-control experts explain the key to prevention.
article.articleSummary: Cyclosporiasis, caused by Cyclospora cayetanensis, has surged in the United States, with over 24,000 confirmed or suspected cases across 41 states and two related deaths in Michigan as of August 11, 2026. Clinical symptoms include fever, abdominal pain, diarrhea, nausea, and vomiting, with prolonged, relapsing diarrhea lasting days to more than a month, especially severe in immunocompromised individuals, the elderly, and children. The infection source is partly imported leafy greens, notably lettuce, where cysts can cling to leaf folds during field-to-table processing. Contamination can occur at harvesting, irrigation, washing, transport, or storage; other raw produce such as basil and raspberries may also be involved. Prevention emphasizes cooking leafy greens to at least 70°C; washing alone is insufficient. Summer heat facilitates spread. China CDC has issued alerts; China has not yet reported imported cyclosporiasis cases. High-risk groups should prefer cooked foods and strict kitchen separation of utensils.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季は環胞子虫症に警戒を　疾病予防専門家が予防のポイントを解説
triage.triage_reason: 発生源は米国で、対象国であるChinaでは輸入症例の報告がなく、CDCによる注意喚起にとどまるため、対象地域への直接的な公衆衛生上の脅威は現時点で確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国での環胞子虫症アウトブレイク（41州、24,000例超、ミシガン州で2例死亡）。中国は輸入症例なしで、CDCが予防啓発を行っているのみのため、対象国リストにおける実発生国は該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: قتيل كل نصف ساعة.. هذا ما يفعله إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A death every half hour... This is what Ebola is doing in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is contending with its 17th and largest Ebola outbreak, identified since May 15, with about 2,128 deaths among over 4,500 confirmed cases across six provinces. Uganda has reported cases, and transmissions have been detected near the South Sudan border. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever. UN humanitarian affairs head Tom Fletcher warned the epidemic is the fastest-spreading to date and urged a intensified, broadened international response. Donor support totals roughly $300 million for the Ebola Response Fund, plus $30.5 million from the UN's emergency fund, joining $24 million allocated to DRC and four other countries. The UN is deploying 20 additional frontline staff, with calls to double teams for safe and dignified burials, expand treatment capacity, strengthen contact tracing, and meet urgent water, sanitation, and other basic-service needs. Ebola was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River.

triage.headline_ja: 30分ごとに1人死亡…コンゴのエボラ出血熱が引き起こしていること
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模となる第17次エボラ流行が発生し、4500例超・死者2128人に達し、ウガンダや南スーダン国境付近にも伝播が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。UNが国際支援強化を要請しており、資金拠出も進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Mẹ kể hành trình con điều trị viêm màng não do thủy đậu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mother recounts her child's journey through treatment for varicella-induced meningitis.
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-08-15, in Nghệ An province, Vietnam, a 7-year-old boy from Do Luong commune developed fever and a vesicular rash, initially diagnosed as hand-foot-mouth disease. Five days later, fever persisted above 39°C with lethargy, seizures, vomiting and delirium, leading to hospital care. Laboratory tests confirmed varicella (chickenpox) with meningitis (CSF inflammatory signs). He received intravenous antiviral therapy, anti-inflammatory drugs, and measures to reduce intracranial pressure. After one week, fever resolved and seizures stopped, but monitoring continued. The mother, after close contact, also developed varicella and recovered after about 20 days. CSF in the child returned to normal, with a low risk of neurological sequelae, and discharge followed. VNVC experts note that chickenpox and HFMD can start with fever and vesicular rashes but differ in lesion distribution, underscoring vaccination and hygiene. Varicella vaccines are available; EV71 vaccine for HFMD is under consideration; parents should monitor symptoms and seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 水疱瘡による髄膜炎で治療を受けた我が子の経過を母親が語る
triage.triage_reason: 単一の小児例における水疱瘡合併髄膜炎の症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事象や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個別症例の啓発的な報道記事であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。水痘は既知の予防可能疾患でありワクチンも存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Rondônia está entre os estados com maiores índices de hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rondônia is among the states with the highest rates of viral hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: Rondônia ranks among Brazilian states with the highest viral hepatitis rates, according to the Viral Hepatitis Epidemiological Bulletin 2026 released by the Ministry of Health in July. The state has the second-highest Hepatitis B detection rate in the country: in 2025, 406 new Hepatitis B cases, a rate of 23.2 per 100,000 inhabitants—more than four times the national average of 5.2; Acre recorded the highest rate at 30.2. From 2000 to 2025 Rondônia registered 11,367 Hepatitis B diagnoses, representing 24.6% of Northern Region cases in the period. In 2025, Rondônia reported 201 new Hepatitis C cases, equating to 11.5 per 100,000 inhabitants. Porto Velho, the state capital, ranks fifth among Brazilian capitals in Hepatitis C incidence. Among pregnant women, 2025 saw 16 Hepatitis B cases, a rate of 0.7 per 1,000 live births versus 0.3 nationally.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドニア州、ウイルス性肝炎の発生率が最も高い州の一つに
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症（B型・C型肝炎）の統計報告であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な流行を示すものではない。国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は保健省の疫学速報に基づく統計報告であり、突発的な感染症アウトブレイクではなく慢性疾患の地域比較データ。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Por qué siete virus respiratorios compitieron en República Dominicana durante el 2025?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why did seven respiratory viruses compete in the Dominican Republic during 2025?
article.articleSummary: Seven respiratory viruses circulated in the Dominican Republic in 2025, led by influenza, COVID-19, and RSV, creating a complex health picture. Epidemiologist Clemente Terrero links this surge to pandemic-era changes: prolonged isolation reduced incidence, and resumed social activity spurred a rebound, a pattern seen in Spain and China. Influenza was the most incident disease, mainly affecting children and young adults, with higher clinic visits and hospitalizations as it co-circulated with other viruses. Dengue paused after a 2023 epidemic (over 27,000 cases); Terrero had not seen a dengue case since January 2025 until a single case last week, noting serotype 3 had ceased but serotype 2 could trigger new cases. Leptospirosis rose, affecting young adults in rural areas with higher incidence and mortality. Dengue cases in Latin America rose from about 2 million to over 10 million in 2023. Strengthening surveillance, environmental prevention, and continued vaccination for preventable diseases are essential.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ2025年にドミニカ共和国で7つの呼吸器ウイルスが競合したのか？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症の通常範囲内の流行状況を解説する記事であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、レプトスピラ症の増加や新型デング血清型の懸念など経過観察に値する情報を含む。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はドミニカ共和国（対象国リスト外）における呼吸器ウイルス流行状況の分析。スペインと中国はパンデミック後の同様のパターンの比較例として言及されているのみで、中国での具体的な発生イベントではないため参考程度。デングの血清型変化とレプトスピラ症の増加傾向は今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: Surto de Ébola pelo vírus Bundibugyo está a aumentar na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak is increasing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in intense, geographically linked transmission, the WHO says, the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the DRC and expanding faster than any prior event. By 12 August 2026, there were 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths (case fatality 46.8%). Initial transmission was confined to Mongbwalu in Ituri, but the outbreak now covers 54 health zones across six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé. Bas-Uélé recently reported a confirmed case in Buta with travel history to Haut-Uélé and onset 4 August. Response includes expanded treatment centers and health worker training. France reported an imported case on 24 June with no secondary transmission by 14 August. Uganda's most recent imported case discharged 16 July; 42-day monitoring ends 27 August; ongoing cross-border risk keeps surveillance high.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの流行が拡大中
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラアウトブレイクで6州54保健地区に拡大し、フランス・ウガンダへの輸出例も発生。IHR基準の複数該当により国際的懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 致死率46.8%、症例4,665例・死亡2,184例。フランス（6/24輸入例、二次感染なし）とウガンダ（監視は8/27終了予定）への越境拡大あり。フランス・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: El virus del ébola mata a una persona cada 30 minutos en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus kills one person every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating, with more than 2,128 deaths among 4,566 confirmed cases, three months after the outbreak was declared on May 15. The UN warns that the epidemic is the fastest-spreading on record and is claiming a life roughly every 30 minutes. Health systems in the DRC, one of the world’s poorest, lack resources to contain it. UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher urged the international community to wake up and mobilize, deploying 20 additional frontline staff and securing 30.5 million USD from the UN CERF to bolster the response. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo variant driving this outbreak, and authorities warn many more are at risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスが30分に1人の割合で死者を出している
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がDRCで急速に拡大し、死者数・症例数ともに深刻。ワクチン・特効薬が存在せず国際社会の緊急対応が要請されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: UNはこのエボラ流行を史上最速の拡大速度と警告。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特効薬が存在せず、国連CERFから3050万ドルの資金拠出と追加人員派遣が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: রাজ্যে ফের কোভিডে মৃত্যু! প্রাণ গেল দিঘা স্টেট জেনারেল হাসপাতালের সুপারের
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another COVID-19 death in the state! The superintendent of Digha State General Hospital has died.
article.articleSummary: One COVID-19-related death reported in the state: the superintendent of Digha State General Hospital died after a COVID-19 infection that caused pneumonia and lower respiratory tract infection. Family has requested a post-mortem examination; autopsy is underway to determine the exact cause of death. The report does not provide additional case counts, exposure history, or an infection source, and lacks further clinical details. This represents another fatality linked to COVID-19 in the region. The article cautions readers about misinformation on social media and says a fuller update will follow once verified. No vaccination status or travel history is mentioned. Published on 2026-08-15.

triage.headline_ja: 州で再びコロナウイルスによる死亡！ディガ州立総合病院の院長が死去
triage.triage_reason: 単発のCOVID-19関連死亡例であり、集団発生や異常な流行の兆候は確認されていないが、続報を要するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 単一の死亡例報告であり、感染源・接触歴・他の症例数などの情報が欠如している。SNS上の誤情報への注意喚起があり、続報待ちの状態。

article.articleHeadline: 联合国追加资金应对埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations to provide additional funding to tackle the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has escalated since its May 15 declaration. As of August 13, 2026, the cumulative confirmed cases reach 4,727 with 2,214 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus characterized the outbreak as potentially the second largest in recorded history, possibly exceeding the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. On August 14, the United Nations announced an additional 30.5 million USD from the Central Emergency Response Fund to bolster response efforts, supplementing the prior 24 million USD allocated to DRC and four neighboring countries. The UN will also deploy 20 more frontline staff. The expanded Ebola response plan doubles safe-burial teams, triples treatment capacity, strengthens contact tracing, and places more experienced managers on the ground, while ensuring water, sanitation, medical, and other essential services for affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ出血熱流行対応のため追加資金を拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は累計4,727例・死者2,214人に達し、WHO事務局長が史上2番目の規模になり得ると発言するなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響があり、国連が追加資金・人員を投入するなど国際的関心・支援の必要性が明確であるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCでの流行を主題としており、Angolaでの発生には言及がないため除外した。近隣4か国への資金配分に言及があるが国名は明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: CCZ faz feira de adoção e testes de leishmaniose em Araçatuba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Folha da Região: CCZ holds an adoption fair and tests for leishmaniasis in Araçatuba.
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis testing is part of an Araçatuba event as the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ) hosts a Sunday adoption fair during Feira Viva, from 8:00 to 11:00 at Praça Hugo Lippe Jr. (Praça Olímpica). Twelve dogs are up for adoption—three adult males and nine puppies—rescued from abuse or neglect and receiving veterinary care. All animals are vaccinated, neutered, and dewormed. Prospective adopters must be 18 years or older and present a photo ID plus proof of residence. The initiative, supported by the municipality, promotes responsible pet ownership and lifelong care. The event underscores ongoing animal welfare efforts in Araçatuba, with emphasis on humane treatment and potential exposure to leishmaniasis testing at the venue.

triage.headline_ja: Folha da Região:CCZが動物養子縁組フェアとリーシュマニア症検査をアラサトゥーバで実施
triage.triage_reason: 動物の譲渡イベントに付随したリーシュマニア症検査の案内であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や流行の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は動物の譲渡イベントと日常的な動物検疫活動に関するもので、感染症のアウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Muito além de uma "micose": Várzea Grande capacita profissionais para identificar e acompanhar doenças fúngicas graves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Far More Than a 'Mycosis': Várzea Grande Trains Professionals to Identify and Monitor Serious Fungal Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Two-day capacity-building workshop at Hotel Fazenda Mato Grosso, Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, equips Vigilância em Saúde professionals from Várzea Grande and other municipalities to implement the endemic and opportunistic mycoses surveillance system (Sistema Micosis) across Mato Grosso. The focus is sporotrichosis transmission, primarily through contact with infected animals, especially cats, which can cause skin lesions and, without timely diagnosis and treatment, progress to more severe disease. The system will allow notification, patient tracking, and treatment flow, including pharmacist review for medication dispensing. Deployment will be gradual, starting with structuring the workflow in primary care and referrals to specialized services for continued investigation and care. Beyond case finding, the registry will support epidemiological understanding, enabling prevention planning and public health actions. The training emphasizes turning case identification into ongoing information and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: 「単なる真菌症」ではない：ヴァルゼア・グランデ市が重篤な真菌感染症の特定・追跡のため専門職の能力強化研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: サーベイランス体制強化に関する行政的・教育的な取り組みの記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシス（皮膚糸状菌症）の地域サーベイランスシステム構築のための研修に関する記事。感染症アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Gurgaon News: डेंगू का एक नया मामला, मलेरिया से राहत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gurgaon News: A new dengue case, relief from malaria.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, Gurugram district reports a new dengue case, bringing total dengue infections to 20; no dengue-related deaths have been confirmed. On Saturday, there were no new malaria cases, leaving the year’s malaria tally at four. These figures come from the health department’s Saturday Malaria-Dengue Bulletin, which provides district-level updates on vector-borne disease activity. The bulletin confirms ongoing dengue transmission in the district but does not specify the infection source, patient details, symptoms, or laboratory confirmation in the published summary. No information on imported or exported cases is provided. The report underscores ongoing dengue circulation and a relatively low malaria burden for the year, with no malaria deaths reported so far in Gurugram.

triage.headline_ja: グルガオンニュース:デング熱の新規症例1件、マラリアは小康状態
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の定例統計報告であり、症例数は少なく死亡例もなし。異常性・重大性・国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: インド・グルガオン地区の定例マラリア・デング熱週報であり、通常の季節的なベクター媒介性疾患活動の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Foz do Iguaçu começa a produzir mosquitos com a bactéria Wolbachia para nova etapa de soltura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foz do Iguaçu begins producing Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes for a new phase of releases
article.articleSummary: Foz do Iguaçu, Brazil, begins the second phase of releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti to curb dengue. Production started 2026-08-13 at the Regional Production/Insectary, with 1.2 thousand capsules per package and 911 pots prepared for release on 2026-08-25 across 28 neighborhoods (e.g., Jardim Alvorada, Jardim Bourbon, Jardim Maracanã, Itaipu B). Larvae develop to adults in five to seven days; water is removed the day before release. A pre-release community survey accompanies operations to assess knowledge and readiness. The effort expands Wolbachia coverage from roughly 50% to 100% of the city. Dengue remains monitored: about 3,400 cases notified, 35 confirmed; no deaths reported. The Wolbachia method biologically spreads the bacteria to reduce transmission and complements vector-control efforts. Led by Fiocruz with support from the Ministry of Health, Paraná Health Secretariat, Itaipu Binacional, and Wolbito do Brasil.

triage.headline_ja: フォス・ド・イグアスがウォルバキア感染蚊の生産を開始、新たな放出フェーズへ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防的ベクター対策(ウォルバキア法)に関する通常の公衆衛生プログラムの進捗報告であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱対策としてのウォルバキア菌感染蚊の放出プログラムの進捗を報告するもの。死者はなく、症例数（3400件通知、35件確定）も特段の急増を示すものではない。フィオクルスや保健省主導の計画的な公衆衛生対策であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 成都一男子被确诊艾滋病，医生：传染他的，竟是在高中十几岁男生_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man in Chengdu has been diagnosed with AIDS; doctors say the person who infected him was a high school student in his teens.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-15, a 47-year-old truck driver in Chengdu, Sichuan, China was diagnosed with AIDS, linked to HIV infection transmitted by a teenage high school student who had been influenced by an outside older male. The case highlights that HIV/AIDS can affect older adults and propagates through unprotected sex and nondisclosure. Early HIV infection often presents no symptoms; the virus first targets gut-associated immune tissue and gradually weakens immunity, leading to fever, oral thrush (white tongue), mouth ulcers, chronic diarrhea, night sweats, and weight loss. Lymphadenopathy—neck, armpits, and groin lumps—may accompany illness. A roughly one-month window exists between exposure and detectable blood tests; testing during this window may be negative. The patient now receives antiretroviral therapy and tests blood every three months; his wife and child are unaware. The article stresses proactive, routine testing for timely diagnosis and intervention.

triage.headline_ja: 成都の男性がエイズと診断される、感染源は10代の高校生だったと医師
triage.triage_reason: 個別のHIV感染事例に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常な集団発生や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個人の症例報告であり、HIV/AIDSに関する啓発目的の記事。中国での集団感染や政策的対応の必要性は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Gobierno prorroga emergencia sanitaria por brote de sarampión por 90 días
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government extends public health emergency for 90 days due to a measles outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts a 90-day extension of Peru’s public health emergency starting August 15, 2026. The extension aims to contain active transmission in Puno and prevent spread to Lima Metropolitana, Callao, and 11 other departments: Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, and Apurímac. Through epidemiological week 30 of 2026, transmission persists in 118 districts across 40 provinces, with Puno accounting for 32.5% of active cases. Affected jurisdictions include Puno (83.9% of districts, 52), Arequipa (21), Cusco (14), and Lima Metropolitana (12). Forty-five districts show sustained transmission for more than four weeks; ten districts—mostly in Puno—have epidemic foci lasting over twelve weeks. The decree modifies Annex II of DS 008-2026-SA to enable emergency procurement. The Minsa leads a free nationwide SPR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccination campaign in over 8,000 facilities and mobile brigades, urging caregivers to check vaccination cards and seek care for fever or rashes.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、麻疹の流行により公衆衛生上の緊急事態を90日間延長
triage.triage_reason: ペルーで麻疹の伝播が118地区・40県に及び、12週間以上続く流行拠点も存在するため、公衆衛生上の緊急事態が90日間延長されるなど、深刻な公衆衛生影響と社会的関心の高まりが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はペルーにおける麻疹（風疹・おたふく風邪含む）流行であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（ブラジル等）は主題ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتوسع في الكونغو الديمقراطية ويسابق الوقت والجغرافيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and races against time and geography.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, expanding beyond initial areas to Bas-Uélé Province, the sixth province reached by the outbreak. A death confirmed in the city of Buta raises fears of transmission to close contacts. The outbreak numbers have risen to more than 4,600 registered infections and over 2,180 fatalities. Response faces severe challenges, including delays in detection, a fragile health system, and ongoing armed conflict, all of which hinder surveillance, case management, and containment. The geographic spread—from origin to new districts—complicates efforts to trace contacts and interrupt transmission. The brief does not specify laboratory confirmation details or infection sources, but the data reflect a high-fatality Ebola outbreak unfolding in a resource-constrained, conflict-affected setting in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大、時間と地理との闘いに
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで6州目に拡大し、感染者4,600人超・死者2,180人超と高致死率で、紛争・脆弱な医療体制により対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 致死率は約47%と非常に高く、紛争地域での対応困難により国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。続報でのラボ確認情報や国際機関の対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : six personnes déclarées guéries cette semaine au CTE de Katwa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: six people declared cured this week at the Katwa Ebola Treatment Center.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows progress at the Katwa Ebola Treatment Center in Butembo, Nord-Kivu, with six patients declared cured or discharged this week. On August 14, two women left the Katwa center; earlier, on August 12, four more patients were discharged—two non-cases and two recoveries, including a six-month-old baby. The recoveries underscore ongoing response efforts, though many patients remain in care. The outbreak's epicenter remains Ituri, with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola identified, a rarer variant. The DRC outbreak continues to spread to new areas; Bas-Uélé has become the sixth province affected, following a confirmed case in Buta, in the province’s northeast. As of August 15, total confirmed cases reached 4,727 across Ituri, Nord-Kivu, South-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Bas-Uélé. Health authorities urge vigilance, early screening, and rapid management of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボのエボラ出血熱：カトワ治療センターで今週6人が治癒宣言
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は累計4,727例に達し、新たにバス・ウエレ州へ拡大するなど、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: DRCの多州にまたがる大規模なエボラ流行が継続中で、新たな州（バス・ウエレ）への拡大が確認されており、国際保健規則の通知相当と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 'हमसे आगे निकल रहा है इबोला': महामारी से हर 30 मिनट में एक व्यक्ति की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Ebola is outpacing us': One person dies every 30 minutes due to the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, declared May 15 as Bundibugyo strain, is rapidly escalating with 2,184 deaths (~47% of identified cases) and a death every 30 minutes. Ituri Province is the epicenter, with over 4,660 cases and more than 3,400 in Ituri; six of DRC’s 26 provinces have reported cases, and Uganda has 20. UN humanitarian chief Tom Flatcher warns the virus is outrunning response and announced an additional $30.5 million from CERF, after $24 million previously allocated. OCHA deployed 20 more staff; WFP will provide hot meals in Ituri and other provinces from Saturday. Violence in North and South Kivu between Congo forces and M23 rebels further complicates efforts. About 2.6 million people in eastern DRC suffer severe malnutrition, mostly in Ituri; since late May, WFP has delivered 260,000 hot meals to treatment and isolation centers across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The UN calls for rapid, large-scale, coordinated action, safer burials, expanded treatment capacity, and improved contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラは我々を追い越している」：この流行で30分ごとに1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大し、致死率約47%、複数州・隣国ウガンダへの拡大、国連が大規模支援を要請するなど深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例（20件）も記載されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。CERFからの追加資金拠出や国連人道責任者の警告など、国際的関心・支援の必要性が非常に高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Face à la progression d'Ebola en RDC, l'ONU débloque 30,5 millions de dollars supplémentaires
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In response to the progression of Ebola in the DRC, the UN unlocks an additional $30.5 million.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is advancing three months after its May 15, 2026 declaration, marking the country’s 17th outbreak. Six provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, and Bas-Uele. The UN announces a strengthened response, adding USD 30.5 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund (CERF), atop USD 24 million previously allocated for DRC and four neighboring countries; donors have mobilized nearly USD 300 million for the response. UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher and Ebola response lead Julien Harneis oversee heightened coordination; 20 more frontline staff have been deployed. The plan prioritizes expanding patient care capacity, improving contact tracing, and securing safe burials, including doubling burial teams and tripling treatment capacity while boosting WASH and essential services. Insecurity and attacks on treatment centers, plus health worker strikes in Ituri, hinder operations and drive displacement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ拡大を受け、国連がさらに3050万ドルを追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が6州に拡大し、国連が大規模な追加資金を投入するなど国際的対応が必要な深刻な公衆衛生事案であるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 宣言から3ヶ月で6州に拡大し、治安悪化や医療従事者ストライキが対応を阻害している。近隣4カ国への波及リスクも資金配分に反映されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتفشى بسرعة قياسية في الكونغو.. والصحة العالمية تحذّر من تفاقم الوباء - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads at a record pace in the Congo, and WHO warns of the outbreak worsening - Al Ahly Stadium
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading at a record pace, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths (case fatality 46.8%). The WHO warns the outbreak could worsen, noting humanitarian crises, insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement hinder response and raise the risk of further spread. Surveillance is being strengthened, treatment centers expanded, and health workers trained to improve detection and care. France reports no secondary transmissions after an imported case on 24 June, while Uganda maintains enhanced surveillance in view of ongoing risk of transmission from the DRC. The report underscores cross-border risks with Uganda and the need for regional cooperation to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで記録的な速さで拡大…WHOは流行悪化を警告 - スタード・アル・アハリ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が記録的な速さで拡大し、致死率46.8%と深刻。フランスへの越境例やウガンダへの拡大リスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダとフランスは越境リスク・輸入症例として言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・フランスは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。フランスは二次感染なしと報告。

article.articleHeadline: Vattiyurkavu emerges as hotbed of dengue, chikungunya cases
article.articleSummary: Vattiyurkavu in Thiruvananthapuram district, Kerala, has emerged as a hotbed of dengue and chikungunya, prompting a two-week campaign of prevention and control. District health authorities report high Aedes vector indices; dengue cases in August exceed 700 (confirmed and probable) and chikungunya about 25 in the district, with 101 chikungunya cases recorded in the district until August 12 and 54 from Vattiyurkavu. Health officials note that Vattiyurkavu is the hotspot for both diseases across the district. The plan includes house-to-house visits, intensified source reduction, and vector control despite observed community apathy. Aedes are container breeders; even a teaspoon of water can support egg-laying. Fogging to kill adults will run from Monday, followed by surveillance and source reduction for two to three weeks, with potential Kerala Public Health Act enforcement if residents don’t cooperate; contingency teams deployed per ward.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァッティユールカーヴがデング熱・チクングニア熱の流行拠点として浮上
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州の一地区における季節性のデング・チクングニア流行で、地元当局が対応中だが、国際的拡大や重大な渡航貿易制限のリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 毎年発生する風土病的な季節性流行であり、地元保健当局が防除キャンペーンを実施中。死亡例や重症度に関する情報はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: 联合国追加资金应对埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations to provide additional funding to tackle the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is escalating, with UN humanitarian affairs undersecretary Thomas Frechter stating on Aug 14 that the outbreak is taking hold. The UN will add $30.5 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to expand the response, supplement existing funding of $24 million to DR Congo and four neighboring countries, and deploy 20 more frontline staff. The Ebola response plan doubles safe burial teams, triples treatment capacity, strengthens contact tracing, and expands support to meet water, sanitation, medical, and other basic needs in affected areas. The outbreak began on May 15 in DR Congo; WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned it is the second-largest on record and could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. As of Aug 13, DR Congo reported 4,727 confirmed cases and 2,214 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ流行対策に追加資金を拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行し、WHOが史上2番目の規模で2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性を警告しており、国際的な資金・人員支援が展開されるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題として言及されており、Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。致死率は約46.8%と極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: রাজ্যে ফের কোভিডে মৃত্যু! প্রাণ গেল দিঘা স্টেট জেনারেল হাসপাতালের সুপারের
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another COVID death in the state! The superintendent of Digha State General Hospital has died.
article.articleSummary: On August 15, 2026, West Bengal’s Digha State General Hospital superintendent, Dr. Sandip Bag, 43, died amid a COVID-19–related illness. He developed sudden breathlessness two days earlier and was diagnosed with Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome; he was transported to SSKM Hospital, with stabilization attempted in Chandipur and Tamluk en route. Physicians reported deep infection of the lungs and lower respiratory tract with pneumonia, triggering a severe inflammatory response. The death certificate cites Massive Acute Myocardial Infarction as the immediate cause, reflecting a sudden loss of blood supply to a large portion of the heart in the context of a COVID-induced pulmonary infection. Chest X-ray showed diffuse white-out lungs described as sponge-like, with pneumonia believed to have spread to other body parts. An autopsy has been ordered to determine the exact cause. Health Minister Dr. Shardwata Mukhopadhyay mourned the loss and praised the district hospital chief during a recent visit.

triage.headline_ja: 州でまた新型コロナ死亡例！ディガ州立総合病院の院長が死去
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19による個別の死亡事例であり、新規性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既知の疾患の単発症例報告に留まる。
triage.notes: 個人（病院長）のCOVID-19関連死亡事例の報道であり、集団感染やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。地域として西ベンガル州（インド）のみが該当し、バングラデシュは記事本文に主題として登場しない。

article.articleHeadline: Amplían por 90 días emergencia sanitaria por brote de sarampión y riesgo de contagio en 11 regiones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health emergency extended for 90 days due to measles outbreak and risk of contagion in 11 regions.
article.articleSummary: Peru extends its health emergency for 90 days due to a measles outbreak with local transmission confirmed in Puno and high risk of spread to Lima Metropolitan, Callao, and 11 regions. The measure starts August 15, 2026, covering Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios and Apurímac (Supreme Decree 013-2026-SA). The Ministry of Health, the National Institute, Lima Metropolitan health networks, and regional DIRESA offices will implement actions per the emergency plan and continue procurement of required goods and services, reporting activities and resources at the end. As of epidemiological week 30-2026, measles cases were identified in 40 provinces and 118 districts nationwide; Puno accounts for 32.5% of active transmission. 83.9% of affected districts are in Puno (52), Arequipa (21), Cusco (14), and Lima Metropolitan (12). 45 districts have sustained transmission >4 weeks; 10 districts, mainly in Puno, show persistence >12 weeks. The SPR vaccination campaign continues at over 8,000 health centers and mobile points nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の流行と11地域における感染リスクにより、衛生非常事態が90日間延長
triage.triage_reason: ペルーで麻疹の地域内伝播が確認され、40県118地区に拡大、10地区で12週以上の持続的伝播が続いており、政府が90日間の衛生非常事態を延長するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントはペルー国内での麻疹流行であり、対象国リスト（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、コンゴ民主共和国、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）には該当しないため、verified_locationsは空とした。発生地域にブラジルが含まれるが、記事本文はペルー国内の状況のみを扱っており、ブラジルへの拡大の言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: قتيل كل نصف ساعة.."إيبولا" يفتك بالكونغو وتحذيرات من انتشاره في إفريقيا | البوابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A death every half hour... "Ebola" ravages the Congo and warnings about its spread in Africa | Al-Bawaba
article.articleSummary: Ebola is ravaging the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Tom Fletcher, UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs, warning that a death occurs every 30 minutes. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the country has recorded over 4,500 infections and more than 2,128 deaths. The spread spans six provinces, with cases detected in Uganda and areas near the South Sudan border, raising fears of wider transmission. The United Nations has allocated an additional $30.5 million from the emergency fund, joining $24 million already allocated; international donors total around $300 million. Twenty more frontline staff have been deployed, and there are calls to double response teams, strengthen treatment centers, expand contact tracing, and ensure dignified, safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: 30分に1人が死亡…「エボラ」がコンゴを蝕む、アフリカでの拡大に警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,500人超の感染、2,128人超の死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダ・南スーダン国境付近にも拡大の兆候があり、国際的な資金・人員支援が動員されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよび南スーダンでの症例発生が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCが主たる発生国である。

article.articleHeadline: മലപ്പുറം ജില്ലയില്‍ എലിപ്പനി കേസുകള്‍ വര്‍ധിക്കുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of elephantiasis are increasing in Malappuram district.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 15, 2026, Malappuram district in Kerala reports 116 laboratory-confirmed elephantiasis (lymphatic filariasis) cases, with two deaths this month: a 57-year-old Edavathiruthy resident on Aug 6 and a 45-year-old Manjeri native on Aug 9. In the past week, 40 people with elephantiasis symptoms sought care; meanwhile, fever remains high, with 16,634 fever patients treated in government hospitals over the last week and an average of over 2,000 daily. Areas reporting cases include Edavannur, Manjeri, Vettakkode, Kavannur, Thrippanachi, Anakkayam, Thrikkalangod, Kondotti, Chokad, Chunkathara, Nilambur, Thirunavaya, Marakkara, and Mangalassery. At-risk groups are agricultural workers in paddy fields, cleaners, and other outdoor laborers. Health authorities are providing doxycycline prophylaxis to those at risk and urge hospital care for severe body pains with fever or eye redness; emphasis on hygiene and sanitation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: マラプラム県でレプトスピラ症（鼠熱病）の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケララ州マラプラム県でレプトスピラ症の確認症例116件・死亡2件が報告されているが、動物媒介感染症でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事タイトル・疾患名フィールドは『象皮病(リンパ性フィラリア症)』となっているが、原文マラヤーラム語見出し（എലിപ്പനി＝レプトスピラ症）およびソースURL・記事内容（発熱、doxycycline予防投与、農業従事者リスク等）から、実際はレプトスピラ症の記事と判断される。Bluedotの疾患分類・翻訳の誤りと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Claro chegama 23 casos de dengue | JC Rio Claro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Claro reaches 23 dengue fever cases | JC Rio Claro
article.articleSummary: Rio Claro, Brazil reports 23 dengue fever cases this year, with a new case added, per the Epidemiological Surveillance bulletin released Friday. Health authorities keep the municipality on high alert to curb the mosquito vector amid El Niño–driven rainfall, with March–April forecasts signaling heightened transmission risk. Residents are urged to act now: remove any water-holding containers and keep yards clean; eight ecopoints are available, along with regular waste collection, bulky waste pickup, and selective recycling. Key symptoms include high fever above 38.5°C, severe muscle pains, eye movement–related pain, general malaise, loss of appetite, headache, and red skin rashes. In severe dengue, patients may experience intense, ongoing abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, and mucosal bleeding. The initial febrile phase can be hard to identify, underscoring the need for preventive actions and ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: リオ・クラーロでデング熱23症例に | JC Rio Claro
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一地方都市における例年規模のデング熱発生報告であり、症例数も少なく異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年季節的に発生する疾病であり、今回の23症例は地域の通常監視活動の一環として報告されたもの。特段の異常性・重症例急増の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: ¿ALERTA de sarampión en Perú? Minsa amplía EMERGENCIA SANITARIA por 90 días ante transmisión activa y RIESGO de expansión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Alert in Peru? MINSA Extends Public Health Emergency for 90 Days in Light of Active Transmission and Risk of Spread
article.articleSummary: Measles alert in Peru: MINSA extends the Public Health Emergency for 90 days starting 15 August 2026 due to ongoing outbreak and confirmed local transmission in Puno, with high risk of spread to Lima Metropolitana, Callao and 11 other regions. The measure, under Decree Supremo No. 013-2026-SA, reinforces epidemiological surveillance, vaccination, prevention, control, and case care. By epidemiological week 30 of 2026, measles cases have been detected in 40 provinces and 118 districts. Puno accounts for 32.5% of cases with active transmission; risk of dissemination to Lima Metropolitana, Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, Apurímac and Callao. About 83.9% of affected districts are concentrated in Puno, Arequipa, Cusco and Lima Metropolitana. Of the 118 districts with cases, 45 show sustained transmission for over four weeks; 10 districts, mainly in Puno, have persistence over 12 weeks. Vaccination remains the main tool; parents urged to ensure two doses. Symptoms include fever and rash.

triage.headline_ja: ペルーで麻疹アラート？MINSA、活発な伝播とまん延リスクを受けて公衆衛生緊急事態を90日間延長
triage.triage_reason: ペルー国内で麻疹の持続的伝播が確認され、40州118地区に拡大、政府が90日間の公衆衛生緊急事態を延長するなど深刻性・異常性の両基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本イベントはペルー国内での麻疹アウトブレイクであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。発生地域にBrazilが含まれているが、記事はペルーの状況のみを扱っておりブラジルでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情歷來「擴散最快」 聯合國：每30分鐘就有1人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo Ebola outbreak is the fastest-spreading in history; UN: one person dies every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak, the fastest-spreading on record, is caused by Bundibugyo virus. Since May 15, there are over 4,500 confirmed cases and at least 2,128 deaths. The epidemic has extended to six DRC provinces and into neighboring Uganda, with cases near the South Sudan border. Ebola transmits via contact with infected bodily fluids and can cause hemorrhagic fever. No therapy or vaccine is available for Bundibugyo virus per the report. Ituri Province frontline workers were burying an infected individual, illustrating local impact. UN OCHA warns deaths occur every 30 minutes and urges intensified international aid. Global funding approaches USD 300 million, plus USD 30.5 million emergency fund and USD 24 million previously allocated; 20 more frontline staff deployed. Calls to double manpower, triple treatment capacity, strengthen contact tracing, and improve water and health services.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は史上「最速の拡大」、国連：30分に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで6州に拡大し、ウガンダにも波及、致死者数・症例数も甚大でIHR基準を複数満たすため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主題国として明確。

article.articleHeadline: Liên hợp quốc: Cứ 30 phút lại có 1 người chết vì Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: Every 30 minutes one person dies from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) is the fastest-spreading yet, with a death every 30 minutes. Since it began on 15 May, 2,184 deaths (about 47% of cases) have occurred among over 4,660 infections nationwide; Ituri Province accounts for more than 3,400 cases. The outbreak has spread to six of the DRC’s 26 provinces, and Uganda has 20 cases. Ituri is the epicenter, amid widespread malnutrition affecting 2.6 million people, more than half in Ituri. UN agencies have escalated response: CERF adds $30.5 million on top of $24 million previously allocated; WFP will provide hot meals at treatment centers from 15 August; OCHA has deployed 20 additional specialists, with more needed. Interventions include doubling burial teams, tripling treatment capacity, enhanced contact tracing, clean water and sanitation, and nutrition support, though food-security funding is only 25% funded. WHO says coordinated action across five transmission zones could reverse the trend within about three months.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:エボラで30分ごとに1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約47%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC複数州とウガンダに拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生地はDRC(Ituri州)。国連・WHOによる大規模な国際支援が展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: UN upozorava na dramatično širenje ebole: Virus odnosi jedan život svakih 30 minuta, stiže hitan odgovor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN warns of the dramatic spread of Ebola: The virus claims a life every 30 minutes, an urgent response is on the way.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-15, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is described as the fastest-growing and potentially deadliest, with a reported death every 30 minutes according to WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, as cited by the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs. UN Deputy Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Tom Flečer said the virus is outpacing the response and chaired an urgent Inter-Agency Standing Committee meeting that agreed to dramatically accelerate the joint response. A senior Ebola coordinator has been deployed to improve coordination; international donors have pledged nearly $300 million. An additional $30.5 million was allocated from the UN Central Emergency Response Fund, and 20 more professionals were sent to the DRC frontline to combat the deadly virus.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラの劇的な拡大を警告：ウイルスは30分ごとに1人の命を奪い、緊急対応が急がれる
triage.triage_reason: WHO・国連が「最速拡大かつ最も致死的な可能性」と評価し、緊急資金・人員投入を伴う大規模対応が進行中であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長・国連副事務総長による緊急声明であり、既に約3億ドルの国際支援が表明されている。フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 二战日军的疯狂计划：动用5吨鼠疫跳蚤袭击美国西海岸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Imperial Japanese Army's insane plan in World War II: Deploy five tons of plague fleas to attack the U.S. West Coast
article.articleSummary: Records reveal the Imperial Japanese Army’s Gongzi 9420 Unit, based in Singapore and southern Malaya (Johor), as the Southeast Asian hub of a bacteriological network linked to Unit 731. While publicly framed as sanitation and water services, the unit maintained a laboratory and peaked at about 850 staff. Osman Wā, a former Singapore Home Affairs Minister who had served in the unit’s lab as a youth, testified that plague-infected fleas were produced as biological bombs and shipped to Bangkok by train. In December 1944, Vice Admiral Ozawa Jisaburo proposed the PX plan: load five tons of plague fleas onto Seiran aircraft and drop them from a submarine carrier over the U.S. West Coast—San Diego, Los Angeles, and San Francisco—potentially killing millions. General Umezu Yoshijiro halted the operation to avoid retaliation. Postwar, Naito Ryōichi of 731 founded Green Cross; Ishii Shiro led 731.

triage.headline_ja: 第二次世界大戦時の日本軍の狂気の計画：5トンのペスト蚤で米国西海岸を攻撃
triage.triage_reason: 歴史的な戦時中の生物兵器計画に関する記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は第二次世界大戦中の日本軍731部隊関連の歴史的記録・歴史検証記事であり、現代の感染症発生事例ではないため、シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola vaccine trial launches as outbreak spreads in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Ituri (Bunia) has reached 3,748 cases and 1,657 deaths with 708 recoveries as of 1 August, the largest outbreak on record. Protocols written before the outbreak declaration in mid-May enabled quicker trial initiation. First Bundibugyo-specific vaccine trials began in the United Kingdom on 24 July, with a second in Canada this week; both are phase-one studies using ferrets and monkeys before WHO reviews progression. In Ituri, three testing sites have opened, with a fourth to open later this week, where trials of medicines including a 10-day oral post-exposure prophylaxis are under way and have enrolled over 25 high-risk contacts. A new 100-bed treatment centre was inaugurated in Bunia. There are no proven safe and efficacious treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo yet; results from ongoing trials are expected in months. Ervebo vaccine targets a different Ebola strain.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ流行拡大の中、新たなワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が3,748症例・1,657死亡に達し過去最大規模となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 英国・カナダでの記載はワクチン治験実施国であり、実際の感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。致死率・症例数から見て極めて深刻な流行であり、既存のEbola対応ワクチン(Ervebo)は異なる株を対象とするため有効な治療・予防法が未確立という点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo aumenta a 2.214 la cifra de muertos y 4.727 los casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises the death toll to 2,214 and the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 4,727.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 2,214 deaths among 4,727 confirmed Ebola cases (case fatality 46.8%) as of 2026-08-15. The epidemic has spread to six provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; Bas-Uele reports a fatality in a traveler from the initial containment area. No approved specific treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo virus. The outbreak is the fastest to spread since it was declared, raising concerns it could exceed Africa’s 2014–2016 West Africa record (>11,000 deaths). Public health measures remain rapid isolation, community case finding, and strict contact tracing to slow transmission. Source: EFE.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数2,214人、確定症例数4,727人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大し、致死率46.8%、6州に拡大、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 2014-2016年西アフリカのエボラ流行を超える可能性が懸念されており、感染拡大速度が過去最速とされる重大アウトブレイク。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyoウイルスによる流行である点も特筆すべき。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: إيبولا يقتل شخصًا كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو و2128 وفاة تنذر بكارثة عابرة للحدود - نافذة مصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: Ebola kills someone every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and 2,128 deaths warn of a cross-border catastrophe - Egypt Window
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the fastest-spreading on record, with more than 4,500 confirmed cases and at least 2,128 deaths, equating to about one death every 30 minutes. Infections have reached six DRC provinces, with cases also detected in Uganda near the border and concerns of cross-border spread toward South Sudan. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pains, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and possible liver/kidney failure with internal or external bleeding. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated objects, not typically airborne. Challenges include ongoing conflict, displacement, weak health systems, limited access to vaccination and treatment, and misinformation that undermines response. International funding approaches $300 million, with an additional $30.5 million from the UN emergency fund and $24 million previously allocated; rapid, scaled deployment of vaccines, mobile labs, PPE, and isolation capacity is imperative, alongside border and community engagement and rapid case finding.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴでエボラが30分に1人を死亡させ、2,128人の死者が国境を越えた大惨事を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行(4,500症例超、死者2,128人)、ウガンダへの越境拡大とスーダンへの拡大懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。国際支援(約3億ドル)が既に投入されているが、紛争や医療体制の脆弱性により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 2.000 νεκροί στο Κονγκό - Κάθε 30 λεπτά καταγράφεται ένας θάνατος
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 2,000 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — one death every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the 17th recorded there. The outbreak began May 15, and the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. As of August 15, 2026, the DRC reports 2,128 deaths and 4,556 lab-confirmed cases. The epidemic is described as the fastest on record, killing about one person every 30 minutes. The health system remains severely under-resourced. UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher urged urgent international mobilization. Twenty additional UN staff were deployed to the frontline. An additional 30.5 million USD was allocated from the UN Central Emergency Response Fund, supplementing 24 million USD already disbursed for DRC and four neighboring countries. A funding gap persists: of 518 million USD needed, about 264 million USD is secured. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain; clinical trials are underway. Context: 2018–2020 outbreak killed nearly 2,300 from ~3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴで死者2,000人超──30分ごとに1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行であり、致死率・拡大速度ともに深刻で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOはすでに2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行であり、資金不足も深刻（必要額518百万USDに対し確保264百万USD）。近隣4か国への波及も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Wash Out, Wipe Out and Chuck Norovirus
article.articleSummary: Rise in viral stomach infections, especially norovirus-like illnesses, spreading rapidly in crowded spaces in India, with notices from Mumbai and Pune hospitals. Norovirus is extremely contagious, spreading through contaminated hands, doorknobs, shared surfaces, food and water, and causes sudden vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach cramps, nausea, fever, body aches, and weakness. Outbreaks commonly occur in schools, offices, restaurants and crowded residences. Dehydration can escalate quickly, particularly in children and the elderly; seek medical care if symptoms persist beyond about 12 hours or involve repeated vomiting or diarrhoea, as some patients require IV fluids and monitoring. Norovirus differs from food poisoning, which tends to follow a single meal. Recovery centers on hydration and simple foods: oral rehydration solutions, electrolyte drinks, coconut water, plain meals, and rest; avoid antibiotics. Prevention emphasizes handwashing with soap and water, disinfecting surfaces, avoiding shared utensils, drinking clean water, and properly cooked food.

triage.headline_ja: 洗い流せ、拭き取れ、ノロウイルスを撃退せよ
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発記事であり、公的機関の発表や具体的な患者数・集団発生の報告がなく、通常の季節性ノロウイルス流行の注意喚起に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事は病院からの注意喚起を紹介する一般的な健康情報記事で、具体的な症例数や集団感染の規模、公式な報告データが記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Refuerzan la vigilancia epidemiológica ante un casos sospechosos de sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reinforce epidemiological surveillance in the face of suspected measles cases.
article.articleSummary: Suspected measles case in Santa Cruz province triggers reinforced epidemiological surveillance and control measures by the Ministry of Health and Environment. Through the Expanded Immunization Program, authorities urge verification and completion of vaccination, highlighting the Triple Viral vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) included in the National Vaccination Calendar. Travelers should ensure an up-to-date immunization status. Individuals presenting high fever, nasal discharge, conjunctivitis, cough, white spots on the inner cheek, or a characteristic rash should seek care at the nearest health facility promptly. Measles is highly contagious, spreading via respiratory droplets and remaining viable in air and surfaces for hours, enabling transmission in crowded settings. Infected persons can transmit four days before to four days after rash onset. Complications may include pneumonia and encephalitis, especially in young children, the malnourished, or those with weakened immune systems. No confirmed case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹疑い症例を受け疫学サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン・サンタクルス州での麻疹疑い1例に対する監視強化の報道であり、確定症例数や国際的拡大の情報が不足しているため続報を注視する。対象国（フィリピン等）とは無関係。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはフィリピンの地域情報を付与しているが、記事の主題はアルゼンチン・サンタクルス州の麻疹疑い症例であり、フィリピンとは無関係。確定症例数は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: QC leptospirosis casesnow 161; deaths hit 20
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Quezon City has reached 161 cases with 20 deaths from 1 January to 13 August 2026, per the 15 August surveillance update, up from 138 cases and 18 deaths reported on 4 August. Of current cases, 119 (74%) involve people aged 21 years and older, while 129 are men. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria, commonly found in the urine of infected rats and capable of contaminating dirty water, including floodwater; this highlights heightened transmission risk in flood-prone and post-flood environments. The update indicates an ongoing outbreak in Quezon City during the first eight months of 2026, as of August 13.

triage.headline_ja: ケソン市のレプトスピラ症、患者数161人に増加、死者20人に達す
triage.triage_reason: 季節性・地域限定的な感染症(レプトスピラ症)であり人-人感染はないためIHR基準は該当しないが、症例数・死者数が増加傾向にあり継続的な曝露リスクがあるため注視が必要。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はフィリピンで洪水時期に毎年発生する風土病的な感染症であり、人-人感染はない。症例数・死者数の増加は地域の公衆衛生対応（サーベイランス継続）で管理可能と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: des travailleurs humanitaires canadiens décrivent la situation | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Canadian humanitarian workers describe the situation | L'actualité.
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Bunia, Ituri Province) involves the Bundibugyo strain, with over 4,500 cases and more than 2,100 deaths since spring. The WHO notes it as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history, potentially surpassing the prior high of about 11,000 deaths. There is no vaccine or specific treatment yet for Bundibugyo, though clinical trials are underway. Canadian humanitarian workers report local improvements—greater awareness, willingness to seek care, and participation in safe burials—but case numbers continue to rise. Health workers face violence, rebel threats, and widespread misinformation. Outside hospitals, funerals pose a transmission risk due to contact with bodily fluids. Efforts emphasize safe, dignified burials and logistics for PPE and supplies from Canada, with 1.8 million dollars allocated to local Red Cross efforts under an 8 million dollar international fund, plus door-to-door community engagement in Ituri to identify and monitor 200–300 contacts daily.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:カナダ人人道支援活動家が現地の状況を語る | L'actualité
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が史上最速のペースで拡大し、4,500例以上・死者2,100人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ワクチン・特異的治療法が未確立で国際支援も行われているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: カナダは人道支援国として言及されているのみで、発生国はDRCのみ。WHOにより史上最速拡大のエボラ流行と評価されており、ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立という点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'INSP actualise son plan de riposte après trois mois - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: INSP updates its response plan after three months - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of August 15, 2026, Ebola Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts an updated response plan after three months of activity. A Bunia, Ituri workshop convened by the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) aims to accelerate interruption of transmission chains in six affected provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Bas-Uélé. The meeting gathered leaders of response pillars and partners to review lessons, identify persistent challenges, and tailor interventions to evolving epidemiology and field realities. Each pillar is to revise its action plan to strengthen impact and coordination. The overarching objective remains to reduce morbidity and mortality and prevent spread to other provinces and neighboring countries, by accelerating priority actions and boosting on-the-ground effectiveness to achieve outbreak control within set deadlines.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：国立公衆衛生研究所（INSP）が3か月後に対応計画を更新
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内6州に及んで3か月間継続しており、国際的拡大や近隣国への波及リスクが指摘されているためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州、オー・ウエレ州、ツォポ州、バ・ウエレ州）でのエボラ対応計画更新に関する内容。近隣国への拡大防止が明記されているが、具体的な渡航・貿易制限措置については言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Bunia : trois mois après Ebola, les transporteurs peinent à retrouver leurs recettes - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bunia: three months after Ebola, transporters struggle to regain their earnings - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Three months after the official declaration of the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak in Bunia, Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, transporters report a continued earnings decline linked to fear and reduced passenger numbers during May–June. Daily revenue plummeted while fixed costs persisted, though earnings have begun to rise modestly from July through August as people resume using taxis and moto-taxis. Despite partial recovery, income remains below pre-outbreak levels. Operators urge authorities and response teams to maintain public awareness and reinforce prevention measures—handwashing, avoiding risky contacts, and rapid reporting of suspected cases—to reassure the population and enable safer mobility. They stress staying vigilant and continuing to use transport with hygiene practices to support a gradual restoration of livelihoods during the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア：エボラから3か月、運送業者は収入回復に苦戦 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イトゥリ州ブニアで進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（発生から3か月経過）に関する記事であり、エボラは重篤かつ異常事態としてIHR基準に該当するため、状況確認のためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ流行の新規症例報告ではなく、発生3か月後の経済的影響（運送業者の収入減）に焦点を当てた続報記事。アウトブレイク自体は既知・継続中であり、最新の疫学状況（症例数・死亡者数等）については別途確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un décès toutes les 30 minutes en RDC, alerte l'ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: One death every 30 minutes in the DRC, the UN warns.
article.articleSummary: On 15 August 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo have expanded to a sixth province, with deaths occurring at a rate of about one every 30 minutes. UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher, speaking after an emergency inter-agency meeting in Geneva, urged the international community to wake up and mobilize, warning that Ebola is gaining ground in the DRC and that authorities cannot let the virus outpace the response. The report highlights the ongoing outbreak across the DRC but provides no laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported or exported cases. No additional locations beyond the six provinces are named.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国で30分に1人が死亡、国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行が6州に拡大し、死亡率が急増していることから公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められ、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: スイス・ジュネーブは国連の緊急会合開催地であり、発生地ではないため除外。感染源や検査確認情報は記事に記載なし。
