article.articleHeadline: WHO and United Kingdom step up Ebola response and regional preparedness
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has infected more than 4,500 people and killed over 2,000 across five provinces, with Ituri the epicentre and transmission continuing in North Kivu and Haut-Uélé. In the latest period, two-thirds of deaths occurred in communities, underscoring delays in detection and care; fewer than a quarter of confirmed cases have been identified as contacts, and the infection source remains unknown for more than half. Insecurity, displacement, mining activity and high population mobility hinder access, with some hotspots facing saturated treatment facilities, missing ambulances and health-worker shortages. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo virus, so control hinges on case detection, isolation, contact tracing, clinical care, infection prevention and control, safe burials and community engagement. WHO and the United Kingdom reviewed response gaps in Brazzaville, expanding surveillance, testing and treatment capacity, and strengthening cross-border preparedness with Uganda, South Sudan and the Central African Republic.

triage.headline_ja: WHOと英国、エボラ対応と地域の備えを強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4,500人超が感染、2,000人超が死亡する大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、国際的な対応強化と越境拡大リスクへの懸念がある。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ（Bundibugyoウイルス）流行が主題。ブラザビル（コンゴ共和国）はWHOと英国のレビュー会議の開催地であり発生地ではない。ウガンダ、南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国は越境準備の文脈での言及であり、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tracking Ebola's spread across eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) since May 2026 remains concentrated in Ituri Province. Uganda has declared its outbreak over, but DR Congo continues to see transmission, with more than 650 patients recovered by early August 2026. The response is hampered by constant movement in mining communities and insecurity, which hinder contact tracing. Lab and field teams have identified the Bundibugyo strain, for which existing Ebola vaccines do not offer protection. Vaccine trials began in June 2026 to assess candidates against this strain. International support has surged, with donations totaling over $1.4 billion pledged by international donors, the World Health Organization and Africa CDC by the end of June 2026 to bolster surveillance, vaccination, and treatment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部におけるエボラ出血熱の拡大状況の追跡
triage.triage_reason: 既存ワクチンが効かないブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が継続中で、国際的な大規模支援が行われており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既にアウトブレイク終息を宣言しており、現在はDRC（特にイトゥリ州）に限局。既存ワクチンが無効なブンディブギョ株である点、鉱山地域での人の移動と治安悪化が接触者追跡を阻害している点が特にリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: کانگو میں ایبولا وبا شدت اختیار کر گئی،ہر30منٹ میں ایک شخص ہلاک
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo has intensified; one person dies every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies, with confirmed cases surpassing 4,600 and deaths at least 2,184 (≈47% case fatality). Fatalities now occur about every 30 minutes. UN emergency response coordinator Tom Flatcher says the outbreak is gaining the upper hand; roughly $35 million is being mobilized to strengthen response. UN OCHA has deployed 20 additional staff to Ituri province, the epicenter, where over 3,400 of the 4,660+ total cases have occurred. North Kivu and South Kivu are also affected amid fighting between Congo’s army and the M23 militia, backed by Rwanda. Eastern Congo faces about 2.6 million people in severe food insecurity, more than half of whom live in Ituri. Experts describe it as the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date, requiring immediate, large-scale, coordinated action. WFP will begin delivering prepared meals to treatment centers in Ituri and other provinces from tomorrow.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行が深刻化、30分に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 症例4,600人超・死亡2,184人（致死率約47%）に達し、史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大とされる大規模流行であり、紛争地域での対応困難も重なるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダは反政府勢力M23の支援国として言及されているのみで、エボラ症例発生国としての記載はないため verified_locations から除外した。武力紛争と食料不安が対応をさらに困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: 联合国追加资金应对非洲伊波拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN to provide additional funding to tackle the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with Bunia volunteers removing the body of a three-year-old child suspected to have died from Ebola. The United Nations will provide an additional 30.5 million USD from the Central Emergency Response Fund to bolster the response, supplementing the 24 million USD previously allocated to DRC and four neighboring countries; 20 more field staff will be deployed. The plan doubles safe burial teams, triples treatment capacity, strengthens contact tracing, and places more experienced managers on the ground, while ensuring water, sanitation, medical and other essential services for affected areas. The outbreak began in DR Congo on May 15. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says this is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. As of Aug 13, 2026, 4,727 confirmed cases and 2,214 deaths have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、アフリカのエボラ流行対応のため追加資金を拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模とされるエボラ流行が進行中で、感染者4,727例・死者2,214人に達し、国連が追加資金・人員を投入するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際支援が必要な状況であるため。
triage.notes: 近隣4カ国への資金配分に言及があるが、具体的な国名（アンゴラ等）での発生確認は記事内で明示されていないため、DRCのみを検証済み地域とした。WHO事務局長は本流行が2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性があると発言しており、致死率も約47%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس "إيبولا" يتسع في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 54 منطقة صحية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus has expanded to 54 health zones in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has expanded to 54 health zones across six provinces, up from an initial confinement to the Mongbabu area in Ituri. Total confirmed cases reach 4,665 with 2,184 deaths (case fatality 46.8%). Ongoing humanitarian crisis, insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement hinder response; efforts include enhanced surveillance, expanded treatment centers, and health worker training. In France, one imported traveler case on June 24 yielded no secondary infections; Uganda maintains heightened surveillance amid continued cross-border risk. The DRC announced on May 15 that this is its seventeenth Ebola outbreak, linked to Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or widely available targeted treatment at present.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスが54の保健地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大、国際的拡散＝フランスへの輸入例）し、WPRO基準も全て該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: フランスでの輸入症例やウガンダでの越境警戒は言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・フランスは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCにとって17回目のエボラ流行であり、Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点も重症度・管理可能性のリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera fears rise as Yangon diarrhoea cases surge
article.articleSummary: Cholera fears rise in Yangon as diarrhoea cases surge. In four days hundreds of people in Yangon, Myanmar, were hospitalised with diarrhoea, with dozens testing positive for pathogens. Officials tie the spike to contaminated water and street-vendor practices; authorities have ordered temporary closures of high-risk street-food venues. Flooding and ongoing conflict strain health services during the monsoon season. The military government controls public health reporting. WHO data from 2024 is cited to contextualize risk. The outbreak is concentrated in dense urban zones, with localized Chinatown clusters highlighted as a proximity issue between vulnerable populations and high-risk food sources. Pathogen types have not been confirmed; case counts vary by outlet. Public health messaging emphasizes safe water, proper food handling, water safety, vendor restrictions, and timely medical treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コレラへの懸念高まる ヤンゴンで下痢症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: ミャンマー・ヤンゴンで数百人規模の下痢症例が急増し複数の病原体陽性が確認されており、洪水・紛争下での医療逼迫と情報統制も重なりIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべきである。
triage.notes: 病原体は未確定（コレラ疑いだが検査確定情報なし）。軍事政権による公衆衛生報告の統制があり、実際の症例数・重症度の把握には情報不足がある。モンスーン期の洪水・紛争による医療体制逼迫が状況を悪化させている可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: LHQ: Mỗi 30 phút lại có 1 người chết vì Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Every 30 minutes, one person dies from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is accelerating, with deaths every 30 minutes. The Bundibugyo-strain outbreak has killed 2,184 people, about 47% of confirmed cases, since it began on May 15 and as of August 14 has reached six of DRC’s 26 provinces; neighboring Uganda has 20 cases. UN Deputy Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Tom Fletcher warns the outbreak cannot be allowed to spiral further. In response, the UN is adding $30.5 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund (CERF), supplementing $24 million previously allocated for the DRC and neighbors, bringing CERF support to $54.5 million. OCHA has deployed 20 specialist staff to the epicenter, with calls for additional personnel to slow transmission and bolster response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:エボラで30分に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が急速に拡大し、致死率約47%、6州に拡大、ウガンダにも越境しており、国連が緊急資金を追加投入するなど国際的関心・支援が高まっているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un décès toutes les 30 minutes en RD Congo (ONU)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: one death every 30 minutes in the DRC (UN).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused at least 2,184 deaths from more than 4,600 cases since its appearance on 15 May, with UN warnings that the epidemic is spreading faster than any previously recorded. Cases have been detected in six Congolese provinces and have reached Uganda, near the border with South Sudan, signaling cross-border transmission. The United Nations and partners have mobilized about $54.5 million in emergency funding (an additional $30.5 million on top of $24 million already allocated) to support the DRC and four other countries. Authorities urge intensified actions, including doubling safe and dignified burial teams, tripling treatment-center capacity, strengthening contact tracing, and deploying 20 additional frontline agents. Urgent needs in water, sanitation, healthcare, and other essential services are emphasized to curb the spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で30分に1人が死亡（国連）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最速級のエボラ流行が拡大し、死者2,184人・感染者4,600人超、国境を越えた伝播も報告されており、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよび南スーダンへの越境伝播が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。国連による5450万ドルの緊急資金投入が発表されており、国際的関心・支援ニーズが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: প্রতি আধঘণ্টায় ১ জনের মৃত্যু! কঙ্গোয় আরও মারাত্মক ইবোলা সংক্রমণ, প্রাণীদেহ থেকে ছড়াচ্ছে রোগ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One death every half hour! In Congo, another deadly Ebola outbreak, the disease is spreading from animal carcasses.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda is driven by a Bundibugyo strain, described as the worst outbreak to date. By 15 August 2026, fatalities exceed 2,100, with roughly one death every 30 minutes. The strain reportedly spreads not only via human-to-human contact but also through animal carcasses, indicating novel animal-to-human and animal-to-animal transmission dynamics. The outbreak began in Congo in February and has spread to Uganda; vaccines effective against earlier Ebola strains are largely ineffective against Bundibugyo. Nature Medicine reports genetic distinctions from 2007 and 2012 strains, with supporting studies from Congo, Uganda, Belgium and other countries. Experts, including Kritika Kuppalli, note cross-host circulation; no vaccine has yet been successfully developed for this variant. The UN Secretary-General likened the situation to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, before vaccines existed.

triage.headline_ja: 30分に1人死亡！コンゴでさらに深刻なエボラ感染拡大、動物の死骸から病気が広がる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したブンディブギョ株エボラは死者2100人超と過去最悪規模で、ウガンダへ拡大し既存ワクチンが無効とされるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ベルギー・アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれない、または記事の主題はコンゴが中心。ウガンダは対象国リストになし。既存ワクチンが新変異株に無効であることから今後の国際支援必要性が高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 influenza cases surfaces earlier than usual in Chennai
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza (influenza A) cases are surfacing earlier than usual in Chennai, reported across several hospitals including Apollo Hospitals, MGM Healthcare, CHILDS Trust Hospital, and Government Stanley Medical College Hospital. At Apollo, Suresh Kumar notes six weeks of activity with three to four outpatient visits daily and some admissions; severe illness includes body and head pain, back pain, and extreme fatigue, with variable nasal symptoms and occasional diarrhoea. A vaccine expected by month-end is stressed, with emphasis on older adults, pregnant women, and those with underlying conditions. MGM's Madhumitha R. says influenza A has been rising in an endemic pattern, with fever, cold, cough, and sore throat; cases also seen among children. Government doctors cite testing limitations for confirmation and use Oseltamivir for moderate symptoms. Stanley Medical College Hospital's Chandrasekar mentions earlier mild cases, predicting a surge with the monsoon; August-September remains the recommended vaccination window.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでH1N1インフルエンザ症例が例年より早く出現
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザが例年より早く出現し増加傾向にあるが、重症度や国際的拡大の証拠は限定的であり、続報を注視する段階と判断。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations allocates an additional more than $30 million in funding to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in responding to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is gaining the upper hand in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with the outbreak described as the fastest-spreading on record and a death occurring roughly every 30 minutes. As of August 13, the current outbreak has 4,727 confirmed cases and 2,214 deaths. On August 14, UN Deputy Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Thomas Fritsche announced an additional $30.5 million from the UN Central Emergency Response Fund to strengthen outbreak response, supplementing the earlier $24 million allocated to DRC and four neighboring countries. The plan adds 20 field staff, doubles safe burial teams, triples treatment capacity, and enhances contact tracing and management. It also stresses meeting basic needs—water, sanitation, medical and other essential services—in affected communities. WHO has called it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and warned it could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC : Roger Kamba alerte sur l'extension de la maladie au Bas-Uélé et renforce la riposte - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: Roger Kamba warns of the disease's spread to Bas-Uele and strengthens the response
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports geographic expansion of Ebola virus disease (EVD). Health Minister Samuel Kamba confirms a first Bas-Uélé case, bringing the outbreak to six provinces. Ituri remains the epicenter; Nord-Kivu and Haut-Uele also report new cases. On 11 August, 118 new cases were recorded (Ituri 98, Nord-Kivu 18, Haut-Uélé 2), with 32 recoveries (cumulative recovered 918). Authorities stress intensified surveillance, contact tracing, vaccination, and patient care to curb transmission. Vaccination with rVSV-ZEBOV is used against Zaïre ebolavirus; however the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine exists. WHO advises evaluating vaccines against other Ebola species in structured trials. Remdesivir plus MBP134 monoclonal antibody are being tested in the PARTNERS trial in Ituri; obeldésivir is evaluated in EBO-PEP as post-exposure prophylaxis, starting July 2026 in DRC and Uganda. Education sector coordination aims to protect schools; cholera remains a concurrent concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行:ロジェ・カンバ氏がバス・ウエレ州への拡大を警告し対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行がDRC国内で6州に拡大し、1日で118例の新規感染が報告されている。原因種（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）には承認済みワクチンがなく、国際的な支援体制（WHO、臨床試験）も動いており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 聯合國向剛果民主和國追加逾3千萬美元撥款　協助應對伊波拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations allocates over $30 million in additional funding to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to help respond to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: United Nations allocates $30.5 million from the Central Emergency Fund to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to respond to an Ebola outbreak. Since the outbreak began in mid-May, there are over 4,700 confirmed cases and more than 2,200 deaths. UN humanitarian officials describe the spread as the fastest on record, with a death roughly every 30 minutes at current rates. The funding, plus the deployment of 20 humanitarian staff by OCHA, aims to accelerate action before transmission worsens. Goals include doubling safe burial teams for confirmed cases, tripling treatment capacity, strengthening contact tracing, and deploying more senior managers to scale up the response.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱対応支援のため3000万ドル超を追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例4,700件超、死者2,200人超という大規模流行で、国連が「記録上最速の拡大」と表現しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 国連中央緊急対応基金（CERF）から3050万ドルが拠出され、OCHAが人員20名を追加派遣。安全埋葬チーム倍増、治療能力3倍化、接触者追跡強化等が計画されており、既に国際支援が展開中の大規模流行。

article.articleHeadline: Supervacinação contra o Sarampo acontece neste sábado no Bosque Maia e no Shopping Bonsucesso - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles vaccination blitz takes place this Saturday at Bosque Maia and Shopping Bonsucesso - Click Guarulhos
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination blitz in Guarulhos on Aug 15 includes drive-thru at Bosque Maia (Avenida Paulo Faccini) until 16:00 and a tent at Shopping Bonsucesso until 17:00 for ages 6 months–59 years. The Vacimóvel program runs Aug 17–20 at Terminal Urbano São João and Aug 21 at SEST SENAT Jardim Novo Portugal, 9:00–16:00, offering measles and influenza vaccines at high-traffic locations. Vaccination at six universities—Uninove, Anhanguera, UNG, São Judas, Unisa—began Aug 10; Eniac vaccination occurred on Aug 10; sessions continue through Aug 20 with 9:00–16:00 and 18:00–21:00 slots (UNG Aug 18; São Judas Aug 19; Unisa Aug 20). Day D of Multivacinação on Aug 22 opens all UBSs 8:00–17:00 to update vaccination cards for children and adolescents under 15 and to vaccinate measles for 6 months–59 years. Campaign runs through Sept 1; documentation: photo ID required; vaccination card recommended; for children, vaccination card is mandatory.

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola causado por una nueva transmisión animal: qué significa y por qué preocupa a los científicos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak caused by a new animal-to-human transmission: what it means and why scientists are concerned.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-15, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda is linked to a new animal-to-human spillover involving Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Genomic analyses indicate the initial case likely resulted from wildlife rather than a reactivation of a human transmission chain. Spillover occurs when a virus from wildlife infects a person, after which human-to-human transmission can spread via direct contact with blood, vomit, feces, urine, saliva, sweat, breast milk, semen, or other fluids of the sick or deceased. Effective outbreak response centers on rapid case detection, isolation, contact tracing, and strict infection control in health facilities and communities, alongside animal investigations and community engagement. Bundibugyo Ebola poses particular challenges because vaccines and treatments vary by species; sequencing-driven identification informs therapeutic choices, surveillance, and risk communication about exposure in human–animal contact zones.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな動物由来のスピルオーバーによるエボラ出血熱の流行：その意味と科学者が懸念する理由
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダにおける新たな動物→ヒトスピルオーバーが確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、公衆衛生上の重大性と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Prorrogan por 90 días la emergencia sanitaria por sarampión en Puno, Lima, Arequipa y otras regiones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 90-day extension of the measles health emergency in Puno, Lima, Arequipa and other regions.
article.articleSummary: On August 15, 2026, Peru extends by 90 days the local measles emergency across Puno, Lima Metropolitan, Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, Apurímac, and Callao due to persistent transmission and vaccination coverage below the 95% target. Supreme Decree 013-2026-SA renews the previous emergency (DS 008-2026-SA) and updates Annex II; vaccination gaps as of August 11 keep the standard out of reach. Through epidemiological week 30, measles cases were reported in 40 provinces and 118 districts; Puno accounts for the largest share of transmission (32.5% of affected provinces). About 83.9% of affected districts are in Puno, Arequipa, Cusco, and Lima Metropolitan. Additionally, 38.1% show sustained transmission beyond four weeks, with a core 10 districts (mainly in Puno) reporting active contagion for over 12 weeks. The measure was approved by the Council of Ministers with MINSA Technical Committee support; resources unchanged.
