triage.triage_reason: 本事案はペルー国内の麻疹流行に関するものであり、対象国リスト（ブラジルなど）に該当する国は主題として言及されていないため、監視対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazilが含まれているが、記事内容はペルー国内（プーノ、リマ、アレキパ等）の麻疹流行に限定されており、ブラジルへの言及はない。対象国リストにペルーは含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Doença volta a preocupar autoridades no Brasil após novos casos em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The disease returns to worry authorities in Brazil after new cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles returns to worry Brazil in 2026 after new cases were reported. Brazil had eliminated endemic transmission (OPAS certification in 2016) but the virus re-emerged in 2018 amid migration and declining vaccination coverage. From 2018–2022, over 39,000 cases were recorded, with 2022 at 41 and 2023 zero; 2024 saw five. In 2025 Brazil confirmed 38 measles cases, all linked to importation or transmission after entry of infected people. Through epidemiological week 14 of 2026, two new cases were confirmed: one in São Paulo tied to international travel and lack of vaccination, and another in Rio de Janeiro with unknown source and no immunization record. A cluster of 25 cases occurred in a traditional community where 22 were unvaccinated. São Paulo boosted vaccination; Bahia last reported cases in 2020. Measles is highly contagious, airborne, with fever, red rash, cough, and eye irritation; transmission can begin days before rash onset.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、新規症例の発生でブラジル当局が再びはしかを懸念
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹の輸入例及び未接種者を中心としたクラスター発生が続いており、感染拡大しやすい状況かつ社会的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 麻疹はブラジルで2018年以降輸入例による散発的発生が続いており、2026年第14週までに新規2例、未接種者中心の25例クラスターが報告されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、未接種population存在による今後の感染拡大リスクに注意。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Bundibugyo Ebola Spread Undetected for Months; Cholera Hits Six Countries
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has over 4,400 confirmed cases and more than 2,000 deaths, the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak. Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases and 80% of deaths, with spread across five provinces and 53 health zones. The outbreak began in February; detection was delayed, and early cases were misdiagnosed. No virus mutation has been detected. Transmission chains remain untraced; 60–70% of deaths occur in communities outside treatment centers and among people not on contact lists. WHO plans to triple treatment capacity to 3,000 beds in 12 weeks; 80% of identified contacts are followed, but 95% is needed. Ervebo enters Phase 3 for Bundibugyo; no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine yet; cross-protection possible but unproven in humans. Gavi commits $40 million; cholera hits six countries in West and Central Africa with a $15 million UNICEF emergency appeal. Two CCHF cases in Uganda's Yumbe district, including one death.

triage.headline_ja: 週刊保健アップデート：ブンディブギョ型エボラが数ヶ月間検知されず拡大、コレラが6カ国で発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョ型エボラが4,400例超・死者2,000人超と歴代2番目に深刻な流行となっており、検知遅延・接触者追跡不足など公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 記事にはウガンダのCCHF症例（対象国外）や西・中央アフリカ6カ国でのコレラ流行にも言及があるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。エボラ流行はDRC・イトゥリ州が主な発生地であり、国際的な支援（WHO・Gavi・UNICEF）が動員されている点からも重大シグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يحصد ضحية كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims a victim every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 August 2026, the United Nations warns that Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are accelerating, with the latest data indicating a death every 30 minutes. UN agencies urge urgent international action and a broadened health and humanitarian response to the outbreak, warning that its current pace is unprecedented and placing mounting strain on affected communities. The warning highlights the need for intensified international engagement, rapid resource mobilization, and cross-cutting public health measures to curb transmission. Officials stress that the situation requires sustained, coordinated efforts at national, regional, and global levels to prevent further escalation of this deadly disease in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが30分に1人の犠牲者を出している
triage.triage_reason: エボラのDRCにおける急速な拡大と致死率上昇が報告され、国連が国際的な緊急対応を要請していることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 国連がDRCにおけるエボラ流行の急速な悪化を警告し、国際的な緊急支援を要請している。具体的な症例数・死亡者数の詳細データは記事内に不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola En RDC: Un Décès Toutes Les 30 Minutes, Alerte L'ONU | Rewmi.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: One death every 30 minutes, UN warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached its 17th outbreak, declared May 15. Three months into the response, authorities say it is the fastest Ebola epidemic on record, with 2,128 deaths among 4,566 laboratory-confirmed cases. UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher warned that the virus is outrunning the response, noting a death every 30 minutes and urging rapid, large-scale action and solidarity. The DRC’s health system remains severely under-resourced. In response, 20 additional frontline personnel were deployed. The current outbreak follows the 2018–2020 episode, which killed about 2,300 people for around 3,500 cases. The UN pressed for accelerated global mobilization to curb further spread and to prevent the virus from overtaking response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱：30分ごとに1人死亡、国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が発生し致死率・死亡者数が極めて高く、国連が国際的な緊急対応を呼びかけているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 史上最速とされるエボラ流行で、致死率約47%（2,128/4,566）。国連が国際支援の緊急動員を要請しており、継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Un mort cada 30 minuts: el brot d'èbola a la República Democràtica del Congo deixa ja més de 2.200 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One death every 30 minutes: the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already claimed more than 2,200 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 2,214 deaths among 4,727 confirmed cases, with 749 hospitalized, as of 2026-08-15. Declared mid-May, the outbreak is centered in Ituri province (north-east) and has spread to a new health zone, Buta, in Bas-Uele. The circulating variant is Bundibugyo, for which there is no approved vaccine. WHO warns of extreme severity and urges rapid action. UN OCHA’s Tom Fletcher warns of a death every 30 minutes in the DRC and calls for intensified response. The UN CERF has allocated an extra 26.3 million euros, joining more than 20 million euros already mobilized for the DRC and four neighboring countries. Twenty additional frontline professionals have been deployed; authorities say double the teams are needed for safe, dignified burials and triple treatment capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 30分に1人死亡：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者2,200人超に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死亡2,214人、致死率約47%）で、承認ワクチンのないブンディブギョ株が原因。国際機関の緊急支援が動員されておりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 流行はイトゥリ州で開始し、バス・ウエレ州のブタ地区に拡大。近隣4か国への波及懸念があり、UN CERFが追加資金2630万ユーロを拠出するなど大規模な国際対応が進行中。承認ワクチンのないブンディブギョ株である点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Normas legales: el Gobierno prorrogó 90 días emergencia sanitaria debido a sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Legal norms: The government extended the health emergency by 90 days due to measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts a 90-day extension of Peru’s health emergency, effective August 15, 2026. The government extended the sanitary emergency due to confirmed local transmission in Puno and risk in Lima Metropolitana, Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, Apurímac, and Callao. Supreme Decree 013-2026-SA updates Annex II of 008-2026-SA, directing the action plan and continuing procurement of goods and services. At the end of the period, agencies must report activities, resources used, and results. As of week 30-2026, measles cases were recorded in 40 provinces and 118 districts, with Puno accounting for 32.5% of active transmission. 45 districts have sustained transmission >4 weeks; 10 districts, mainly in Puno, have outbreaks >12 weeks. Minsa runs a free SPR vaccination campaign in 8,000+ centers; more than 340,000 doses were sent to Puno. Parents should verify schedules and complete two doses; seek care for fever and rash.

triage.headline_ja: 法規制：政府が麻疹による衛生非常事態を90日間延長
triage.triage_reason: ペルー国内での麻疹アウトブレイクに関する記事であり、対象国（ブラジル含む）における感染発生の記述はないため、モニタリング対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにBrazilが含まれるが、記事本文はペルー国内（Puno等）の麻疹流行に関する内容のみであり、ブラジルでの発生への言及はないため対象国として扱わない。ペルー自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Fletcher: Kongo'da Ebola Her 30 Dakikada Bir Can Alıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fletcher: Ebola Is Taking a Life Every 30 Minutes in the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of August 12, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing its Ebola outbreak described by UN humanitarian official Tom Fletcher as the fastest-spreading yet, with deaths occurring roughly every 30 minutes. Fletcher urged a greatly intensified international response, broader operations, and stronger solidarity to stop the virus from outrunning interventions, stressing that Ebola is currently prevailing in the DRC and more people are at risk. He called for urgent support to water, sanitation, health services, and other basic needs. About $300 million has been donated to the Ebola response fund. Officials reported 4,449 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,061 deaths in the DRC. The country declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, and WHO soon declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: フレッチャー氏:コンゴでエボラが30分毎に1人の命を奪っている
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、致死率が高く、国際的な支援要請と社会的関心が極めて高いため。
triage.notes: WHOにより既にPHEIC宣言済み。4,449症例、2,061人死亡と報告されており、既にフルRRAまたは既存評価の更新対象と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : une équipe de médecins ougandais annoncée pour renforcer la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: Ugandan doctors' team announced to bolster the response - ACP
article.articleSummary: An Ugandan medical team was announced to bolster the Ebola response in North Kivu, DRC, with deployment to Katwa health zone in the city of Butembo, currently the outbreak epicenter. Prisca Luanda, lead health coordinator for the province's military governor, said the team will help coordinate the response and assess how to ease cross-border restrictions as Uganda has shut its borders; only goods vehicles are allowed for merchants. The North Kivu provincial governor appealed for exemptions for traders, students, and patients. President Museveni reportedly promised to relax measures once the medical team arrives. The announcement follows an official mission by North Kivu’s executive head to Uganda, including a cross-border surveillance meeting in Mbarara.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ出血熱：対応強化のためウガンダ人医師団の派遣が発表される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、ウガンダが国境を閉鎖するなど国際的な渡航制限が既に発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしウガンダの国境閉鎖措置は国際的拡大リスクの根拠として評価に反映した。震源地はDRC北キブ州ブテンボ市カトワ保健区。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: tudo o que você precisa saber sobre a vacinação e a doença em 15 pontos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Everything You Need to Know About Vaccination and the Disease in 15 Key Points
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks are reported in São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, Brazil, with a rise in August 2026 among unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Elimination status remains, but outbreaks stem from imported cases in a region with international travel. Measles spreads by airborne droplets; the virus can stay viable up to two hours, and a single case can infect up to 90% of susceptible contacts, with transmission starts four days before symptoms. Early signs appear 1–2 weeks after exposure and include high fever, malaise, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis, followed by a rash starting on the face behind the ears and spreading downward. Vaccination now targets ages 6 months to 59 years in three cities, with a zero-dose for 6–11 months, MMR at Basic Health Units. Two doses confer ~98% protection; a booster is safe and reduces circulation. Exposed individuals should verify vaccination status and seek care if unprotected.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：ワクチン接種と疾患について知っておくべき15のポイント
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数都市（サンパウロ市、グアルーリョス、サンベルナルドドカンポ）で麻疹アウトブレイクが拡大しており、排除ステータス国での輸入例由来の流行かつ政府が緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施している点でWPRO複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹に関する一般啓発記事だが、サンパウロ州複数都市での輸入症例由来のアウトブレイク拡大と、6ヶ月〜59歳を対象とした緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施が報告されており、公衆衛生上の懸念として続報を要する。排除ステータスは維持されている点は留意。

article.articleHeadline: DRC reports 26 million malaria cases in 2025
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 2025 malaria burden: about 26,064,143 malaria cases and 29,938 deaths in 2025, according to PNLP Deputy Director Dr. Guy Esebe Dembo, announced during a mass administration campaign launch in Ituri. Malaria remains the country’s principal public health challenge, with historical dominance of Plasmodium falciparum; however, the 2025 species breakdown was not disclosed. The figures highlight the need to sustain and expand high-impact interventions while testing new approaches adapted to different health zones. The Ituri campaign forms part of a broader malaria prevention and response effort, aiming to reduce both cases and fatalities and to mobilize authorities, healthcare professionals, partners, and communities to strengthen control measures across the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、2025年のマラリア症例数2,600万件を報告
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCにおいて長年にわたり流行している風土病であり、本記事は年次の疾病負担統計報告であって、異常な増加や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、シグナルとして識別しない。
triage.notes: マラリアはDRCで風土病として恒常的に存在しており、本記事は2025年通年の統計発表と予防接種キャンペーン開始の告知であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: New Congolese health zone affected by Ebola as infections surge
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands to a new health zone in Tshopo province amid rising infections. As of the Health Ministry update, confirmed cases total 4,727 with 2,214 deaths, affecting 55 health zones across Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo; Tshopo now has seven affected zones. There are 749 patients in isolation or in hospital, and 976 have recovered. The outbreak was formally declared on May 15, with Africa CDC suggesting transmission may have begun in February. Ituri remains the epicenter, where a treatment center was temporarily closed due to a health-worker salary strike. UN official Tom Fletcher warned the epidemic is killing about one person every 30 minutes and announced an additional $30.5 million from CERF, in addition to $24 million previously allocated; the Congolese government has mobilized $50 million for the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、新たな保健区でエボラ感染拡大、感染者急増
triage.triage_reason: DRCで複数州にまたがる大規模エボラ流行が継続・拡大しており、死亡者数・症例数ともに深刻で、国際的な資金支援も行われているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に正式宣言されたDRCのエボラ流行は、Bas-Uele、Haut-Uele、Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tshopoの6州55保健区に拡大中。死亡者2,214人、症例4,727人、致死率は高水準。国連CERFから追加3,050万ドル、コンゴ政府も5,000万ドルを動員するなど国際支援が継続している。イトゥリ州で医療従事者の賃金ストライキにより治療センターが一時閉鎖された点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola překročila další hranici. V Kongu už zabila přes 2100 lidí a jedna věc situaci dramaticky zhoršuje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has crossed another threshold. In the Congo, it has already killed more than 2,100 people, and one thing is dramatically worsening the situation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has spread to six provinces. As of 14 August 2026, 4,665 cases and 2,184 deaths have been confirmed, including a new death in Bas-Uele and a new case in the provincial capital Buta. Unlike Zaire-ebola, Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or specific antiviral; Ervebo is not indicated for this variant. Experimental treatments are under study in Congo, including MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, but supportive care remains the cornerstone. Transmission requires direct contact with blood or body fluids; incubation 2-21 days. Early symptoms resemble malaria and can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, organ dysfunction, and sometimes bleeding. Conflict, displacement, and weak health systems hinder surveillance, PPE availability, testing, and safe burials, facilitating spread. Imported cases in Europe are rare; travelers from Congo should monitor 21 days and seek medical care if fever or other symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが新たな境界を越えた。コンゴではすでに2,100人以上が死亡し、状況をさらに悪化させている一つの要因がある
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・特効薬のないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行が6州に拡大し、死者2,184人・症例4,665人と深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスに対する承認済みワクチン・抗ウイルス薬がなく、支持療法が中心。紛争・避難民・脆弱な医療体制がサーベイランスや安全な埋葬を妨げ、感染拡大を助長している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: CAG audit finds E. coli in water, poor amenities at 458 railway stations
article.articleSummary: E. coli detected in drinking water at Indian Railways water coolers across multiple NSG non-suburban stations, with 458 of 512 stations deficient in Minimum Essential Amenities (MEA). Specific water-positive sites: Coimbatore and Palakkad Junctions (Southern Railway); Hyderabad (South Central Railway); Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Bhiwandi Road, Kalyan, Lonavala (Central Railway); Madhupur (Eastern Railway). Platform taps showed total coliforms at 49 stations (2022-23) across eight zones and 56 stations (2023-24) across nine zones. Bacteriological tests beyond total coliforms were unsatisfactory at eight stations (2022-23) and 11 stations (2023-24). The CAG evaluated 2019-20 to 2023-24 and noted gaps despite Railway Board MEA/RA/DA directives issued in April 2018, aiming for compliance under the Uniform Drinking Water Quality Protocol. National scope: 5,908 NSG stations, ~7,424 daily non-suburban trains, 292.4 crore passengers in 2023-24.

triage.headline_ja: CAG監査、458の鉄道駅で水質中に大腸菌検出、施設の不備を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインド会計検査院（CAG）による過去5年間（2019-2024年）の鉄道駅の水質・設備監査報告であり、実際の感染症患者発生や急性アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 実際の患者発生や症例報告はなく、水質検査結果に基づく行政監査報告。インフラ・環境衛生上の課題として鉄道当局内で対応されるべき事案であり、公衆衛生上の急性イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Une nouvelle zone de santé touchée par Ebola en RDC alors que les infections augmentent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new health zone affected by Ebola in the DRC as infections rise.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has spread to a new health zone in Tshopo province, bringing the total in that province to seven as infections rise. Confirmed cases reach 4,727 with 2,214 deaths. The epidemic now covers 55 health zones across Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Tshopo. Currently, 749 patients are isolated or hospitalized and 976 recovered. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, though Africa CDC notes transmission may have begun as early as February. Ituri remains the epicenter, where a treatment center was temporarily closed due to a health-worker strike over delayed salaries. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher warned that Ebola is progressing in the DRC, announcing $30.5 million in new funding from the UN CERF, in addition to $24 million previously allocated; the Congolese government has mobilized $50 million for the response.

triage.headline_ja: 感染増加の中、DRCでエボラの新たな感染地域が確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで拡大を続けており、確認症例4,727例・死亡2,214例に達し、55保健地域に拡大。国際的な資金支援も動員されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率は約46.8%（2,214/4,727）と高く、医療従事者のストライキによる治療センター閉鎖など対応体制にも課題がみられる。UN CERFやコンゴ政府による大規模資金拠出が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: CAG Flags E. Coli Bacteria In Drinking Water At Stations, Cites Violation Of Railway Board Norms
article.articleSummary: E. coli detected in drinking water at multiple Indian Railways stations, with bacteriological testing missing at 59 stations across six zones. Water cooler samples were positive for E. coli at Coimbatore and Palakkad Junctions (Southern Railway), Hyderabad (South Central Railway), and four Central Railway stations—Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Bhiwandi Road, Kalyan, Lonavala—and Madhupur in Eastern Railway. Platform taps at 49 stations across eight zones (2022-23) and 56 stations across nine zones (2023-24) showed Total Coliforms, including E. coli. Tests beyond Total Coliforms were unsatisfactory at eight stations (2022-23) and eleven stations (2023-24). The CAG report, tabled in Parliament on August 12, covers 2019-20 to 2023-24 audits and notes 458 of 512 stations deficient in Minimum Essential Amenities, amid high passenger traffic: 5,908 NSG stations, 7,424 daily trains, and 292.4 crore passengers in 2023-24.

triage.headline_ja: CAG報告、駅の飲料水からE.coli菌検出を指摘、鉄道委員会基準違反
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインド会計検査院(CAG)による鉄道駅の水質検査に関する監査報告であり、実際の感染症患者や健康被害の発生報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は水質監査報告であり、具体的な感染者数・発症事例の記載はない。今後の水系感染症リスク管理の観点から継続的な水質改善状況は注視に値するが、現時点で緊急のアウトブレイク情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola na kashe mutum guda cikin kowace rabin sa'a a Congo - MDD
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to escalate; as of August 15, 2026, more than 2,000 people have died, with authorities warning the disease is spreading at unprecedented speed—the fastest Ebola outbreak in history. WHO/UN OCHA head Tom Fletcher cautioned against letting the outbreak overwhelm response efforts, noting some towns are under threat. Ebola was declared on May 15 as the 17th outbreak in the DRC. Health systems across Congo remain among the world’s weakest, hampered by underfunding and shortages of supplies. Domestic and international health authorities have pledged to intensify joint action to stop transmission; however, there is no cure or vaccine currently available. The report emphasizes the need for sustained resources and coordination to reverse the trajectory, while avoiding speculation on specific infection sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが30分毎に1人を死に至らしめている - MDD
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速のエボラ流行が進行中で死者2000人超、WHO/UN OCHAも警戒を表明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: DRCで17回目のエボラ流行、2026年5月15日に宣言。死者2000人超、史上最速の拡大速度と報告。ワクチン・治療薬が現時点で利用不可とされており、国際的な支援強化が表明されている。

article.articleHeadline: Faridabad News: दस दिन से नहीं उठा शहर का कूड़ा, बीमारी फैलने की आशंका
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Faridabad News: The city's garbage hasn't been collected for ten days, risk of disease spread.
article.articleSummary: Faridabad, Haryana is facing a sanitation crisis as municipal sanitation workers' union strikes continue, delaying waste collection for ten days and threatening public health. The strike, with demands including regularization of contract workers, a minimum monthly wage of Rs 15,200, timely salaries, reinstatement of laid-off staff, and provision of PPE and incentives for hazardous work, is set to extend to August 18. Consequently, more than 10,000 tons of garbage have accumulated on streets, with about 1,200 tons daily from households and markets. Poor collection has worsened odors and attracted disease vectors, elevating dengue risk amid rain-driven water pooling and stagnant waste. About 20 suspected dengue patients are under treatment in government and private hospitals. Doctors urge not to self-medicate, advise prompt medical testing for fever, and maintaining water-free surroundings. Haryana Municipal Employees Union conducted Independence Day flag-hoisting and announced further actions through Aug 18.

triage.headline_ja: ファリダバード:10日間ゴミ収集されず、疾病拡大の懸念
triage.triage_reason: 衛生局職員のストライキによるゴミ放置でデング熱媒介蚊増加のリスクはあるが、疑い患者約20名のみで確定患者数や重症度が不明であり、フルRRAに進めるには情報不足。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性・地域的な流行であり、ゴミ収集ストライキという行政問題が主因。確定患者数・重症度データがなく、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : des travailleurs humanitaires canadiens témoignent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Canadian humanitarian workers testify.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo centered on Bunia, Ituri Province, has killed over 2,100 people and infected about 4,500 since spring. The World Health Organization calls it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history, potentially surpassing the 11,000 deaths from a decade ago. The causative Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine or specific treatment, though clinical trials are underway. Canadian humanitarian workers report rising local awareness and willingness to seek care and participate in safe, dignified burials, even as transmission continues amid violence against health staff and misinformation. In rural Ituri, contact tracing reaches roughly 200–300 people daily, while Bunia’s caseload overwhelms tracing efforts. The Canadian Red Cross coordinates safe-burial logistics and PPE supply; Canada has allocated CAD 1.8 million within an $8 million international aid package. Initiatives include door-to-door outreach and involving families or religious leaders to handle bodies safely.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:カナダ人人道支援者が証言
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が続き、死者2,100人超・感染者4,500人規模の深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イトゥリ州（ブニア中心）のエボラ流行に関する内容で、カナダは人道支援者の証言・資金拠出の文脈のみで発生国ではないため除外。ワクチン・特効薬不在で史上最速拡大との報道あり、既にWHO監視下にある可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: CAG flags E. coli in railway drinking water, cites norm violations
article.articleSummary: E. coli detected in drinking water at Indian Railways non-suburban stations amid a CAG audit of 512 stations. Water cooler samples tested positive at eight stations: Coimbatore and Palakkad Junctions (Southern Railway); Hyderabad (South Central Railway); Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Bhiwandi Road, Kalyan, Lonavala (Central Railway); Madhupur (Eastern Railway). Total coliforms were found in taps at 49 stations across eight zones in 2022-23 and 56 stations across nine zones in 2023-24. Non-conformities beyond Total coliforms were unsatisfactory at eight stations in 2022-23 and 11 stations in 2023-24. Overall MEA compliance is deficient at 458 of 512 stations; infrastructure like drinking water taps, seating, sanitation facilities, and signage are lacking. The report urges adherence to water-quality testing protocols and comprehensive inspections under the Uniform Drinking Water Quality Protocol. 89% of stations lacked MEAs as of the audit, highlighting ongoing sanitation and safety gaps for millions of railway passengers.

triage.headline_ja: 会計検査院(CAG)、鉄道飲料水の大腸菌検出と基準違反を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症患者発生ではなく、インド会計検査院(CAG)による鉄道駅の飲料水質監査報告であり、大腸菌検出は水質基準違反の指摘に留まる。健康被害の報告はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は監査報告書に基づく水質基準違反の指摘であり、実際の感染症発生・患者報告はないため対象国の感染症イベントとしては該当せず。

article.articleHeadline: قتيل كل نصف ساعة.. ضحايا "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A death every half hour... Ebola victims in Congo
article.articleSummary: Dubbed Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the outbreak is described by Tom Fletcher, Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs, as causing a death every half hour. He warns it is the fastest-spreading outbreak to date and calls for accelerated, expanded international response and solidarity. The epidemic has expanded beyond previous bounds into Bas-Uele, the sixth province affected. The latest update confirms a death in the town of Buta, heightening concerns about transmission to contacts. As of 15 August 2026, figures exceed 4,600 cases and 2,180 deaths. The response faces severe challenges, including delays in detection, a fragile health system, and ongoing armed conflict. The article underscores the need for urgent, broader international action to curb this deadly outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 30分ごとに1人死亡…コンゴでのエボラ犠牲者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、致死率の高さ、感染拡大の速さ、6州への拡大、国際支援要請など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 国連人道問題担当事務次長が過去最速の流行拡大と警告しており、4,600症例以上、2,180人以上の死者、6州への拡大が確認されている。武力紛争下での対応の困難さも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Expands to New Province
article.articleSummary: As of 15 Aug 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has expanded to Bas-Uele, a province not previously affected. The government tallies 4,665 confirmed cases nationwide with more than 2,180 deaths. World Health Organization data report 4,566 cases and 2,128 deaths. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects such as clothing and bedding. Health authorities are tracing transmission chains and isolating infected individuals while investigating how the virus reached Bas-Uele. The UN health agency is evaluating whether an existing vaccine could be effective, following promising animal studies. If containment is not strengthened, officials warn the outbreak could last longer than a year and potentially become the deadliest in history. International partners are preparing vaccination and treatment support; communities are urged to follow safety protocols.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ流行、新たな州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つ以上該当（深刻・異常・国際拡大リスク）し、致死率の高いエボラが新州へ拡大しており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 感染者数・死者数は政府とWHOで統計に差異あり。1年以上の長期化や史上最悪の流行になる可能性も指摘されており、続報の注視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ONU alerta: Ebola mata uma pessoa a cada 30 minutos na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Warns: Ebola Kills One Person Every 30 Minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo variant, declared May 15, is the fastest-spreading and deadliest the country has faced, with 2,128 deaths and 4,566 laboratory-confirmed cases as of August 14, 2026. The disease is advancing rapidly, with officials warning it claims a life roughly every 30 minutes. There is no vaccine or specific treatment available for Bundibugyo. The UN appeals for intensified global mobilization, releasing an additional $30.5 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund (CERF) atop $24 million already allocated to the DRC and four neighboring countries, bringing CERF support to about $54.5 million. Of the $518 million required for the Africa CDC/WHO joint response plan, only about $264 million has been mobilized. Health systems remain among the world’s most fragile, demanding rapid, large-scale resources.

triage.headline_ja: 国連警告：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが30分ごとに1人の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo変異株によるエボラ流行が過去最速・最多死者数を記録し、ワクチン・特異的治療法もない中、国連が資金不足を訴え緊急対応を呼びかけている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株による流行で2,128人死亡、4,566例が確認済み（2026年8月14日時点）。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在せず、資金不足（必要額518百万ドルに対し264百万ドルのみ調達）が深刻。周辺4か国への影響拡大リスクも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Centre's Auditor CAG Flags E Coli In Drinking Water Across Railway Stations
article.articleSummary: Centre's Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) audit covering 2019-20 to 2023-24 finds widespread non-compliance with passenger amenities at Indian Railways’ non-suburban stations. Drinking water from water coolers tested positive for E. coli at Coimbatore and Palakkad Junctions (Southern Railway); Hyderabad (South Central Railway); and four Central Railway stations—Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Bhiwandi Road, Kalyan, Lonavala—and Madhupur (Eastern Railway). Platform taps showed total coliforms, including E. coli, at 49 stations in eight zones (2022-23) and 56 stations in nine zones (2023-24). Bacteriological tests beyond total coliforms were unsatisfactory at eight stations (2022-23) and 11 stations (2023-24). Of 512 stations sampled, 458 (over 89%) lacked Minimum Essential Amenities. With 5,908 NSG stations and 7,424 daily trains carrying 292.4 crore passengers in 2023-24, Railways must ensure water quality testing per the Uniform Drinking Water Quality Protocol; the CAG urges stricter inspection protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 会計検査院(CAG)、鉄道駅の飲料水から大腸菌検出と指摘
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドの会計検査院による2019-2024年の鉄道駅設備監査報告であり、実際の感染症患者発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、感染症シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は監査結果に基づく水質基準不適合の指摘であり、具体的な感染症患者数や発症事例の報告はない。インフラ・公衆衛生管理の問題として扱われるべきで、感染症サーベイランスのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados tem mais de 5 mil casos confirmados de chikungunya em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados has more than 5,000 confirmed Chikungunya cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul (MS) records a record 30 deaths in 2026, nearly double 2025, with Dourados reporting 5,146 cases—the highest in the state, eight times Fátima do Sul’s 639. Through the 31st epidemiological week, MS reports 12,520 probable and 9,961 confirmed chikungunya cases. Municipal fatalities include Dourados (18), Bonito (2), Jardim (2), Fátima do Sul (1), Douradina (1), Guia Lopes da Laguna (1), Itaporã (1), Ponta Porã (2), Nioaque (1), Corumbá (1); one death under investigation. In Corumbá, a 62-year-old woman died July 28; the city has 542 cases. Public health guidance urges care for dengue or chikungunya symptoms and eliminating standing water to curb Aedes aegypti. Dengue shows 4,551 probable and 1,933 confirmed cases in MS, with one confirmed death in Bonito. Dengue vaccination: 241,030 doses received, 223,322 administered, 201,349 to target population; two-dose schedule for ages 10–14 years 11 months 29 days.

triage.headline_ja: ドウラードスで2026年のチクングニア熱確定症例が5,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: マットグロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱の死者数が前年の約2倍（30人）に急増し、症例数も1万件近くに達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な増加傾向が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マットグロッソ・ド・スル州（ドウラードス市を含む）における2026年のチクングニア熱流行を報告。デング熱も併発しており、ワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: AP to Conduct Simulation Exercises to Test Disease Outbreak Preparedness
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Krishna district (Machilipatnam) on August 18–19, followed by Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza in West Godavari district (Bhimavaram) on August 20–21. Subsequent exercises will cover dengue in Visakhapatnam, scrub typhus in Vizianagaram, and cholera/severe diarrhoeal diseases in Guntur. Andhra Pradesh health department will conduct simulation exercises for the first time to assess state preparedness to respond to public health emergencies from detection to containment. Exercises will test early detection, information flow, investigation, sample collection and testing, availability of medicines and equipment, public communication, and inter-department coordination, following a One Health approach. The aim is to identify coordination gaps, resource shortages, and procedural bottlenecks before actual outbreaks occur. Participants include the State IDSP unit, district medical and health officers, district surveillance teams, and officials from Animal Husbandry, Food Safety, Agriculture, Forest, Municipal, and Panchayat Raj departments.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州、感染症アウトブレイク対応能力を試すシミュレーション演習を実施予定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実際の感染症発生ではなく、州保健当局が実施予定の机上演習・シミュレーション訓練に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の実発生事案には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の疾病アウトブレイクではなく、アンドラプラデシュ州保健局による準備態勢確認のためのシミュレーション演習（レプトスピラ症、鳥インフルエンザ、デング熱、ツツガムシ病、コレラ等を想定した訓練）について述べている。実発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ‎Face à Ebola, le Nord-Kivu et l'Ouganda s'accordent sur des dérogations transfrontalières
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing Ebola, North Kivu and Uganda Agree on Cross-Border Exemptions
article.articleSummary: Cross-border Ebola response between North Kivu (DRC) and Uganda: North Kivu's military governor, General-major Somo Kakule Evariste, secured Uganda's commitment to allow the passage of specific categories of people across the border under certain conditions, despite border closures implemented for the Ebola virus disease response. The arrangement aims to mitigate disruptions to movements of people, notably traders, students, and some Congolese patients seeking care in Uganda, and vice versa, while maintaining health-screening controls to curb transmission. Coordinated by Prisca Luanda Kamala, the plan included a visit to Mbarara for a coordination meeting and to Mpondwe Ebola Treatment Center near the RDC border to assess Ugandan safeguards. In addition to the border issue, Kampala announced strengthening medical support to the DRC; Ugandan specialists deployed to North Kivu will conduct field missions, notably in Katwa and Butembo. A mobile laboratory is to be established in Butembo to strengthen diagnostics. Authorities view cross-border cooperation as essential given ongoing outbreak and trade-linked movements.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策で北キブ州とウガンダが国境越え特例措置に合意
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関し、国境閉鎖や越境者への特例措置、近隣国への医療支援展開など、IHR基準（重大性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（北キブ州）とウガンダの国境地域における越境協力に関する内容。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。既存の継続的アウトブレイクに関する続報記事であり、国境管理・医療支援体制強化が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Rutshuru : alerte sanitaire autour d'une viande d'hippopotame contaminée par le charbon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rutshuru: public health alert concerning hippopotamus meat contaminated with charcoal.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax confirmed in a hippopotamus carcass found August 8 in Vitshumbi, Rutshuru Territory, Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, within Virunga National Park. Laboratory confirmation of Bacillus anthracis ties the event to a potential zoonotic source; portions of the meat had been recovered by residents before results were issued. An August 14 health alert from the Kibirizi rural health zone calls for active surveillance of people who handled or consumed the animal or its meat and for monitoring signs such as unusual skin lesions, fever, or general deterioration after contact with the animal or its products. Authorities urge immediate reporting of any suspect cases and identify at-risk individuals for follow-up. Residents are asked to avoid touching carcasses of animals found dead under unknown circumstances and to refrain from cutting or consuming meat or products from such animals. The region is concurrently affected by Ebola and is under M23 control, complicating monitoring efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ルチュル：炭疽菌に汚染されたカバ肉をめぐる公衆衛生警戒
triage.triage_reason: カバの死骸から炭疽菌（Bacillus anthracis）が検出され、住民が肉を採取・消費した可能性があるため保健当局が監視を呼びかけているが、現時点でヒトの症例は確認されておらず、重症度や感染拡大の実態は不明であるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 地域はエボラ流行下にありM23武装勢力の支配下にあるため、監視・対応能力が制約される可能性がある。ヒト症例の確認状況について続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à Dengue Em São Bernardo Ganha 500 Estações Da Fiocruz - ABC Agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight Against Dengue in São Bernardo Wins 500 Fiocruz Stations - ABC Agora
article.articleSummary: Dengue control in São Bernardo do Campo, Brazil, launches 500 Fiocruz-designed Estações Disseminadoras de Larvicida (EDLs) in Vila São Pedro, one of the country’s 20 largest communities, as the starting point of a new Aedes aegypti containment strategy. From Aug 12, 2026, health teams install the devices to interrupt the mosquito life cycle; the female mosquito, attracted to a water-filled, larvicide-coated float, carries larvicide to other breeding sites, inhibiting larval development and aiming to reduce dengue incidence. The 6-month deployment includes monthly checks of water levels, with residents instructed not to move or handle the units. This follows June’s Montanhão phase, when six ovitrampas were deployed there to map infestation; the Zoonoses department may extend EDL use to other neighborhoods in São Bernardo. The program notes El Niño–related climate variability that can affect breeding conditions. Community members expressed support for dengue reduction.

triage.headline_ja: サンベルナルドのデング熱対策、フィオクルスの500基設置で強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の通常の予防・防除活動を報じる内容であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例の急増等は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染拡大のニュースではなく、Fiocruzが開発した幼虫防除装置(EDL)の設置による予防対策プログラムの紹介。デング熱自体は既知の流行性疾患であり、本記事は通常の公衆衛生対策として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Rutshuru : un hippopotame testé positif à l'anthrax, les autorités sanitaires renforcent l'alerte à Kibirizi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rutshuru: a hippopotamus tested positive for anthrax, health authorities intensify the alert in Kibirizi.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax has reappeared in Virunga National Park’s central sector, with a confirmed case in a hippopotamus found dead in the Kibirizi health zone, Rutshuru Territory, North Kivu. An alert dated August 14, 2026 confirms Bacillus anthracis by laboratory testing. Concern for human transmission rises after some residents reportedly recovered meat from the carcass before the illness was identified. Authorities urge against handling or consuming animals found dead under unusual circumstances and recommend medical care for anyone in contact with the carcass or its products. People exposed should watch for skin lesions, fever, or general deterioration. Vitshumbi health facilities are asked to strengthen epidemiological surveillance to identify those who handled, cut, transported, or consumed the meat. The region also faces Ebola and Mpox; anthrax affected hippos near Ishasha in 2025 at the DRC–Uganda border.

triage.headline_ja: ルチュル：カバが炭疽菌陽性、キビリジで保健当局が警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（カバ）での炭疽菌確認と住民による死骸肉の回収という曝露リスクがあるが、現時点で人間の感染例は確認されておらず情報が不十分なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物由来炭疽菌で人間感染はまだ未確認。2025年にも同地域（DRC-ウガンダ国境付近イシャシャ）で類似事例あり、周期的発生の可能性。EbolaやMpoxも同地域で懸念されているが本記事の主題は炭疽菌。

article.articleHeadline: Distrito Federal confirma primeiro caso de raiva em cães após 26 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District Confirms First Rabies Case in Dogs in 26 Years.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a dog in the Federal District, Brazil—the first canine case in 26 years (since 2000). A four-year-old female dog from Lago Norte showed symptoms last month and died about a week later. Diagnosis was confirmed by the Health Secretariat this week; two other suspected cases were ruled out. In response, Environmental Health Surveillance launched a dog rabies vaccination campaign across the Distrito Federal, with 151 vaccination points operating Monday through Saturday until the end of the month. The Health Secretariat reiterates that annual vaccination of pets is essential, even in areas with no recent cases. The rabies virus continues to circulate sporadically among wildlife, especially bats and herbivores. Rabies can be transmitted to humans and has a high fatality rate; vaccination remains the main preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦区、26年ぶりに犬の狂犬病感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 26年ぶりの犬の狂犬病症例で異常性はあるが、単一動物症例でヒト感染例なし、既にワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施され管理下にあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 単一の犬の狂犬病症例であり、当局が迅速にワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始済み。ヒト感染例の報告はなく、野生動物（コウモリ等）での散発的な狂犬病ウイルス循環が指摘されているが、現時点で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Mwenga : la zone de santé de Kitutu notre des cas de poliovirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mwenga: Kitutu health zone reports poliovirus cases.
article.articleSummary: Two cases of poliovirus variants (cVDPV2) were detected in Kitutu health zone, Mwenga, Sud-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The provincial health division confirms two cVDPV2 cases with an orphan profile, suggesting possible silent circulation. Dr. Claude Bahizire, DPS Sud-Kivu communications chief, says intensified vaccination may be required, potentially monthly revaccination, and campaigns from September through December 2026 to halt transmission. During an integrated Measles, Rubella, and Poliomyelitis campaign, the WHO representative reiterated vigilance. Epidemiological data from the WHO notes the cases were notified in Week 31. Since 2023, Sud-Kivu has recorded five poliovirus cases prior to this incident. The new cases arise amid a vaccination drive, underscoring ongoing outbreak risk and the need for heightened immunization efforts in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ムウェンガ：キトゥツ保健地帯でポリオウイルス感染例を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国南キブ州でワクチン由来ポリオウイルス2型(cVDPV2)の症例が確認され、孤発性プロファイルからサイレント感染拡大の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: cVDPV2の「孤発性プロファイル」はサーベイランス網に捕捉されていない感染連鎖の存在を示唆し、サイレント循環のリスクが高い。2023年以降南キブ州で既に5例確認されており、地域的な流行継続の可能性が高い。9月から12月にかけて追加ワクチン接種キャンペーンが計画されている。

article.articleHeadline: Cepa de sarampo que circula em São Paulo veio dos EUA e Canadá, diz ministro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles strain circulating in São Paulo came from the United States and Canada, says minister.
article.articleSummary: Measles strain circulating in São Paulo state originated from the United States and Canada, according to Health Minister Alexandre Padilha. From June to July, 21 measles infections were confirmed in São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, with 18 cases in the capital, two in São Bernardo do Campo, and one in Guarulhos. Vaccination efforts were expanded temporarily for residents aged 6 months to 59 years to curb transmission. The Ministry has allocated 3.2 million doses of the measles-containing vaccine (triple viral) to reinforce supply. Brazil regained measles-free status in 2024; last year saw 38 imported cases but no outbreaks. The Americas are experiencing a measles surge (47,459 confirmed cases and 44 deaths as of July 18), led by Guatemala, Mexico, the United States, and Peru. Measles is highly contagious, with red rash, fever, cough, conjunctivitis, and risks of pneumonia or encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで流行している麻疹株は米国とカナダ由来、と保健相が発表
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除認定を回復したばかりのブラジルで輸入株による集団感染が発生し、国境を越えた伝播が確認されているためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 米国、グアテマラ、メキシコ、ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは2024年に麻疹排除状態を回復したばかりで、輸入株による集団感染は再流行リスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Конго стремительно распространяется -- медики не успевают отслеживать контакты
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak in Congo is spreading rapidly — medics can't keep up with contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly, with medical teams unable to keep up with contact tracing. Between 60% and 70% of new cases are identified among people who were not previously monitored as contacts, meaning infections are often detected after symptoms appear and transmission may have already occurred. As of August 11, 2026, authorities have recorded more than 4,700 Ebola cases and over 2,200 deaths in the region. Public health officials warn the virus is outrunning response efforts. In response, the United Nations has allocated an additional $30.5 million in emergency aid to bolster outbreak control and support health workers in the eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が急速に拡大 — 医療従事者が接触者追跡に追いつけず
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ東部で急速に拡大し、致死率の高い4700例以上・死者2200人超を記録、接触者追跡が破綻しており国際支援も投入されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 国連が3050万ドルの緊急支援を追加投入していることから、既に国際的な懸念事案として認識されている。感染者数・死者数の規模が大きく、接触者追跡の破綻はヒトーヒト感染拡大リスクの増大を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Конго стрімко поширюється - медики не встигають відстежувати контакти
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo spreading rapidly — health workers cannot keep up with tracing contacts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread rapidly, with health workers unable to keep up with contact tracing. Officials report that 60–70% of new infections are occurring in people who were not previously under surveillance as contacts, meaning transmission often occurs before isolation and monitoring can prevent spread. By August 2026 the outbreak has surpassed 4,700 cases and more than 2,200 lives, with mortality pace nearly three times faster to reach 2,200 deaths than during the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak. The surge in cases comes amid strain on surveillance and isolation efforts. In response, the United Nations has allocated an additional $30.5 million in emergency funding to bolster outbreak response and support affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行が急速に拡大 - 医療従事者が接触者追跡に追いつけず
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ東部で急速拡大し、4,700例超・2,200人以上の死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが記事本文はコンゴ（DRC）のみに言及しているためAngolaは除外。UNが3050万ドルの緊急資金を追加投入。2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行より致死ペースが速いと報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: More than 26 mln malaria infections recorded in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo recorded more than 26 million malaria infections in 2025, with 29,938 malaria deaths, per the National Malaria Control Program. Malaria remains the country’s top public health challenge, requiring intensified high-impact interventions and evaluation of new approaches tailored to health zones, said deputy director Guy Dembo. In Ituri province, the government launched a mass administration of antimalarial drugs earlier this week as part of accelerated action to end malaria, aiming to strengthen prevention and response. Dembo urged authorities, health professionals, partners and communities to act as champions of malaria elimination. The World Health Organization notes malaria kills hundreds of thousands annually across Africa, with the heaviest toll on young children.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でマラリア感染者2600万人以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCにおいて既知の風土病であり、年次報告としての数値公表であるため異常性・突発性がなく、既存の対策枠組み内で対応されている。
triage.notes: マラリアはDRCで毎年多数の感染・死亡が報告される風土病であり、本記事も年次統計とマス投薬キャンペーンの実施を報じる定例的内容。新規の異常な流行拡大の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'ONU tire la sonnette d'alarme face à une flambée meurtrière - Tunisie Numerique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the UN sounds the alarm in the face of a deadly flare-up - Tunisie Numerique
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at the fastest rate ever recorded, with the UN noting a death roughly every 30 minutes as cases exceed 4,500 across six provinces, with additional cases in Uganda and near the South Sudan border. UN OCHA’s Tom Fletcher urged intensified international action, warning the virus is gaining ground and stressing needs for water, hygiene, health care, and essential services. About $300 million has been pledged to a dedicated response fund. The UN also announced 20 more frontline staff, calling for doubled safe and dignified burials teams, tripled treatment capacity, expanded contact tracing, and deployment of more experienced responders. Since May 15, at least 2,128 deaths have occurred, with Ebola’s reach prompting renewed alarm as the most deadly outbreak in the disease’s history; the 2018–2020 outbreak saw ~2,300 deaths from ~3,500 cases. The Central Emergency Response Fund has added $30.5 million on top of $24 million already released to DRC and other countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：国連が致死的な感染拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の感染拡大とされる大規模エボラ流行で、4500例超・死者2128人以上、複数国への拡大と大規模な国際支援要請があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事本文の発生地域にはウガンダ・スーダンも含まれるが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの流行が主題であり、史上最も致死的なエボラ流行と報じられている。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo Virus Outbreak Intensifies In DRC, Cases Rise To 4,665 -- WHO
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is intensifying, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths (case fatality ratio 46.8%), the largest Ebola outbreak in the country. Starting in Mongbwalu health zone, Ituri Province, it has spread to 54 health zones across six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé. Bas-Uélé’s first confirmed case in Buta involved a traveler from Haut-Uélé. The highest weekly figures occurred in epidemiological week 32: 579 cases and 304 deaths. Insecurity, displacement, mobility, and cross-border movements complicate response. WHO and Africa CDC emphasize stronger surveillance, community engagement, expanded treatment centers, and health-worker training. Regarding imports/exports, France reported an imported case on June 24 with 41 days without secondary cases by Aug 14; Uganda’s latest imported case was discharged July 16, with a 42-day monitoring period ending Aug 27. Uganda remains at risk of re-introduction; regional preparedness continues.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイルス病の流行がDRCで激化、症例数4,665人に増加 -- WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ属ウイルス（ブンディブギョウ）流行が拡大し、致死率46.8%、54保健圏に拡大、国際的な輸入例も発生しておりIHR4基準中複数該当。
triage.notes: フランス・ウガンダでの輸入症例が報告されているが、対象国リストにフランス・ウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。国際的拡大リスクは既に実現している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le gouverneur militaire appelle les communautés à renforcer leur implication dans la riposte contre Ebola - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the military governor calls on communities to strengthen their involvement in the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri Province, Ebola virus disease response emphasizes community involvement as the military governor of Ituri launches an August 15 workshop in Bunia on the non-medical dimensions of the response, with support from the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). The workshop aims to strengthen participation of communities and local actors in prevention, epidemiological surveillance, and awareness-raising amid persistent Ebola transmission. The governor cites three principles: listen to understand, dialog to persuade, act with communities, advocating a dialogue-based, participatory approach. Organizers seek to make communities full partners to improve risk identification, alert dissemination, and adoption of behaviors to limit virus spread. The initiative aims to rebuild trust between populations, authorities, and responders, deemed essential for adherence to prevention measures and rapid use of health services. Participants will explore mechanisms to enhance collaboration among response structures, local authorities, and affected communities, reinforcing community-based surveillance and swift referral of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: イツーリ州：軍事知事、エボラ対応へのコミュニティ関与強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツーリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する対応強化の記事であり、WPRO基準の複数項目（重症度、持続的曝露、流行のしやすさ、管理可能性）に該当し、国際機関（UNDP）の支援も継続していることから、進行中のアウトブレイクとしてフルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は新規発生ではなく、既存のエボラアウトブレイクに対する対応強化（コミュニティ関与、UNDP支援）に関する内容。継続的な監視と地域対応の状況把握のためフルRRA相当の評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: More than 26M malaria infections recorded in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo logged more than 26 million malaria infections in 2025, with 29,938 malaria deaths, according to the National Malaria Control Program. Malaria remains the country’s top public health challenge, requiring intensified, high-impact interventions and ongoing evaluation of new approaches tailored to health zones. Deputy director Guy Dembo said a mass administration of antimalarial drugs was launched earlier this week in Ituri province to accelerate progress and reinforce prevention and response. He urged authorities, health professionals, partners, and communities to champion malaria elimination. WHO notes that malaria continues to claim hundreds of thousands of lives annually in the African region, with the heaviest toll on young children.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でマラリア感染者2600万人超を記録
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCで長年の風土病であり、本記事は年間統計報告に過ぎず、異常な増加や新規アウトブレイクを示す情報がないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの国家マラリア対策プログラムによる年間統計報告であり、Ituri州での集団投薬プログラム開始が言及されているが、これは既存の対策強化であり新規の異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ONU: Ébola causa una muerte cada 30 minutos en RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Ebola causes one death every 30 minutes in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher warned that Ebola is causing about one death every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 15 August 2026, during the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. He urged accelerated, broader international action and solidarity to address critical water, sanitation, health care, and other basic services gaps in affected areas. Congolese authorities report 4,449 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,061 deaths. The DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak was declared on 15 May, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. About $300 million has been pledged to a fund to combat the disease. The UN calls for intensified international support to prevent further expansion of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で30分に1人の死者を出している
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが宣言された過去最速拡大のエボラ流行で、死者数が急増し国際支援拡大が要請されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。史上最速の拡大速度とされる第17次エボラ流行で、既に4,449例確認・2,061死亡が報告されている重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Por que o sarampo voltou a preocupar?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why has measles become a cause for concern again?
article.articleSummary: Measles has re-emerged as a public health concern in the Americas and Brazil. In 2025 Brazil reported 38 cases with no sustained transmission; by July 2026 there were 24 confirmed cases, 23 in São Paulo. Across the Americas, up to July 18, 2026, 47,459 measles cases were recorded. Hospital Pequeno Príncipe in Curitiba stresses vaccination, noting measles' high contagion and that up to 90% of susceptible contacts can be infected. Koplik spots may appear about 72 hours before rash. Common pediatric complications include pneumonia (1 in 20), acute otitis media (1 in 10), encephalitis (1–4 per 1000), and deaths (1–3 per 1000). Pan-American vaccination strategy relies on MMR; in 2025, 92.5% of infants received the first dose, 77.9% completed on time. Brazil's schedule: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months; those with both doses require no revaccination; pregnancy and immunocompromised individuals are contraindicated. Vaccination is safe and protective.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹はなぜ再び懸念材料となったのか？
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルおよび米州で麻疹症例が継続的に報告されているが、記事は啓発的な内容で急性の大規模アウトブレイクを示すものではなく、社会的関心の高まりも明確でないため、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の医学的解説と予防接種推奨を主眼とした啓発記事であり、ブラジル国内の症例数（2026年7月時点で24例）は限定的。米州全体では47,459例と規模は大きいが、ブラジル固有の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'ONU débloque 30,5 millions de dollars supplémentaires pour renforcer la riposte - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the UN unlocks an additional 30.5 million dollars to bolster the response - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: UN announces an additional $30.5 million through the CERF to bolster the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring countries, supplementing $24 million already released. As of August 15, 2026, this marks the 17th EVD outbreak in the DRC, declared May 15, 2026, with spread to six provinces: Ituri (epicenter), Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, and Bas-Uele. The funding aims to intensify interventions: expanded patient-care capacity, strengthened epidemiological surveillance and contact tracing, and a doubling of secure, dignified burials teams with a tripling of treatment capacity. Twenty new field staff have been deployed. Authorities will recruit experienced managers and improve access to water, sanitation, hygiene, and health services. Insecurity, armed violence, and worker strikes complicate response efforts amid dwindling international humanitarian resources, underscoring the urgency of mobilization.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：国連が対応強化のため追加3050万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が6州に拡大し、国連が緊急資金を追加投入するなど国際的対応が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはDRC国内の州（Tshopo、South Kivu、Nord-Kivu、Bas Uele、Haut Uele、Ituri）が含まれるが、いずれもDRC国内の行政区分のため国単位ではDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上。近隣国への波及は記載があるが具体国名は不明のため対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में डेंगू की दस्तक के बीच एमसीडी सुस्त, घर-घर छिड़काव और जांच दोनों में आई कमी - delhi dengue threat rises mcd cuts antimosquito efforts by 61
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid Delhi's dengue threat, MCD is sluggish, with declines in door-to-door spraying and testing — Delhi dengue threat rises as MCD cuts anti-mosquito efforts by 61.
article.articleSummary: Delhi faces a rising dengue threat as MCD’s anti-mosquito drive falters. Dengue-2 strain cases are increasing in the capital. From Jan 1 to Aug 8, 2026, MCD sprayed mosquito-repellent chemicals in 275,767 houses, a 61% drop from 703,793 sprayed in the same period in 2025. Domestic Breeding Checkers’ inspections fell 8.3%. Door-to-door vector-control activities and inspections declined: 23,208,873 inspections this year vs 25,331,526 last year. Breeding found dropped to 82,870 houses this year from 114,451 last year (27% decline). Legal actions declined: notices 69,203 vs 85,135; prosecutions 6,544 vs 16,384; challans 2,313 vs 4,023. Gambusia fish releases in Amrit scheme ponds fell from 287 sites to 229. Dengue cases in Jan–Aug 2026 reached 1,179—the highest on record, compared with 174 (2022), 348 (2023), 322 (2024), and 315 (2025).

triage.headline_ja: デリーでデング熱の脅威が高まる中、MCD(デリー市自治体)の対応が鈍化 ― 戸別消毒・検査ともに61%減少
triage.triage_reason: デリーで例年より大幅に多いデング熱症例数（過去最多）が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、行政の媒介動物対策の遅れという国内公衆衛生上の課題として続報を注視すべき事案。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの風土病であり季節性の増加。今年の症例数（1,179件）は過去最多であり、MCDによる媒介動物対策（家屋消毒・幼虫検査）の顕著な縮小が要因として指摘されている。死亡者数や重症度に関する情報はなく、国際的な波及の兆候も見られない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 26 millions de cas de paludisme enregistrés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: more than 26 million malaria cases recorded.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), official data show malaria infected more than 26 million people in 2025, with 29,938 malaria-related deaths. The National Malaria Control Program states malaria remains the country’s leading public health challenge and requires intensified, high‑impact interventions and new, zone-tailored approaches. In Ituri Province, the government launched a mass antimalarial drug administration campaign this week to accelerate control, aiming to strengthen prevention and response and urging authorities, health professionals, partners and communities to mobilize toward elimination. Malaria continues to cause hundreds of thousands of deaths annually in Africa, with young children most affected, per the World Health Organization. The report highlights a substantial burden despite ongoing efforts and regional interventions.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：マラリア感染者2600万人以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCの風土病であり、感染者数・死亡者数は深刻だが「異常/予想外」とは言えず、蚊媒介感染症のため国際的拡大リスクも低い。Ituri州でのMDAキャンペーンなど対策強化の動きはあるが、既存の公衆衛生課題の年次報告的側面が強い。
triage.notes: マラリアは風土病であり、既知の年次統計報告に近い内容。Ituri州でのマスドラッグ投与（MDA）キャンペーンなど新規対策の動きは注視価値があるが、緊急性を示す異常事態の兆候は記事内に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo Ebola virus cases rise to 4,665
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has intensified, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths (case fatality 46.8%) as of Wednesday, making it the largest Ebola outbreak in the country. Transmission expanded from Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, to 54 health zones across six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé. Bas-Uélé reported its first confirmed case in Buta, linked to a traveler from Haut-Uélé. The highest weekly burden occurred in epidemiological week 32 (579 cases, 304 deaths). Insecurity, displacement, mobility and cross-border movements complicate response; authorities with WHO and partners are expanding treatment centres, training health workers, and scaling up surveillance and community engagement. Imported/exported cases: France reported an imported case on June 24 with no secondary transmission by Aug 14 (41 days); Uganda’s latest imported case discharged July 16, with the 42-day monitoring ending Aug 27, while Uganda remains at risk of re-introduction due to DRC transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブジョ・エボラウイルス感染症、感染者数が4,665人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブジョウイルス）流行で、致死率46.8%、6州54保健地区に拡大し、フランス・ウガンダへの越境例も報告されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: フランス・ウガンダへの輸出例が報告されているが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC国内で史上最大のエボラ流行が継続中であり、渡航・貿易制限の有無については記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 4 727 cas confirmés et 2 214 décès au 13 août, 62 nouvelles confirmations en vingt-quatre heures
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 4,727 confirmed cases and 2,214 deaths as of August 13, 62 new confirmations in 24 hours
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: as of August 13, 2026, 4,727 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,214 deaths (case fatality 46.8%). In the last 24 hours, 62 new confirmed cases (Ituri 41, North Kivu 16, Haut-Uele 4, Tshopo 1) and 30 deaths (14 community, 16 in treatment centers; Ituri 14, Haut-Uele 2). 11 recoveries in Ituri; total cures 976. 749 patients are in isolation or in treatment centers; contact follow-up 82.6% for the day. A 55th health zone was affected in Tshopo; now 7 of 23 in that province; 55 health zones across 151 health areas. Ituri remains epicenter with 85.0% of confirmed cases and 66.1% of new cases. Ituri: 4,020 cases, 1,745 deaths; Nord-Kivu 569/404; Haut-Uele 123/57; Tshopo 11/6; Sud-Kivu 3/1; Bas-Uele 1/1. Confirmations declined from 118 on Aug 11 to 100 on Aug 12 to 62 on Aug 13 (provisional). A mass antimalarial campaign in Ituri aims to reduce fever and aid Ebola case identification; no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo; Ervebo targets Zaïre strain only. WHO target: 3,000 beds in 12 weeks and 95% contact follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱:8月13日時点で確認症例4,727件、死者2,214人。24時間で新規確認62件

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: وفاة شخص بـ"إيبولا" كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: A person dies of Ebola every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-15, a United Nations official, Fletcher, warns that Ebola is winning in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with a death every 30 minutes attributed to the outbreak. He stresses that containment efforts must not be overwhelmed and calls for sustained international support to halt transmission. The briefing underscores critical humanitarian needs in affected areas, including water, sanitation, healthcare, and other essential services, arguing that addressing these needs is essential to curb spread. It notes Western media reports on the situation and urges effective international action to limit the virus’s reach, calling on partners to mobilize resources and coordination to strengthen outbreak response in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより30分ごとに1人が死亡

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة وفاة شخص بـ إيبولا كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: A person dies of Ebola every 30 minutes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is causing a death every 30 minutes as of 15 August 2026, per Tom Fletcher, the United Nations Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator. He warned that the outbreak is expanding and described it as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, urging the international community to bolster its response to fight the epidemic. The remarks underscore the rapid transmission and rising mortality, and call for intensified global action to support affected communities and curb transmission within the DRC, underscoring the urgent international engagement required to address this emergency, as declared by the UN.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国で30分に1人がエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 国連高官が「史上最速の拡大」と警告する重大なエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・国際支援の必要性が複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: República del Congo supera los 3.000 casos de ébola %
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Republic of the Congo surpasses 3,000 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreaks in the east have reached 3,075 confirmed cases and 1,354 deaths, with a case fatality rate of 44%. Seventy-five patients are in isolation or hospitalization, and 556 have recovered; contact tracing coverage stands at 76.4%. Five provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, and Haut-Uele (all in the east), plus Tshopo (central-north). The latest government bulletin notes more precise epidemiological data, ongoing contact tracing, and reinforced surveillance and diagnostic capacity, including an additional laboratory to improve detection and confirmation in affected areas. The outbreak was declared in mid-May, with authorities emphasizing improved detection and case management as the response progresses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の症例数が3,000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行が3,075例・致死率44%と大規模化しており、複数州にまたがる拡大とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性からIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 北キブ州は発生地域リストに明示されていないが記事サマリー中で言及されている。致死率44%と高く、5州にまたがる拡大が継続中で、国際支援を要する可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatites virais: diagnóstico precoce é essencial para combater doenças que podem permanecer silenciosas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral hepatitis: early diagnosis is essential to combat diseases that can remain silent.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-15, the Municipal Health Secretariat of Várzea Grande held an educational talk at the Rogina de Arruda Shelter in Novo Várzea Grande, focusing on viral hepatitis types B, C, and Delta, and also syphilis and HIV. Dr. Natanael (Primary Care) outlined transmission, signs and symptoms, and diagnostic approaches, emphasizing that hepatitis can be silent for years. Common symptoms include fatigue, fever, malaise, nausea, abdominal pain, dark urine, pale stools, and jaundice; yet hepatitis B and C are often asymptomatic. A patient story about hepatitis C illustrated the stealthy course. Diagnosis can start with rapid tests in the public system; active HCV infection is confirmed with additional tests. Hepatitis B vaccine is freely available; hepatitis C has curative treatment but no vaccine. The event also noted future November activities on prostate cancer and men's health.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性肝炎:早期診断は沈黙する可能性のある疾患と闘うために不可欠
triage.triage_reason: 教育啓発イベントに関する記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地域保健局による住民向け啓発講演の報道であり、感染症サーベイランス上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliches Dengue-Fieber - hier müssen Urlauber besonders aufpassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous dengue fever – here vacationers must be especially careful.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is a tropical, mosquito-borne disease transmitted by female Aedes mosquitoes (Aedes aegypti and A. albopictus), affecting more than 120 countries with about 390 million infections annually (WHO). Most recover, but 1–5% develop severe dengue (dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome), especially after a second infection with a different serotype or in children and those with preexisting conditions. Incubation is 3–10 days; symptoms include high fever, a patchy rash, severe headache, and intense muscle/joint pains (“bone-breaking fever”), with nausea and abdominal pain; about 25% are symptomatic. Regions at risk: Southeast Asia, Central/South America, the Caribbean, and parts of Africa; Asia accounts for ~70% of cases. Imported infections in Germany mainly come from travelers returning from Thailand; Europe has had autochthonous cases since 2010 (France, Spain, Portugal, Croatia, Italy) with a 2024 peak. Prevention emphasizes bite avoidance, DEET or Icaridin, protective clothing, nets, and eliminating standing water. Vaccination with Qdenga is approved in Europe for ages 4+, not universally recommended; may be considered for those with prior dengue traveling to risk areas after risk-benefit discussion. Suspected dengue after travel warrants prompt medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なデング熱―旅行者が特に注意すべき点
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する一般的な啓発・予防情報記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ対象国での新規シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツの旅行者向け一般啓発情報で、タイは輸入感染症例の背景として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola en Ituri : les parties prenantes mobilisées pour renforcer l'engagement communautaire - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response in Ituri: stakeholders mobilized to strengthen community engagement - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Ituri mobilizes stakeholders to boost community engagement. In Bunia, August 15, 2026, UNDP organized a one-day workshop to strengthen non-medical responders’ capacities and consolidate community engagement amid the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Governor Major General Gaby Kasongo reported 28 of 36 health zones affected, with 3,814 confirmed cases and 2,061 deaths; 886 people have recovered. Dr. Gisèle Mbuyi of the Public Health Emergency Group stressed that Ebola is not only a health emergency but a social, humanitarian, and security challenge requiring coordinated action by local, national, and international actors, beyond medical measures alone. Crisis governance expert Léopold Gnonke emphasized trust and social dialogue as essential; ten UN-recruited community volunteers will be deployed next week to support authorities, traditional leaders, and civil society in non-medical response. A roadmap will be validated to structure interventions, clarify roles, and establish a monitoring and reporting mechanism.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ対応：関係者が地域社会エンゲージメント強化に向け動員
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で36保健地区中28地区に拡大し、確定症例3,814例・死亡2,061例という大規模かつ継続中のエボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 州知事や公衆衛生緊急対策グループ、UNDPなど複数機関が関与しており、既に国際支援が行われている継続中の大規模流行。致死率が高く（2061/3814、約54%）、公衆衛生上深刻な影響がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : faute de vaccin contre Bundibugyo, l'OMS recommande d'essayer l'Ervebo directement en phase 3
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: in the absence of a vaccine against Bundibugyo, the WHO recommends trying Ervebo directly in Phase 3.
article.articleSummary: WHO’s vaccine advisory group recommends Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) be prioritized for inclusion in a Phase 3 efficacy study during the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, without a prior Phase 2 trial. Ervebo is licensed for the Zaïre Ebola virus, while the current outbreak (began May 17) is caused by Bundibugyo, for which no licensed vaccine exists. The recommendation draws on animal and laboratory data, including non-human primate and ferret challenge studies and pseudovirus neutralization, and remains open to Bundibugyo-specific candidates if they become available. The plan leverages Ervebo’s safety record from hundreds of thousands vaccinated against Zaïre; the Phase 3 would test efficacy against Bundibugyo rather than safety. About 55,000 frontline workers were vaccinated with Ervebo in Ituri and North Kivu; over 47,000 more were vaccinated by Sept 2025 via a $40 million Gavi rapid-response effort. The outbreak is the largest in DR Congo history (4,209 cases, 1,916 deaths; Ituri 3,636/1,551). Global stock holds 500,000 doses, with some pre-positioned in the DRC. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are not yet ready; the PARTNERS therapeutic trial in DRC assesses MBP134, remdesivir, MBP134+remdesivir, or supportive care. Uganda reports 20 cases, 2 deaths; Congo CFR 45.5%. Occurrence across 53 of 140 health zones in five provinces marks the scale of the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ブンディブギョ株ワクチンがない中、WHOはエルベボを第3相試験で直接試すよう推奨
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（4,209症例、致死率45.5%）で、ウガンダへの国際拡大も確認されており、ブンディブギョ株に対する承認ワクチンが存在しないという異常事態のため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20症例・2死亡が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる流行地はDRCイトゥリ州・北キブ州。

article.articleHeadline: Why is the latest Ebola outbreak worsening?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 2,000 people and is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, according to the World Health Organization. The report notes rapid transmission is outpacing containment efforts and raises questions about the drivers of the crisis and its dangers. No details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources are provided in the article. Presented by James Bays, it features Alex Lock (Communications Coordinator for the Ebola response with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies in Kinshasa), Dr Marie Roseline Belizaire (Emergency Director for WHO Africa), and Dr Margaret Harris (global health consultant).

triage.headline_ja: 最新のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクはなぜ悪化しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によりコンゴ民主共和国で2000人が死亡し、過去最速のペースで拡大しているとWHOが報告しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
