article.articleHeadline: Bas-Uélé : le ministre provincial de la Santé appelle à la vigilance face à Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bas-Uélé: the provincial health minister calls for vigilance in the face of Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Bas-Uélé, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo – the provincial health minister urged vigilance against Ebola virus disease as a concerning situation was reported in the Rubi Lisanga health area, Buta health zone. He warned against touching or handling a suspected corpse and noted that an official outbreak declaration is not yet made, a decision reserved for the provincial governor or the national health minister. Patients presenting signs compatible with Ebola have been detected in Rubi Lisanga and are being managed in Buta. The response includes surveillance of affected individuals, contacts, and health facilities with preventive isolation; the implicated hospital has been closed until further notice. Public guidance emphasizes avoiding non-essential travel and gatherings, minimizing physical contact with symptomatic people, regular handwashing, and installing handwashing stations in public places. Residents should promptly report suspected cases and follow authorities to prevent panic and misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: バス・ウエレ州:保健大臣がエボラ出血熱への警戒を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国バス・ウエレ州でエボラ疑い症例が発生し、州保健当局が警戒を呼びかけている。公式な発生宣言はまだだが、エボラは重篤で異常性が高く、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 疑い症例段階であり、公式な発生宣言はまだ出ていない。ラボ確認や感染拡大の詳細は続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola deja más de 2.200 muertos en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves more than 2,200 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,727 confirmed cases and 749 hospitalized, with a death toll exceeding 2,200 since it was declared on May 15. Ituri province in the northeast remains the main epicenter, though the virus has appeared in Buta, a health zone in Bas-Uele province, north of the country. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain currently has no approved vaccine. Ongoing violence and insecurity in Ituri hinder prevention, treatment, and patient tracing. The World Health Organization warns the situation is deteriorating as fatalities accelerate toward levels seen during 2018–2020. UN OCHA notes about one death every 30 minutes and has mobilized additional resources: CERF allocation of $30.5 million, atop $24 million previously mobilized for DRC and neighboring countries, plus 20 deployed field staff. Calls to double safe-burial teams and triple treatment capacity, with thousands still at risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で死者2,200人超に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者2,200人超・確定症例4,727例、ワクチン未承認かつ治安悪化により対応が困難で国際支援も動員されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチンのないブンディブギョ株による流行で、イトゥリ州の治安悪化が対応の障壁となっている。国連機関が多額の資金・人員を動員しており、2018-2020年流行に匹敵する深刻度との警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines: Leptospirosis in Iloilo and Quezon City
article.articleSummary: 84 leptospirosis cases, including 10 deaths, in Iloilo Province (Jan 4–Aug 8, 2026); 2025 period had 100 cases with 5 deaths. Tigbauan reported 6 cases; Janiuay, Dumangas, and Tubungan had 5 each. Agriculture-related exposures total 32; flood-related 18; other exposures 18. In Quezon City, 161 leptospirosis cases (Jan 1–Aug 13, 2026) with 20 deaths; 119 cases (74%) are 21+ years old, and 129 cases are male. Public health guidance stresses avoiding floodwaters, using boots and gloves, keeping environments clean to reduce rat-and-animal droppings, and seeking doxycycline prophylaxis at a health center if wading in floodwater.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン:イロイロ州およびケソン市におけるレプトスピラ症
triage.triage_reason: 季節性・地域流行性のレプトスピラ症報告であり、死亡例はあるものの毎年報告される既知の疾患パターンで、国際的拡大リスクは低いが症例数・死亡数の規模から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はフィリピンの雨季に毎年報告される風土病的疾患であり、洪水・農業関連曝露が主要因。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、地域の保健当局が予防投薬(ドキシサイクリン)などの対応を行っている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : un mort toutes les 30 minutes, alerte l'ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: one death every 30 minutes, UN warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with a death every 30 minutes—the fastest on record, according to Tom Fletcher, UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator. Since the outbreak was announced on May 15, 2026, the DRC has reported more than 4,500 cases and at least 2,128 deaths. Cross-border transmission is evident, with cases also reported in Uganda and near the Sudan–South Sudan border. The United Nations urges rapid scaling of care, enhanced contact tracing, and safer, secure burials, while addressing urgent needs in water, sanitation and health services. In support, UN agencies have unlocked an additional $30.5 million to bolster the response. The crisis underscores the need for sustained international assistance and robust public health measures to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱:30分に1人が死亡、国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、4,500例超・死者2,128人以上、ウガンダやスーダン国境付近への越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダおよびスーダン/南スーダン国境付近での症例も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（ウガンダ・スーダンはリスト外）ため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。国連が3,050万ドルの追加資金拠出を発表しており、国際的な支援体制が既に稼働中。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير أممي.. "إيبولا" يقضي على شخص كل نصف ساعة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN warning... "Ebola" kills someone every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are causing rapid mortality, with about one death every 30 minutes. Since the May 15, 2026 announcement, the DR Congo outbreak has tallied at least 2,128 deaths among more than 4,500 infections. The UN warns it could become the deadliest in history. Red Cross and Red Crescent teams have been burying bodies in Orfielin, Bunia, Ituri Province, on June 19, 2026. Tom Fletcher, Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator, said this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak ever and urged a faster, broader, and more coordinated response with greater solidarity before the virus outruns efforts. Ebola is transmitted through contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever, and containment efforts are ongoing amid concerns that the virus is “winning” in DR Congo unless the response accelerates.

triage.headline_ja: 国連の警告…「エボラ」が30分ごとに1人の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、死者2,128人・感染者4,500人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な支援要請も出ているためIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: إيبولا يودي بحياة شخص كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: Ebola claims the life of a person every 30 minutes in Congo.
article.articleSummary: UN and WHO warn that the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with a death every 30 minutes—the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak recorded there. UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher urged intensified international action. The outbreak, described by WHO as the largest in DRC history and the fastest-growing, has broadened to 54 health zones across six provinces, after initially being limited to a region in Ituri Province. Latest figures from the DRC Ministry of Information report 2,214 deaths and 4,727 infections, for a case-fatality rate of about 46.8%. The report underscores the expanding transmission and ongoing need for urgent, strengthened public health measures to contain spread and protect affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴでエボラが30分に1人の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大・最速拡大のエボラ流行で、死者2,214人、致死率46.8%、6州54保健区域に拡大しており、国連が国際的な対応強化を要請している重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en el Congo: la ONU advierte que muere una persona cada 30 minutos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: the UN warns that one person dies every 30 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues at record pace since declaration on May 15, with 4,660+ cases and 2,184 deaths. Ituri Province bears the majority (>3,400 cases) across six provinces, with spillover into Uganda (20 cases) and proximity to the South Sudan border raising regional concerns. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain drives transmission; there is no known treatment or licensed vaccine for this strain, and infection spreads via contact with bodily fluids, potentially causing hemorrhagic fever and high mortality absent adequate care. The UN warns this could become the deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, urging faster, broader international response. Funding includes $30.5 million CERF, plus $24 million already allocated to DRC and neighbors, and roughly $300 million in donor pledges. About 20 more UN personnel have been deployed; needs include doubling safe-burial teams, tripling treatment capacity, and enhancing contact tracing and essential services, amid severe malnutrition affecting 2.6 million in the east (over half in Ituri). The WFP will expand hot meals at treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行：国連は30分ごとに1人が死亡していると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大）し、WHOやUNが史上最悪規模になりうると警告する重大なエボラ流行であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（20症例）や南スーダン国境付近への波及が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株には既承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、致死率が高い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: إيبولا يودي بحياة شخص كل 30 دقيقة في الكونغو - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: Ebola claims the life of one person every 30 minutes in Congo - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest and fastest-spreading on record in the country. As of August 15, 2026, the outbreak has reached 54 health zones across six provinces, after initially being confined to Mongbabu in Ituri province. The United Nations and the World Health Organization warn of accelerating transmission and rising fatalities, urging a scaled-up international response. Tom Fletcher, the UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator, says the virus is killing one person every 30 minutes. The latest figures from Congo's Ministry of Communications and Media report 4,727 cases and 2,214 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 46.8%.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴでエボラが30分に1人の命を奪う - Urdu Point
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行が6州54保健地区に拡大し、致死率約46.8%と極めて深刻であり、国際的な支援拡大が要請されているため。
triage.notes: 国連・WHOが国際的な対応拡大を要請しており、過去最大規模の流行との報道。フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: UN Warns Ebola Claiming One Life Every 30 Minutes In DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugy o ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the fastest-spreading on record, with UN and WHO warnings. The virus is killing about one person every 30 minutes, per UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher, urging a strengthened international response. Initially confined to Mongbwalu health zone in Ituri province, the outbreak has spread to 54 health zones across six provinces. As of Aug 15, 2026, the DRC Ministry reports 2,214 deaths among 4,727 confirmed cases, a case fatality rate of roughly 46.8%. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the crisis, highlighting the urgency for enhanced containment to halt transmission and prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により30分に1人が死亡していると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクで、致死率約46.8%、6州54保健地域に拡大しUN/WHOが国際的対応強化を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: UN人道問題担当上級代表による警告および国際支援要請があり、致死率・拡大速度ともに極めて深刻。フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果東部伊波拉疫情迅速蔓延，監測系統難以追蹤接觸者，防疫工作面臨崩潰
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo spreads rapidly; surveillance system struggles to trace contacts; public health response faces collapse.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Ituri Province is spreading rapidly, with over 4,700 total cases and more than 2,200 deaths reported. The Bundibugyo strain is rare and currently has no approved vaccine or therapy. Surveillance is collapsing: 60–70% of new cases are found among people not on contact lists, meaning infections are often identified after transmission has occurred. Frontline health workers face severe hardship, including salary delays of over three months, PPE shortages, and fatigue from handling roughly 60–70 alerts daily; in Nyizi region, some staff have begun striking. Security and access are impeded by regional instability and multiple armed groups, with more than ten attacks on health facilities by mid-July, forcing some aid personnel to evacuate. The UN has added $30.5 million in emergency funding to support response and surveillance efforts. Community outreach remains critical to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ出血熱の流行が急速に拡大、監視システムが接触者追跡に苦戦し防疫活動が崩壊の危機に直面
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）が4,700例超・死者2,200人超に達し、監視体制の崩壊、武装勢力による攻撃、医療従事者のストライキなど公衆衛生対応の破綻が進行しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株であること、接触者追跡の60-70%が既知接触者リスト外であること、治安悪化と医療施設攻撃により対応が著しく困難化している点が重大なリスク要因。UNによる緊急資金投入（3050万ドル）は国際支援の必要性を裏付ける。

article.articleHeadline: Rutshuru : alerte sanitaire autour d'une viande d'hippopotame contaminée par le charbon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rutshuru: Health alert over hippopotamus meat contaminated with anthrax.
article.articleSummary: One confirmed case of anthrax in a hippopotamus found dead in Vitshumbi, Rutshuru territory, Nord-Kivu, inside Virunga National Park. The carcass was located August 8 by ICCN patrols; laboratory results were published later. Some residents had already recovered meat before the result. On August 14, the Kibirizi Rural Health Zone issued an alert urging Vitshumbi health facilities to closely monitor people who had contact with the animal or its meat. Health authorities urged active identification of individuals who handled, transported, cut, or consumed the hippo meat, and to monitor for signs such as unusual skin lesions, fever, or general deterioration. Any suspect case should be reported immediately, and exposed individuals identified for follow-up. Residents should not touch carcasses of animals found dead under unknown circumstances, nor cut or eat their meat. The area lies in a province grappling with Ebola and under M23 control, complicating surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ルチュル：カバの肉が炭疽菌に汚染された事案をめぐる健康警報
triage.triage_reason: 野生カバの死骸から炭疽菌が確認され、住民が既に肉を摂取・扱った可能性があり、コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州の紛争地域（M23支配下）でのサーベイランス困難さも重なるため、複数のWPRO基準に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 現時点で人への感染確定例は報告されていないが、既に肉を摂取・運搬した住民への追跡調査が進行中。同地域はエボラ流行も抱え、M23の実効支配下にあるため、保健当局の対応能力が制限されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde recomenda vacina contra sarampo para quem visita SP - 15/08/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health recommends measles vaccine for those visiting São Paulo - August 15, 2026
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination is recommended by Brazil’s Ministry of Health for people who do not live in São Paulo, Guarulhos, or São Bernardo do Campo but work there, as measles circulates in these cities and accounts for most confirmed cases in 2026. Since August, vaccination is advised for residents and workers aged 6 months to 59 years in the three cities, with boosters encouraged even for those previously vaccinated or who have had measles. In São Paulo state, 23 cases are reported: 20 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos; two imported cases and others linked to importation. Brazil lost measles-free status in 2019, regained in 2024; 2025 had 38 imported cases without outbreaks. The Multivacinação campaign runs Aug 3–Sep 1; dose zero is allowed for 6–11 months in ongoing transmission areas. About 660,000 MMR doses have been given in the three cities since Aug 3 (500k capital, 90k Guarulhos, 70k São Bernardo). 645 municipalities are supplied. Nationwide, over 10 million doses distributed in 2026, with about 3.6 million administered and 3.2 million reserved.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ訪問者に麻疹ワクチンを推奨 - 保健省 - 2026年8月15日
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除認定を回復した後の再流行であり、サンパウロ州で複数都市にまたがる感染継続と大規模ワクチン接種対応がなされているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2019年に麻疹排除認定を喪失し2024年に回復したが、2026年にサンパウロ州で23例（うち輸入例含む）が確認され、政府が大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施中。重症例・死亡の報告はなく、国内で管理可能な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Creche é fechada após surto de sarna humana com quase 80 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Daycare center closes after outbreak of human scabies with nearly 80 cases.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of human scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) in Estrela D’Oeste, a municipality in the interior of São Paulo, Brazil, led to the temporary closure of Creche Maria Luiza Gallo Freire de Carvalho after 78 confirmed cases among students at two local schools, with 50 cases concentrated at the affected daycare unit. The preventive shutdown ran from August 12 to August 14, 2026, during which enhanced cleaning, material sanitization, and pest-control measures were implemented to curb transmission. Scabies is a dermatological condition causing intense itching, transmitted mainly through prolonged direct skin contact but can also spread via shared items such as towels, bedding, and clothing. Authorities extended monitoring to parents, family members, and professionals with close contact, and epidemiological surveillance continues to assess additional cases and need for further interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の集団発生でほぼ80症例、保育所が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬はブラジル国内の一保育所・学校での限定的な集団発生であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに低く、既に対策が実施され収束傾向にあるため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染する皮膚疾患であるが、重症例や死亡例はなく、地元当局により既に予防的閉鎖・消毒対応が行われている。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 江西疾控提醒：夏秋季谨防蚊媒传播乙脑
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jiangxi CDC reminds: Be vigilant against mosquito-borne transmission of Japanese encephalitis in summer and autumn.
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis (JE) risk persists in Jiangxi during summer–autumn, with July–September peaking. JE virus is mainly transmitted by Culex tritaeniorhynchus mosquitoes; pigs and other livestock sustain the cycle, and humans are incidental hosts. Incubation is 4–21 days (usually 10–14). Early symptoms resemble flu, with fever 39–40°C, severe headache, nausea, and fatigue; progression can cause confusion, seizures, coma, respiratory failure, and death; about 30% of severe cases retain lifelong sequelae. Prevention requires a three-pronged approach: reduce infection sources by maintaining livestock housing hygiene; cut transmission by eliminating breeding sites and using nets, repellents, and other personal protections; and vaccinate. China uses two JE vaccines: live attenuated schedule (2 doses at 8 months and 2 years) and inactivated schedule (4 doses at 8 months, 2 and 6 years). Seek prompt medical care for fever with recent mosquito exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 江西疾病予防管理センターが注意喚起：夏秋季は蚊媒介の日本脳炎に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: 毎年季節性の日本脳炎に関する一般的な注意喚起・啓発記事であり、異常な発生や集団発生の報告はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は日本脳炎の疫学・予防に関する一般啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数や発生報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: CAG flags E. coli bacteria in drinking water at stations, cites violation of Railway Board norms
article.articleSummary: CAG flags E. coli in drinking water at multiple railway stations across SR, SCR, CR and ER: 2 stations in SR (Coimbatore, Palakkad Junctions), 1 in SCR (Hyderabad), 4 in CR (CSMT, Bhiwandi Road, Kalyan, Lonavala) and 1 in ER (Madhupur). Testing of taps on platforms at 49 stations in eight zones during 2022-23 and 56 stations in nine zones during 2023-24 showed Total coliforms, including E. coli; bacteriological tests beyond Total coliforms were unsatisfactory at 8 stations in 2022-23 and 11 stations in 2023-24. The audit covers 2019-20 to 2023-24 and earlier cases. Indian Railways has 5,908 NSG stations, operates ~7,424 non-suburban trains daily, and carried 292.4 crore non-suburban passengers in 2023-24. MEA deficiencies were found at 458 of 512 stations; specific gaps include latrines (201), urinals (403) and water taps (2,035). RB’s 2018 guidelines mandate MEA/RA/DA; recommendations urge compliance with water-quality testing under the Uniform Drinking Water Quality Protocol.

triage.headline_ja: CAG(会計検査院)、駅の飲料水から大腸菌を検出 鉄道委員会の規定違反を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 会計監査報告に基づく水質基準違反の指摘であり、実際の集団感染や患者発生の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はCAG(会計検査院)による鉄道駅の飲料水質監査報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。水質管理体制の不備を指摘する行政監査記事。
